row.name: Monkey Party
row.detailed_description: Get ready to unleash the adorable monkeys in Monkey Party! This charming puzzle game invites you to merge balls and set these cute critters free. Combine them strategically to build the ultimate tower of monkey fun! Key Features: 🐵 Monkey Mayhem: Release playful monkeys from their colorful balls! Watch as they join the party and bring a dose of adorable antics to your tower. 🎯 Precision Puzzling: Hone your dropping skills to create perfect combinations. Every move counts as you carefully place balls to maximize your monkey party! 🌈 Whimsical World: Immerse yourself in a vibrant world filled with cheerful monkeys and lively colors. Monkey Party is a cheerful celebration for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages! Join the Monkey Party today and let the cuteness and fun overflow! Merge balls, free the monkeys, and build a tower that's the life of the party!
row.short_description: Merge balls, unleash adorable monkeys, and build a tower of fun in Monkey Party! Master precision placement for maximum monkey mischief. It's a charming puzzle adventure that's easy to play and hard to put down!

row.name: Save and Conquer : 8 Years
row.detailed_description: 'Due to climate change, the Earth in 2027 has run out of energy resources. In Korea, batteries charged with a set amount of power are provided to all individuals, companies, and national organizations to guarantee the minimum right to live. War is taking place around the world to scramble for energy resources. We must protect the batteries in the military installations from intruders trying to take them away. You're the commander of a military unit being invaded. Use battery power properly to protect the battery by preventing enemies from attacking 10 times in total.' As you can see in the title, this game is a 2D defense game that was developed for 5 months inspired by Command and Conquer. In-game music, illustration, and scripting(Except for some sound effects) are all being developed by one person. The game that I used to make as a practice gradually developed and participated in the BIGS 2022(Korean indie game show), and as a result, it was released on Steam. The game depicts the future of climate change. The time remaining before the increase in carbon emissions affects humanity has been set as a subtitle of the game, and the game is intended to remind gamers of the dangers. There are still many bugs in the game and there are many shortcomings. We will continue to develop and update continuously even after the release. Please show a lot of interest. Thank you.
row.short_description: This is a 2D defense game that depicts the near future that may arise from climate change. Unlike the defense game, which is automatically attacked by traditional turrets, it is an attractive game that requires you to defeat the enemy by operating the turret directly with limited power.

row.name: 洪荒：我挂机成圣
row.detailed_description: gameplay 游戏开始时，能够选择喜欢的角色作为初始角色，也可以碰碰运气选择随机 当拥有请神令后，也可以使用获得更多的角色，游戏中的角色多大数百名 获得未鉴定的装备时使用将会获得6种质量，数百种不同的技能、词条，构筑的装备 当有了新的角色并经过战斗获得灵气后，即可对角色进行升级，哪怕是相同的角色也会有完全不同的成长 如果对角色的神通技能不满意，也可以通过使用神通书来进行替换或新增 若拥有较多同名的角色请神令，也可以通过分解获得材料或者重生角色来提高属性 两个完全不同的角色间也可以进行融合，取长补短，技能组合，当然，若是运气较差也可能一无所有 当拥有多个角色后，可以选择将角色上阵，如果有强力的阵法也会对阵容有着极大的加强 不仅仅角色能够升级，提升玩家的境界等级也会极大的加强所有角色 当玩家突破大道等级时不仅能提高角色的等级上限，还能获得大道点，选择三千大道 当拥有强力的角色与阵容时，便可前往论道界面，与其他道友一较高下，当然也无需担心遇到强者大能，因为每一境界都会有独立的论道系统与奖励 如果背包里的道具已满，也可以将道具放入仓库之中 或者将有价值的物品与其他道友自由贸易，买低卖高，囤货居奇，修道不成，做一商人货通诸天亦可 About the Game Sorry, the R&D team is not very proficient in English, so there is currently no English version available 本游戏没有内购！本游戏没有内购！本游戏没有内购！ 大家且听我狡辩，我主打的一个就是听劝，直接把付费砍掉，直接就是一个联网放置挂机可交易网游 请大家给我一个面子……打的轻点…… 交流QQ群：930278060 discord群组： 洪荒：我挂机成圣（以下简称洪荒）不是一款靠名字够长吸引人的游戏，而是一款精心打磨的大型网络策略卡牌放置角色扮演类游戏 美术风格使用传承几千年的文字所组成，无一不是大师级设计，不在任何地方节省美术资源的使用，在游戏行业遥遥领先。 游戏题材选择了以网络小说洪荒流做为大世界，融合了世界顶级IP西游记，中国顶级IP封神演义、宝莲灯、白蛇传、聊斋、东游记、倩女幽魂等等，更甚有史诗传记等不下 万部内容结合而成，上到盘古、鸿钧，下到法海、小倩应有尽有，说一句“万P史”也不为过。 当然……这些借鉴内容里面各种各样脍炙人口的故事我们肯定是一点没有的。 洪荒的核心玩法方面，我们充分的借鉴融合了各种出色的游戏设计。 比如，我们在史诗级游戏“梦幻西游”中借鉴了宠物资质、炼妖、打书、阵法系统，让玩家可以在洪荒中给不同的角色学习不同的神通，融合不同的角色本源提升资质，正 所谓我命由我不由天，是神是仙由你说了算，就算是小钻风也有一颗妖族大圣的心。 再比如，我们在殿堂级游戏“暗黑破坏神”系列中，借鉴了装备鉴定以获得不同质量以及各式各样的词条组合，达到更高更强的阵容，你再也不用担心看着每个装备属性都 一样而不知道选啥了，因为不一样你也不知道选啥。 再再比如，我们还融合了传统MMO的交易、好友、聊天等系统，你可以将获取的道具与其他玩家进行交易，将自己获得的超强角色进行拍卖，你甚至能囤货居奇，然后让 自己在高位套牢，损失惨重。 其他各式各样的玩法，那就更是多的数不胜数……
row.short_description: 洪荒是一款非常非常非常肝的文字素材类游戏，游戏中没有华丽的美术，闪亮亮的特效，完全以放置挂机的数值玩法为驱动，养成依靠打书、炼妖、修炼、构筑装备品质词条等搭配数百名不同的角色，在其中玩家更能够通过放置挂机获得宝物与资源，拥有各种神话传说中的角色，然后将获得的物品角色与其他玩家进行交易来养成自己最强的阵容。

You kill enemies in a multiplayer match where you can grab flags from their base back to yours. row.short_description: Fight your way to victory!

row.name: SIC-1
row.detailed_description: SIC-1 is a programming game where the computer only understands a single instruction. Learn an esoteric assembly language. Implement programs to unlock more impressive job titles. Optimize your programs to climb the leaderboards. Sacrifice your personal life for the good of the company! It's an assembly language zachlike for everyone! New programmers will appreciate how few unique instructions there are to learn (just one!), and experienced programmers will appreciate how poorly suited this one instruction is for writing straight-forward programs. If you're ready for a challenge, respond to this job posting from SIC Systems: SIC Systems is hiring engineers to produce highly efficient programs for our flagship product: the Single Instruction Computer Mark 1 (SIC-1). The SIC-1 represents a transformational change in computing, reducing complexity to the point that the processor only executes a single instruction: subtract and branch if less than or equal to zero ('subleq'). Enter the brave new world of single-instruction computing and invent new ways of implementing programs that would be trivial on a conventional computer. Don't adjust the technology to match how you think, adjust your thinking to match how the SIC-1 operates!
row.short_description: SIC-1 is a single-instruction programming game. Neglect your personal life in pursuit of promotions and vague assurances of job security! Optimize your programs to rise to the top of the leaderboards! SIC Systems thanks you for your hard work! Now please return to your desk.

row.name: Gum Ball Run
row.detailed_description: Gum Ball Run is a free to play 3D multiplayer racing platformer where up to 15 Gum Balls run for ultimate glory!. Features: - Tight platforming controls - Colorful, cute and vibrant aesthetics - Online PvP multiplayer with up to 15 players per race - Procedurally generated obstacle tracks across 8 different themes. - Character customization - Free to play! - Leaderboards to compare your skill! - Compete in ranked races or set up unranked custom races with friends - Single player obstacle tracks Each obstacle track is procedurally made. row.name: Space Runaway
row.detailed_description: Space Runaway, a compelling intergalactic journey soaked in bullet hell. Enemy vessels, lasers and larger than life bosses coming at you full speed in a 16-bit authentic arcade experience like no other. Not only an integral part of Wanted: Dead, Space Runaway is a standalone game that features 7 unique stages that will test your reflexes. Space Runaway will be available as an arcade mini-game within Wanted: Dead and is now available for free to give a taste of things to come on Valentine’s Day 2023. Key features: 7 challenging levels to test your arcade skills to the limit. 7 epic bosses that each require a unique approach 7 nostalgic chiptunes to create an unforgettable atmosphere. Voyager 1, a space probe launched by NASA on September 5, 1977, as part of the Voyager program to study the outer Solar System and interstellar space beyond the Sun's heliosphere and deliver a message to a possible extraterrestrial life. The Voyager message was carried by a phonograph record, a 12-inch gold-plated copper disk containing sounds and images selected to portray the diversity of life and culture on Earth. Message received. 200 years later. Planet Corot, one of the few habitable worlds discovered in the second age of space exploration, houses a military research facility where a super secret project known as XR-110 is being commissioned. A giant combat mech capable of interstellar travel is the brainchild of Dr. Lincoln Maverick, the last hope for humanity to resist the wrath of The Toliman Empire. A group of spies from Proxima Centauri swiftly discover that XR-110 is extraterrestrial in its design as well. The mech, that soon will set the galaxy on fire, is a long-lost relic from the Toliman’s past. The Empire launches a surprise attack on Planet Corot before Dr. Maverick manages to refurbish the mech. In order to secure the ancient weapon all forces are thrown into battle. Corot is scorched in mere seconds. General Scaph launches the assault and assumes control over the planet. Before the research facility is levelled to the ground and Dr. Maverick and his team fight off the aliens until the last breath, Lt. Brooklyn Landers of The Earth Confederation Defence Force mans the mech and escapes the facility unharmed. Lt. Landers, reckless and diffident, unwillingly shoulders the fate of humanity. General Scaph, now enraged, orders The Toliman Empire forces to pursue and annihilate the Space Runaway.
row.short_description: Space Runaway, a compelling intergalactic journey soaked in bullet hell. Enemy vessels, lasers and larger than life bosses coming at you full speed in a 16-bit authentic arcade experience like no other.

row.name: Square Off
row.detailed_description: Roll to move. Move to aim. Aim to win. You're a square, and it's time to Square Off! Up to 4 friends get to battle it out in this 'edgy' arena party brawler with unique controls. A New Spin On 2D Platforming You move by rolling. You also aim by rolling. You can climb anything. Chaos reigns supreme with this control scheme. We Accept All Types Of Playstyles Want to play skillfully and maneuver like a master? That works. Want to button mash and create mayhem wherever you roll? Yeah, that works too. Orient Yourself To Your Abilities Obliterate your friends with an array of unique abilities that attach themselves to one of your sides. Use these to fight off your friends! If you survive long enough, you'll be able to pick up boosts that jetpack you across the map or shield you from harm. If you keep surviving, acquire an ultimate ability to unleash complete devastation on your friends. Location Location Location A multitude of stages with unique mechanics add to the chaos by providing new possibilities for play, whether you're bouncing sky-high, knocking another player into lava, or throwing yourself through a teleporter. Support For The Underdog Losing? Don't worry! With a variety of underdog powerups, no game will ever be truly lost as you unleash new powers that increase in power the further you are behind. Free Forever Play with your friends for free. This will never change regardless of how much new content goes into the game!
row.short_description: Square Off is a mayhem filled local party arena brawler where you must roll to move, move to aim, and aim to win by battling it out with up to 3 of your friends in short-chaos filled matches.

Race : There are more than 40 pilots who are divided into more than 20 teams. So choose a driver and try to lead him to victory. Season : - Season 2022 of E-INRX 9 drivers , 4 teams and 9 tracks Race with 5-6 cars Season 7 races - Season 2022 of UK Rallycross 7 drivers , 6 teams and 7 tracks Race with 6-7 cars Season 4 races - Season 2022 of RNordic 12 drivers 9 teams and 9 tracks Race with 5-6 cars Season 4 races - Season of RCenter Race with 5-6 cars Season 2 races - Season of Finland Race with 5-6 cars Season 2 races - Season 2021 of SARX 8 drivers 5 teams and 4 tracks Race with 7-8 cars Season 3 races - Season 2022 of E-ARC 13 drivers 4 teams and 11 tracks Race with 7-8 cars Season 5 races ARC Classic 4 races - 8 Songs Only - keyboards and mouse - Controller This game includes : - Fake names - Fake tracks - Fake teams - Fake cars No licence

row.name: Gaze Into Fate
row.detailed_description: The wilds are scarred by the endless cycle of war. It’s time for a change. In a world that has always been the way it is, Tiiyao, a shaman and tribal leader, searches for knowledge and answers. Communicate with your ancestors and experience an intense story in this approximately 60 minute game experience that will also make you search for answers. Why does the cycle of war never ends? Which is the right path? What is your fate in this world? Do we even have a choice? Immerse yourself in a primeval, shattered world and find your so needed answers. ‚Gaze Into Fate‘ is a meditative and story-driven puzzle game, where you have to find your place in a world of endless wars. Can you make a change? 50+ challenging puzzels, a fully voiced story line and highly polished visuals and sounds are making this game to a special game experience. An exciting story with a serious background Set in a mystical & primal world 50+ challenging but never frustrating puzzles fully voiced characters highly polished, hand drawn visuals coherent soundtracks and sound effects 100% free to play About the developer For us, this is our very first game we ever created as a team. We are so proud of what we accomplished and it’s definitely just the beginning of our journey. Please follow us on social media if you want to be part of our community as a supporter.
row.short_description: A meditative and story-driven puzzle game, where you must discover answers to decisions, we all have to make. Can you make a change in a world of endless wars?

row.name: Legend of Snake
row.detailed_description: The third game in the Legend series, this game is more complex than Legend of Zero, and a bit more strategic, it has 3 level difficulties and have 6 characters. There are 11 chapters in this game, same as the Legend of Zero. All in all I consider this game to be a improved version of Legend of Zero, and has way more replay value, also included the classic permanent death mode. The game itself it extremely similar to Fire Emblem, you move characters on a grid map and defeat each map to advance to the next map, you can level up the characters and gain new skill and classes. It's an RPG styled game without any story.
row.short_description: Another Fire Emblem Clone, this one has a unique spin, overall I consider this an improved version of the previous 2 Legend of games, the game has 3 modes including the classic permanent death mode, it's slightly harder than the previous 2 Legend games I made, hope you enjoy.

row.name: Deltazone
row.detailed_description: War didn’t arrive with a speech. It crept in. In DELTAZONE, it’s the background noise of your life—sirens in the distance, power grids flickering, streets emptied in a hurry. The spark? Veilstone. Purple veins running under the earth, torn open by greed. Touch it and it burns the world differently: lights whole cities, or levels them. Everyone wants it. No one agrees on what it should be for. Lines you thought were permanent keep shifting. Allies today, enemies tomorrow. You learn faces first, flags second. You share rations with strangers at noon and trade fire with them by nightfall. Trust becomes a calculation, not a feeling. Your crew has a simple brief that never feels simple: take back home. The places you grew up are checkpointed now, renamed by people who don’t belong there. Every block costs something, ammo, sleep, a friend’s voice you won’t hear again. You keep moving because stopping hurts worse. Veilstone doesn’t just power machines. It leaks into soil and lungs. Gardens turned to glass. Rivers that glow at midnight. Stay too long and people change, skin toughens, eyes shine, tempers break. The map is honest about one thing: everything past the next corner wants you gone. Soldiers. Drones. Things that used to be human. So you plan. You adapt. You live with the plan failing and make another before the smoke clears. Sometimes Veilstone is the edge you need, a battery in a dead city, a shield that holds one second longer than it should. Sometimes it bites back. You decide how close to stand. Welcome to DELTAZONE. No speeches. No guarantees. Just you, your crew, and a war that won’t end by itself. What you take. What you save. What you become. That’s the mark you leave.
row.short_description: DELTAZONE drops players into an unprecedented global conflict that has been going on for a few years. Your mission is to wipe out the opposing team and take back the land that was once yours.
row.reviews: “Before I played Deltazone, I had a small pp, no friends, no gf, depression, and no life. These things havent changed, but the game is pretty good” 8/10 – 'SugarBaby'

An ice cream man dressed as a penguin who drives a van with a giant penguin-shaped ice cream loses his precious load, help him recover all the penguin-shaped ice creams without getting caught. The costume will prevent the ice cream man from using his hands, but he can use the head or the beak to smash bricks and make his enemies fall. Use your skills to complete this penguin-shaped game XD
row.short_description: Ice-Cream Killer is an old style platform game that will test your skills. Get ready to face one of the hardest games you've ever played.

row.name: Enclosure 3-D
row.detailed_description: Story You play as Mike Goodman, a small-time con man who, after yet another night of bad business, gets an offer he just can't refuse. The next day you find yourself joining a party of 10 professionals embarking on a mission to uncover the secrets of an abandoned arctic base. Gameplay Enclosure is a text-parser graphic adventure game inspired by classics of the genre and horror movies of the 80s. You control Mike by moving him around and issuing commands via keyboard. You explore and interact with the environment, talk to your fellow party members and solve adventure game-style puzzles on the way. Enclosure 3-D is a modern remaster of the game Enclosure originally released in 2004. The graphics have been remodeled in 3D while preserving the pixel art look of the game, and a completely new soundtrack has been composed. You can switch between original and remastered graphics by using F2 in the game. Controls move Mike using arrow keys or the numpad (tap to move/stop) type in text commands ('look', 'open door' etc.) Enter to progress dialog Escape to open menu F11 for fullscreen Tips Talk - talk to all characters until you've exhausted their conversations (F3) Observe - ask Mike to look at anything that stands out Explore - walk inside and outside the station to discover all the locations
row.short_description: You are Mike Goodman, joining a mission to investigate mysterious activity at an arctic base. Text-parser mystery adventure game inspired by classics of the genre, using pixel art in 3D.
row.notes: May contain pixel art images of blood and gore.

row.name: Signal & Echo: Iris is Missing (demo)
row.detailed_description: Just gimme the gist! Informed by the developer’s past career in journalism, you play as Ollie, a wannabe reporter on his first day of work experience at the Signal & Echo newspaper, in the fictional town of Runeton, England. Ollie thought he’d be chained to his desk all day, rewriting press releases. Instead, he’s been given a real assignment: find out what happened to missing schoolgirl Iris Wood. Using a unique text parser system, alongside traditional point-and-click mechanics, help Ollie impress his colleagues and break the story wide open! What’s this about a ‘unique’ text parser? Alongside the verb interactions and inventory puzzles found in many traditional adventure games, Signal and Echo: Iris is Missing uses an innovative text parser system—for conversations, searching the newspaper’s computer archive, and finding new locations on your map. The system recognises any proper noun (i.e. capitalised noun, like John Smith, London, or The Beatles), so long as you’ve found it in-game. It also accepts the name of any hotspot, from any location, including inventory items. This means you can ask anyone about any of these things. You'll need to take notes out in the real world and really think for yourself! (All the puzzles use real-world logic, as opposed to cartoon or moon logic.)
row.short_description: A point-and-click adventure with innovative detective mechanics. Help Ollie, a fledgling reporter on his first day at the Signal & Echo newspaper, to solve the mystery behind a schoolgirl's disappearance. Developed by an ex-journalist.

row.name: Stagdraft
row.detailed_description: DISCORD Jump into Discord with us and become directly involved in our community-focused game development! About the Game STAGDRAFT is a chaotic 2D top-down multiplayer wargame that brings medieval fantasy battles with Hack and Slash PvP action, STAGDRAFT supports up to 24 players and lets you roleplay as one of five ranges of classes: Swordsman, Spearman, Ranger, Magic Staff, and Berserker. The objective is simple yet challenging: capture all the zones along with your allies and secure the final objective to claim your victory in a brutal domination warfare! STAGDRAFT is also accessible for a cross-platform multiplayer, allowing you to combat through PC or mobile device. Get ready to experience the chaotic excitement of medieval combat! Strategize with your allies, and dominate the battleground in this epic fantasy wargame against the enemies. Features: Playable Up to 16 Players: Engage in intense 24-player battles with friends and rivals. Five Unique Classes: Swordsman, Spearman, Ranger, Magic Staff, or Berserker. Diverse Skills: Utilize Shields, Magic Projectiles, and Buffs to enhance your strategy. Frontline Gamemode: Capture and push the zones forward to achieve victory. Cross Platform Multiplayer: Available on PC and mobile devices. Immersive 2D Pixel-Art: Crafted with a nostalgic pixel-art graphics.
row.short_description: STAGDRAFT is a Chaotic 2D multiplayer hack and slasher. Designed for intense PvP action and supports up to 24 players. Pick your role, strategize with your allies and dominate the battleground to capture all the zones and secure the final objectives in a domination warfare!

row.name: ClasSimVR
row.detailed_description: ClasSimVR is a serious game and an exploratory platform targeted at helping pre-service teacher learn about challenging student behaviour. It is a prototype that introduces users to an approach to supporting classroom behaviour called School-Wide Positive Behaviour Interventions and Supports (SWPBIS). Gameplay involves users moving through an introductory scene where the core elements of an SWPBIS approach are explained. Users are then transported into a virtual classroom where they will encounter three scenarios involving a virtual student displaying a low-level challenging behaviour. Users are required to select and then act out one of nine different SWPBIS strategies focused on supporting low-level challenging behaviours.
row.short_description: ClasSimVR is a serious game and an exploratory platform targeted at helping pre-service teacher learn about challenging student behaviour.

row.name: Murders at Tealwoods Manor
row.detailed_description: You've been invited to a strange party at Lady Tealwoods' new mansion. The other members of the guestlist are strange and often quarrelsome, and you are all locked in until midnight. A sudden murder is revealed, and you must piece together who is lying, and who is the murderer as you uncover the secrets of the different strange guests of Tealwoods Manor. 13 playable characters with unique dialogue. A murderer randomly selected from the attendee's, unique every game. The murderer will cleverly lie to you, and frantic guests will claim they saw anything, up to you to figure out what the truth is. Up to 20 million unique combinations of dialogue and scenarios built into the game's randomization engine. wager on which guests will survive the night in an attempt to score the most points.
row.short_description: You've been invited to a strange party at Lady Tealwoods' new mansion. It's not long until a sudden murder is revealed, and you must piece together who is lying, and who is the murderer as you uncover the secrets of the different strange guests of Tealwoods Manor.

row.name: Memory Lost: Chapter One
row.detailed_description: About the Game Memory Lost is a story driven action shooter, the battles in which are built around the mechanics of mind capturing and moving into the enemy's body. First-aid kits were not delivered, there is only one magazine in the weapon - change the bodies to survive! New body - new gameplay. There are dozens of archetypes of opponents in the game, each with its own unique characteristics and skills that affect the outcome of the battle. Relocation is the basis of survival If you don't want to run around in a half - dead state, look for a healthy body! Are the weapons out of ammo? Move into the enemy with full ammunition! Copy enemies' memories! Capturing consciousness is impossible without capturing memories. With each new migration, the Neural Network, the main character of Memory Lost, will collect more and more material to develop its own independent personality, after which it will process the knowledge gained and reap the fruits of his actions at the Mind-Map hub location. Karma in a top-down shooter? The neural network is also shaped by your interaction with the surrounding world. Kill for the common good or for mercy, regardless of the consequences - and get one of three possible endings. Warning: A very small percentage of people may experience seizures while viewing certain images, such as flashing lights or patterns that may be present in video games.
row.short_description: First chapter of Memory Lost. It is a story-driven action shooter, the battles in which are built around the mechanics of mind capturing and moving into the enemy's body. First-aid kits were not delivered, there is only one magazine in the weapon - change the bodies to survive!
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

row.name: Chris Isn't Alone
row.detailed_description: THE PREMISE Chris Isn't Alone is a horror/comedy game where your choices actually have an effect on the outcome of the story. You play as Chris, a 12 year old boy that has just come to the realization that the monster in his closet was real. The monster informs you that they are there to kill you. You must convince it otherwise. CHOOSE YOUR OWN PATH You will be presented with many different choices that WILL have an effect on the outcome of the story. A story path that you may have gone down previously could end up changing depending on what items Chris has... ENDINGS There are a total of 17 unique endings! Can you find the TRUE ending? There is a reward for unlocking all the endings... HOW TO PLAY When you see text on the screen, you can Left Click to advance through the dialogue. Players can use a mouse or trackpad. PLEASE ENJOY! Keep in mind that this is a student project! Feedback would be amazing!
row.short_description: Can you convince a demon from another realm to spare your life? Chris Isn't Alone is a visual novel horror/comedy game that gives players freedom to choose their own path towards their fate. This is a student project!
row.notes: This game contains violent imagery as well as descriptive violent text.

row.name: My Loving Wife
row.detailed_description: This is the story of you and your wife. Since it's your story, you get to decide the protagonist's gender! Every day, you come home from work to spend time with your wife who loves you more than anything and you feel the same, hoping the time that you both spend together will last forever. Things aren't always perfect though. Both of you are going to make mistakes, but that's not gonna stop the two of you from loving each other, right? How you will spend time with your wife is up to you. Of course, you can always be a good spouse and treat her right, but if you make certain decisions, she definitely won't be happy. There are at least a few ways things can turn out depending on your actions, whether they're good or bad. Things are gonna get tough, but that's not gonna separate the two of you. Besides, it's not like either of you is hiding anything from the other... right? Spend time reading this story, make decisions and see how your wife ends up because of them. Features: - Nameable Protagonist - Nameable Wife - 3 Gender Choices - Multiple Endings
row.short_description: Come home to see your wife who loves you a lot every day.
row.notes: There are scenes that in the game that contain violence, with text mentioning gore, murder, and self-harm/suicide.

row.name: Wobble Warriors
row.detailed_description: Wobble Warriors is a 1-4 player ragdoll fighting couch co-op game. In this dungeon crawler, you and your friends play as some wobbly dragons on a mission to conquer the goblins who stole your gold. Jump, dash, ground pound, and bonk your way to victory by clearing each room. The king of the goblins is not only hoarding away the dragon's gold, but has locked himself in the throne room. Find the golden key, defeat the king, and celebrate your victory! Traversing the slime-covered goblin's dungeon is scary by yourself, so bring some friends along and reap the benefits of having additional help. Allied dragons can ground pound near knocked out dragons to revive them back to full health while pushing away the goblins at the same time. Even if an allied dragon cannot come to revive their friend, health slowly replenishes as long as all dragons are not knocked out. When all dragons are knocked out, a life is lost and all players get teleported to the previous room. When all lives are gone, it's game over. Whether you want to play with others or play by yourself to strengthen your skills, Wobble Warriors was made in mind to be played by all skill levels. Will you rejoice in victory or will you get knocked down to try again?
row.short_description: Wobble Warriors is a 1-4 player ragdoll fighting couch co-op game. In this dungeon crawler, you and your friends play as some wobbly dragons on a mission to conquer the goblins who stole your gold. Jump, dash, ground pound, and bonk your way to victory by clearing each room.

row.short_description: Gravity Box is a retro-styled score attack game that requires the player to frantically swap gravity in order to avoid hazards. Grab the gems, unlock cool costumes, and see how long you can last!

row.name: Post-Apo Builder: Prologue
row.detailed_description: It's time to learn about the dangers of the wasteland. You've trained all your life to be one of the captains. The council of elders has given you your first serious assignment. You must lead your people through the wastelands. For the first time, you get access to 3rd level of technology. Which gives you access to vehicles, allows you to explore further terrain. You need to prepare the necessary equipment and resoruces. The wasteland awaits. Restore civilization on the ashes of the fallen world! Scavenge and gather for resources, everything counts! Build and manage city of survivors after a apocalypse. Take care of every aspect of life. Gather, build, farm, upgrade, win ! Explore wastelands to gather resources, protect and take care of your people! Fight off raiders, wild tribesman and natural disasters.
row.short_description: Discover a post-apocalyptic world Collect resources and manage people Build your colony on the remains of an oil tanker Prepare supplies and vehicles for a dangerous expedition. Complete challenging tasks from the council of elders

row.name: Under Observation
row.detailed_description: Under Observation is a first-person, single-player horror game developed by a group of students from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences. In-game you are a researcher working at a Bioweapons R&D company, focusing on national security. You've been given a subject which you need to study and fill out a report on. Now the subject has escaped its containment and the facility is on lockdown. The only way out is to open the main blast door with a staff keycard but unluckily you lost yours and need to find it. The rogue subject is a dangerous entity so you need to dance a fine line between avoiding it and following its every action to gather intel. Research focuses on the behavioral patterns of the subject. The aim is to figure out the subject's perks and abilities such as sight, hearing, and diet. As you gather intel the subject's main type becomes more evident. There is a total of 20 different subject types. When you are confident about the subject's type, the research is completed. Some perks are more subtle such as genetype, which gives out no visual clues. Instead, you need to take a sample off the subject and run that through various experiments. Some terrifying variations of the subject are also able to turn completely invisible. You have many gadgets at your disposal that are used in the experiments. These include things such as flashlights, dart guns, tablets, and photo cameras. Guard post has a CCTV monitoring station which you can use to locate the subject. Between the main corridors of the facility runs ventilation ducts that are accessible and great for hiding. ______________________________________________________________________________ 'A week ago they brought yet another subject to be analyzed. I believe this one was grown at ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ . The report we got from them suggests that subject's 4th development stage had an evolution score of 4.6. This means that the behavioral patterns need to be mapped thoroughly before commercial deployment can even be considered. It may never fit that mold, but that big of an evolutionary jump must be investigated. The subject is now located at ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ , where it is to undergo ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ . All required documentation on the said operation can be obtained through intel management. As the facility's security system was newly upgraded, the procedures/experiments with an SR of 3 or lower can be conducted by just 1 person on-site Operational Management, ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ Soteria Security Solutions Great is the Enemy of Perfect'
row.short_description: You are a researcher working at a Bioweapons R&D company, focusing on national security. The weapons being developed here are usually horrifying beasts that possess many different perks. In your case, one of them has escaped and it's up to you to continue your research or escape the facility.

row.name: Wings of The Universe
row.detailed_description: Wings of The Universe is an indie game inspired by game titles 'Space Rangers 2: Reboot' (PC game), 'Avorion' (PC game) and 'Interstellar Pilot' (mobile game). Wings of The Universe is a game full of battles, diplomacies and trades. You can be a miner, merchant, warrior, diplomat or a strategist. You can build an empire with your friends and fight your foes, or become a pirate to promote chaos within other empires. There is only one galaxy, so make sure your name goes down in its history! Important In order to play, you have to register via game client or the game website. The game server is located in Europe, Germany. Players outside of Europe might face high internet latency issues. Key Features: single global map (the whole galaxy divided to 25 sectors and each sector is divided to 25 systems) purely player based economy (there are no NPC shops, everything is made and sold by players) galaxy domination, fights for resources strategy and tactics - your type of equipment and chosen ship make the difference bonuses for playing with other players in a long-term faction and a short-term squadron chained missions and repeatable missions non-pvp zone on starting map Purely player-based economy The space is empty. It is up to the players to create factions and build the space stations they need. Each station have different items it can interact with. This makes each station type have their own list of shop items and their own factory lines, which can consume the input items (mostly commodities) to create the output items (other commodities, ships or pieces of equipment). Players then set-up the shop prices, which can exclude some items from being bought or sold by the station or the player. Strategy Your equipment and skills matter! There are limitations on the ship equipment, but there are many types of equipment to choose from. Should you use projectile or energy weapons? Should your protection be against projectile or energy weapons? Should you take smaller or a bigger ship? Every target is different and one equipment strategy might not work all the time. Knowledge and reconnaissance is a key to survive. It also makes a difference if your strategy involves other players who can help achieve your goals. Tactics 'I go first and you follow' can sometimes be followed by 'Are you sure about that?' and Wings of The Universe is no exception. Especially when it comes to wars between players. Be prepared to be ambushed at all times. The space is vast and an enemy can come from any direction! Take a friend with you who will cover you or act as a bait for your own forces to counter an ambush. Prepare a carrier ship full of players to be safely transported to the war zone and be ready to be launched straight into battle.
row.short_description: Wings of The Universe (WoTU) is a free-to-play 2D indie space action MMORPG top-down game developed by a single programmer. WoTU is designed to be co-op heavy, but even a lone wolf can survive with his skills and have fun.

row.name: Fishing Online
row.detailed_description: Fishing Online lets you explore the joy of fishing in beautiful natural settings—online. Join friends or global players and experience a relaxing fishing life together. ■ The Fun of Fishing Your fishing journey begins! When you hook a fish, the real challenge begins as you battle to reel it in. Simple controls meet unique fish behavior patterns that deliver that satisfying fishing thrill. ■ Stylized Cartoon Graphics Experience nature brought to life through warm, cartoon-style visuals. Rivers, lakes, and a wide range of unique fish await you. ■ Cooking & Gathering Raise your catches or turn them into tasty meals. Collect ingredients from the wild to cook dishes that provide helpful fishing buffs. You can also craft your own tools. ■ Online Play Connect with friends or players worldwide. Explore maps inspired by locations around the globe and enjoy the game together. ■ Frequent Updates We're a small indie development team, but we're committed to listening to player feedback and providing regular updates. Fish Encyclopedia: View your catches, records, and rankings. Personal Pond: Raise various fish and decorative species. Fishing Tournaments: Compete globally and earn rewards based on rank. Fishing Area Expansion: Plans to expand from freshwater to ocean fishing. Co-op Play: Raid content to catch special fish with friends is in development.
row.short_description: Begin your new online fishing adventure! Fishing Online is a cooperative adventure game where you explore the world and enjoy fishing with friends. Catch over 300 types of fish, complete your collection, and dive into crafting and cooking activities!

row.name: Don't Hide
row.detailed_description: Trapped in a maze with a beast, you must find five keys and their door to escape. The monster can only smell and hear you, but as long as it hasn't fully caught your scent, you can move freely. Don't Hide offers a horror experience where you're forced to manage the monster and explore the surroundings. Nothing is easy to find, as you'll always be surrounded by dreadful darkness. You'll be left searching for five barely illuminated keys, all scattered around the maze. However, your time is limited, as the creature trapped in the maze with you will will eventually catch your scent. Be sure to run away when close, and if it hasn't fully caught your scent, hide to get it off your tracks. Don't Hide offers 6 different levels, all with varying difficulty and predetermined initial key, object, and exit door locations. A 3 star system will help rank your performance in each room. At least one star is required to progress to the next room. Developed in Godot, this game was a side project of mine that I learned along with Godot. Updates may proceed the release with more levels, objects, or features. Its more than likely that I will release balance changes as well as more and more people play the game and test out the ranking system as well as the minor and major time (scent) limits. Controls: WASD = movement Space = hide Escape = open/close menu (pauses game), or go back to previous menu Enter/Left Click = Select Objectives Find all five keys With 5 Keys, find the exit door Don't get caught by the creature Credits Sole developed: T0rt1z (Shawn F.)
row.short_description: Trapped in a maze with a beast, you must find five keys and their door to escape. The monster can only smell and hear you, but as long as it hasn't fully caught your scent, you can move freely.

row.name: Touhou: Fading Illusion
row.detailed_description: Touhou: Fading Illusion is a visual novel set in Touhou Project universe that comprehensively describes Gensokyo and its inhabitants. Get ready to meet many of the series' iconic characters and travel to various locations in the Underworld, Gensokyo, Heaven, and even Outside World! Synopsis: Throughout the ages, excessive curiosity has had a cruel cost. Once, the urge for the unknown made humans superior to animals, but the fear caused by this urge gave birth to the youkai, creatures that rose above mankind itself. Although both species have managed to find a way to coexist peacefully, even today modesty is still not in high favour. While technology is advancing at a rapid pace in the Outside World, the Gensokyo sages are falling deeper and deeper into the illusion of their own power, not realising that there may be something very different, deep, and extremely dense that even they should not touch. With each passing day, the prospect of its coming to light is gradually becoming a question of time. Reimu is enjoying a warm spring day at her shrine, but her rest is interrupted by Yukari, who, in her manner, shows up unexpectedly and gives the shrine maiden an urgent task: Yukari wants Reimu to follow Sumireko at the festival at the Myouren Temple. The matter concerns the Hakurei Barrier, so Reimu has no choice but to go to the base of her rivals and hope that in the evening, Yukari deigns to explain everything that is happening. Game Features: Suitable for people unfamiliar with Touhou Project! A brief introduction to the universe in the free Prologue and an extensive in-game dictionary will keep newcomers from getting lost. Non-linear plot! You have access to many choices that can dramatically change the plot. Currently, you can play Prologue, the first three days of the Destitute Chapter and the first day of the Underworld Chapter. That's about 10-15 hours of reading. Journey through the vast world of Touhou Project! Visit the Former Hell, Netherworld, various parts of Gensokyo and even beyond! Over 50 characters from Touhou Project series! You will definitely find someone you'll like.
row.short_description: A visual novel based on Touhou Project, made by fans for fans and others! Embark on the investigation of the greatest incident in Gensokyo's history and discover the terrifying truth of the youkai world with Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi and other heroines!
row.notes: Some images in our game contain scenes of violence or murder.

row.name: Paragonian 3 : The Warrior of Light
row.detailed_description: Paragonian 3: The Warrior of Light is an ARPG that plays alone. Explore the Oriental World! Paragonian 3: Kwang, the light warrior is a 3D ARPG game. Eliminate enemies to raise levels and use a variety of weapons. Enjoy the story of the game and watch a variety of cinematic videos. Explore the oriental world and enjoy the game! Game Stroy A light warrior who succeeded in escaping from the Paragonian experiment. On his way back home, he meets Raizin, the god of thunder, and starts an inevitable battle. Gwang fights the battle between Laijin, but eventually falls off the cliff. While taking a walk, Hwangryong Village's chief finds Gwang who fainted under a cliff and rescues him. After waking up, Gwang realizes that he has lost his Inner Qi , and with the help of Hwangryongchon Village, he begins to recover. You have to play him and recover Inner Qi and solve Hwangryongchon's request. Cherish Life Once you've entered the game, you'll invest your time to recover your Inner Qi. Upgrade your equipment with the money you earned while restoring your Inner Qi and prepare thoroughly. If you get to the Main Story and die, the game will end, so you have to be fully prepared.
row.short_description: Paragonian 3: The Warrior of Light is an ARPG that plays alone. Explore the Oriental World! Gwang, who lost his mind in the fight against Laijin, the god of lightning, is rescued by the chief of the village. He will lose Inner Qi in the fight against Laijin and must regain his strength.

row.name: Vesalii Anatomy 3D Student
row.detailed_description: Vesalii Anatomy 3D Student The application allows users to view, explore, and interact with any system of the human body systems through an incredibly detailed 3D model. The application also enables viewing CT, MRI, and X-ray images in 3D. The aim of the application is to make an easily accessible way to study the human body and how it comes together. The body systems covered by this application include the skeletal system, muscular system, cardiovascular system, nervous system, lymphatic system, joints, endocrine system, digestive system, urinary system, respiratory system, reproductive system, and integumentary system. To develop the 3D model for this application, Vesalii consulted anatomists and doctors and even hired anatomy specialists to be part of its in-house team. This diligent work and determination for a medically accurate representation of the human body resulted in the high-quality 3D model that Vesalii offers to its users. Vesalii did not stop at that; it also worked on developing and implementing interactive tools in the application that make it easier and more time-efficient to work and explore the model. Additionally, detailed anatomical text information for each part in each system was developed and included to enhance understanding of human body structures. These tools allow users to isolate single or multiple structures, layers, or organs and compare them with other structures or view them from multiple angles to comprehensively understand the part and its relationship to nearby structures. Vesalii Anatomy 3D Student is comprehensive as it offers additional features and extensive medical content and a database that also cover: Radiology Histology The Free version of Vesalii functions as a demo, offering access to a limited set of features. Unlock the full potential of Vesalii by upgrading to the Pro version through a license purchase, granting you access to all features (check our website for a detailed comparison of the Free and Pro versions). With a valid license, you can enjoy the complete application experience on any supported platform and device. Simply log in to the application on any device using the email address and password associated with your Vesalii profile account to access all features seamlessly. Additionally, simultaneous logins on two separate devices or platforms are permitted. Systems Of The Body Twelve systems of the human body are available : skeletal System Comprehensive and impeccably detailed model of the human skeletal system. See and study the skeletal system as you have never before. muscular System Detailed execution of the muscular system accurately shows the origin and insertion of skeletal muscles to show how they are related to bones and how they act on joints or support the body. cardiovascular System Look deep into the immensely detailed cardiovascular system from the heart and major arteries and veins to the smallest capillaries throughout the human body. nervous System Easily look into and learn about one of the most complex systems of the human body: the nervous system. Trace nerve pathways from source to target to better understand how this intricate system works. lymphatic System Discover the lymphatic system with all its vessels and nodes in a fully constructed and accurate 3D model. joints System Learn all you need to know about the joints system and how it relates to other systems of the body, especially the skeletal and muscular systems. respiratory System View all the respiratory system components, including the lungs and their incredibly detailed bronchial tree. endocrine System Learn about the endocrine system and how its glands help keep the body functioning like clock-work. The model of the endocrine system includes all the glands and glandular cells of the endocrine system. digestive System View and learn using an accurate model of the digestive tract and the supporting digestive organs to gain a complete understanding of the human digestive system. urinary System Explore and find out more about the kidneys and other components of the urinary system of the human body, and learn about the important differences between male and female anatomy in this system. integumentary System See the skin and its appendages on the incredibly detailed model to learn all you could about the integumentary system. reproductive System Explore the reproductive system of both the male and female body in great detail. Application Tools Vesalii Anatomy 3D Student come with various innovative tools that make for a more user-friendly experience and facilitate the study of anatomy, radiology, and histology. discovery The discovery tool allows you to explore the layers of the body below the surface. You to select more than one system with this tool to look through each with ease. drawing The drawing tool is designed to allow you to draw lines directly on the 3D body parts of the model or on a board in the background, giving you more freedom to focus on the body parts you want or write down your notes. explode The explode tool breaks down certain parts to their primary components to give you a complete picture of how these parts come together to form a whole. fade The fade tool gives the selected part an almost transparent texture, allowing you to see where the part is and what lies beneath it all at the same time. hide The hide tool removes the selected part completely from the scene to allow you to discover what parts or layers lie underneath. manage Modules The manage modules tool is available with the modules plugin to give you better access and control over modules. It allows you to view all available modules and easily create and save new ones for use at any time. screenshot The screenshot tool allows you to capture a screenshot of the current scene and save it on your device to view or study at any time. isolate The isolate tool can be used to isolate a selected part or group. i.e., only the isolated part or group will be visible in the scene. This gives faster and more streamlined control over what you wish to observe in the scene and how you want to approach it. sticker The stickers tool enables you to pin notes on any body part you desire, allowing you to write personalized notes you can back to later and quickly pick up where you left off. transform tool The transform tool is used to rotate the model of the body on any of the three axes (X, Y, and Z) to allow you to view the model or any body part exactly from the angle you desire. heart play/stop The heart play\stop tool is an amazing way to add a more realistic aspect to the model. The tool can be used to play or stop the heartbeat with a realistic motion and the distinctive sound of a beating heart. select/reset/move With the select tool, you can choose any body part on the model and freely move it or rotate it to see it in the way you desire. You can then use the reset to return the part to its original position. duplicate The duplicate tool allows the user to create a duplicate copy of the selected body part to help compare it with others at the same time and in the same view. fade others The fade others tool enables the user to fade all the body parts visible in the scene except for the selected part or group, which allows for a better view of the selected part while still able to see its location in relation to neighboring parts. freeze The freeze tool allows the user to freeze a part or group, preventing any action from being taken on that part. The part or group must be unfrozen first for any action to be taken. freeze All The freeze all tool allows the user to freeze all parts appearing in the scene, preventing any action from being taken on the part. The parts must be unfreezed first for any action to be taken. part Label This tool is used to display labels that point to the part or group and show its name for easier reference. neighbor Parts The Neighbor Parts tool allows you to view the body parts that are adjacent to the part you selected. The parts appearing using this tool can be filtered by the body systems, so that neighboring parts of a certain system only appear. rotate The rotate tool is used to rotate the selected body part in any direction to help you easily see it from different angles. cut Multiple The Cut Multiple tool is used to cut several parts from all active systems and in any direction the user wants all in a single action, giving the user more control over how they want to see the model. cut Single The Cut Single tool allows the user to cut a single body part any way they choose to reveal what structures lie behind the cut part. Vesalii Plugins In addition to the numerous features of applications, Vesalii offers even more features that can be purchased according to your needs. tracing The tracing add-on enables you to trace the path of all available blood vessels from the heart to the parts they supply. You can also trace nerve pathways, both sensory and motor, from the brain or spinal cord to the part they innervate. histology The histology add-on gives you access to more than 1,500 histology images depicting real tissues that cover the entire body. This feature is a great addition to help have a better understanding of the relationship between gross anatomy and microanatomy. modules The modules add-on gives users access to more than 2,000 anatomical modules pre-created by Vesalii. These modules can be viewed and analyzed using the application tools at any time. In addition to these pre-created modules, you can also create your own modules and save them to the application so you can go back to them whenever you desire. radiology The radiology add-on provides you with over 4,000 medical images taken via several techniques, including CT scans, MRI, and X-ray. These medical images cover the entire body from all planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal). This is an invaluable addition to the application if you are looking to understand the relation between medical imaging and anatomy. application Features Vesalii Anatomy is laden with features that enrich and enhance the users’ experience to achieve even more benefits from using the application. help Center The Help Center offers the user many tutorial videos that help in learning how to use the application and all its tools, components, and features to make the most out of the application.
row.short_description: Vesalii Anatomy 3D Student offers a powerful and visually detailed 3D application for Android. The application allows users to view, explore, and interact with any system of the human body systems through an incredibly detailed 3D model.

row.name: Angels of Amsterdam
row.detailed_description: “Angels of Amsterdam” is a VR-experience which brings you to a truthful recreation of a 17th century café in Amsterdam. Here, you share key episodes in the lives of Maritgen Jans, Juliana, Elsje Christiaens and Pussy Sweet: four fierce angels who were not getting their fair share of the Golden Age’s gold and took their destiny in their own hands. The characters respond to eye-contact, and share their tales in the form of song, dance or musical performance. These stories show the dark side of the wealth and liberty which is generally associated with the port- and trading city of Amsterdam. The power relations between rich and poor, as well as between men and women in that young capitalist society also concerns us. Details from these stories now may seem odd, but the essence effortlessly transcends time frames. These stories have brought us to where we are now. Angels of Amsterdam is a critically acclaimed Immersive experience (VR), which had its world premiere at the 78th Venice Biennale. It is the first Dutch VR-work ever to be selected for the official competition. The work has received praise for bringing together historical storytelling and groundbreaking VR-innovation in an unprecedented way. The work was created by Avinash Changa, VR maker and director of WeMakeVR, and Anna Abrahams, filmmaker and VR programmer for EYE Film Museum in Amsterdam.
row.short_description: Angels of Amsterdam; a truthful recreation of a 17th century Amsterdam-café, where you share key episodes in the lives of Maritgen Jans, Juliana, Elsje Christiaens and Pussy Sweet: four fierce angels who were not getting their fair share of the Golden Age’s gold and took destiny in their own hands.
row.reviews: “one of the most stunningly realistic historical recreation stories in VR to date” Scatter “You can almost smell the ripe plums that are laid out on the 17th-century bar, almost feel the sea breeze brushing through your hair. The virtual reality experience Angels of Amsterdam is so lifelike, that all your senses are involved.” Dutch Culture
row.notes: Angels contains one moment with a very brief moment of female nudity, comparable to nudity in classical paintings. This moment is required to emphasise the theme of female/male inequality in that specific scene. Visually the moment has been styled in a responsible, tasteful manner, supporting the artistic context of the work.

row.name: 2tinycowboys
row.detailed_description: Jump, run, shoot and dodge your way through huge multi-directional levels, while avoiding a wide variety of enemies. Take advantage of the vultures and fly to the top, all the while searching for the gold-bars, required to win. Utilize power-ups and the strengths of your chosen character to search every nook and cranny Enter almost any building and make sure to visit the barbershop and try out any of the eight different hairstyles available for each character, in this retro-flavored platformer for 1-4 players. The Protagonists: Clint : Does not get bitten by snakes. Esmaralda : Does not get bitten by spiders. Felipe : Has a short-sword, rather than a knife (Longer stab-range). /not able to change appearance at Barbershop Ma’ Belle : Able to take two arrows, before dying. Mercedes : Gets 2 jump-boots, rather than one, on pickup. Rose : Jumps higher than everyone else. Santiago : Fires faster than the others. Zeke : Has penetrating bullets that will go straight through his foes. Zorra : Double jump and faster than the rest. /not able to change appearance at Barbershop Ndyan (playable character): More info coming soon. The Enemies: Ndyan – Bow : If quick enough, you can shoot his arrows. Ndyan – Spear : This guy takes 2 bullets before going down. Long reach in melee, but no ranged weapons. Ndyan – Tomahawk : Keep track of his bounce and beware, it will take you 4 bullets to kill him. Sherif & Sherif Twin : Fast draw, quick-shooter. Careful with shooting their bullets. The sherif and his Twin will take 3 shots each to kill. Killing one will resurrect the other. Robot : Made of indestructible material and fires lasers. Bullets will ricochet right off of these guys; Your best bet is to jump over him. Zombies : These undead cowboys can take 5 bullets before going down, becoming slower by each hit. Stabbing will instantly kill them, however. Snakes : Sometimes easy to spot, sometimes hidden in the undergrowth. Their venomous bite will poison the player, giving them one minute to find a anti-venom. Spiders & Bats : These will stun the player for a few seconds. If however the player has been bitten by a snake previous, then they will be instantly killed. Ooze : This will make you unable to stop jumping for 30 seconds. Tentacle : These will slow you down, while decreasing your jump for 30 seconds. Boulders : On certain levels there are boulders coming down from the mountains above. You shoot these to slow them down and eventually destroy them, or try to jump them, else instant death. Vultures : These will carry off with you, enemies as well as goldbars. The Cavalry: Ollie : A bit slow, but fires scattering bullets. Otis : Slow reload, but far reaching bullets. Curtis : Fires his pistol at a rapid rate. Sarge : Boosts morale of the others. (Hard) Pete the Trumpeter : As long as Pete is alive, whenever there are less than 50% of Cavalry remaining, they will respawn. (Hard) The Guns : Pistol : Medium range, medium speed, fist-sized bullets. Ammo capacity = 6 Shotgun : Short range, slow speed, fires in five different angles in front of the shooter, thus making it ideal for taking down enemies on ledges in front of you. Fires pellets, rather than bullets. Able to destroy rolling boulders. Ammo capacity = 5 Rifle : Long range, fast speed, fires a half fist-sized bullet, penetrating any and all enemies (except for Zombies, which are spongy by nature), killing them instantly. Also able to shoot destroy rolling boulders. Ammo capacity = 3 The Loot: Goldbars : These are what you want. Grab enough to win. Hats : Extra lives. Boots : Double-jump. Anti-venom : Negates snake-bite. Ammo : More ammunition for your gun. The different difficulty levels alter the game in the following ways: Easy : No boulders, robots, sherifs, tentacles or zombies. Vultures don’t pick up Tomahawk Ndyan, Goldbars or Snakes & Spiders. 7 Goldbars required to win. Medium : No robots, no tentacles or boulders. Vultures don’t pick up Tomahawk Ndyan or Snakes. 10 Goldbars required to win. Hard : Your default game-mode, 2tinycowboys as it was intended. Challenging, but fun; Especially in multiplayer. But do feel free to pick any level of challenge to get acquainted with the game, before advancing to this. 2tinycowboys is about having fun, for everyone. 12 Goldbars required to win. Gamepad Controls are : D-Pad Right = move right D-Pad Left = move left D-Pad Up = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave/Interact with NPCs D-Pad Down = climb down (ladders/vines) A = jump B = stab X = shoot Y = special Keyboard Controls are: Player 1: Left Arrowkey = move left Right Arrowkey = move right Up Arrowkey = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave Down Arrowkey = climb down (ladders/vines) SPACE = jump M = stab CTRL = shoot N = special Player 2: D = move right A = move left W = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave S = climb down (ladders/vines) V = jump Z = stab C = shoot X = special Player 3: L = move right J = move left I = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave K = climb down (ladders/vines) O = jump ENTER = stab P = shoot Backspace = special Player 4: Numpad 6 = move right Numpad 4 = move left Numpad 8 = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave Numpad 2 = climb down (ladders/vines) Numpad + = jump Numpad 5 = stab Numpad - = shoot Numpad * = special
row.short_description: 2tinycowboys is an action-packed western-themed arcade multi-scrolling platformer in 2D, with huge variety, in which you take the role of one of 9 different cowboys, each with his/her own play-style. It has up to 4 players split-screen multiplayer available and quirky game-play and characters.

row.name: Stillwater
row.detailed_description: '𝕊𝕖𝕖𝕚𝕟𝕘 𝕤𝕥𝕣𝕒𝕟𝕘𝕖 𝕥𝕙𝕚𝕟𝕘𝕤 𝕔𝕠𝕞𝕖 𝕒𝕥 𝕒 𝕡𝕣𝕚𝕔𝕖…' A woman arrives with a mysterious letter in hand addressed to her grandfather. Etched in crimson is a foreboding message, a warning—a promise made from a time forgotten. Private Investigator Hugo Laurent and his assistants must solve this bizarre case before an old family's curse befalls them all. Story, Original Concept | anri Sprite, CG, UI | ota BG, CG | sasa Code, BG | z04 13,004 words + ~1hr playtime 4 endings + 1 ending epilogue Point & click exploration Updated animations, story, gallery, and author notes! Pet Colby! Warnings: shaking screen, abrupt sounds, minor jump scares, mentions of suicide { 𝙰𝚍𝚍𝚒𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗𝚊𝚕 𝙰𝚜𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚜 } Music | Presence of Music , H/MIX GALLERY SFX | Zapsplat Original GameJam Beta Testers | Heiden, sky, Zach Reyes, KyewT_T, auin Stillwater Remastered Beta Testers | Wing, Medrelo7, HardBoiledEgg98, KyewT_T, Sky 1. Will This Be Released On Steam & Itchio? Yes. 2. Will this be released for Windows, Mac, Linux, and Android? Yes. 3. What will happen to the old game jam build? (steam specific question) The game jam build will be obselete. Steam and Itch.io will be updated to Stillwater Remastered. While we are honored you enjoyed the original game jam version, we believe Stillwater Remastered is the polished vision of the work we couldn’t finish during the game jam. We hope you enjoy it! 4. Can I load up old saves from the game jam version of Stillwater? No, Stillwater Remastered can not load up previous saves from the game jam version. 5. Will there be a Stillwater sequel? It is a future project we would like to make, but realistically, we would need time and funds to tackle this endeavor. Hopefully soon.
row.short_description: A short visual novel where a private investigator gets reeled into a murky mystery, entangled in lies, secrets, and a family curse.

row.name: Picma - Picture Enigmas
row.detailed_description: Use your logic skills to uncover hidden pictures. With a library of over 100,000 community-created puzzles , distributed across multiple puzzle types , you are unlikely to run out of challenges. So, have a seat at the Moonberry Café, let Charlotte bring you a cup of your favorite drink, and relax as you sip and solve through Picma - Picture Enigmas. Main Features Much more than Nonograms - Find your favorite picture logic game from our selection of three puzzle types (more coming soon). True logic puzzles - All of our puzzles are machine-verified to have a single logical solution. Massive puzzles - Our puzzles range from the tiny 5x5 all the way to the gigantic 50x50. True multi-color puzzles - What you solve is what you get, with up to 8 colors per puzzle. Play for free daily - Create and rate images to earn Coins and play at no cost. Picma Plus (1/3) Use the numbers around the grid to discover a hidden picture! Picma Squared (2/3) Paint around each number to form a picture! Picma Links (3/3) Create paths between matching numbers to reveal a picture!
row.short_description: Picma is a cozy collection of puzzle games where you use your logic skills to reveal hidden pictures. It features more than 100,000 puzzles, created and curated since 2009 by our lovely puzzler community.

row.name: ParkTo
row.detailed_description: ParkTo is a simple puzzle game that stops the car at its destination. You don't drive a car yourself. The car just moves forward'. Use the given triggers to move the car to its destination: LEFT, RIGHT, STOP, BACKWARD, etc. Triggers can be placed on the path of the car or used on the car itself. FEATURES 48 handcrafted levels. Various trigger interactions reflecting car movements. Comfortable colors and minimal graphics. You can play without a driving license!
row.short_description: ParkTo is a simple puzzle game that stops the car at its destination. You don't drive a car yourself. The car just moves forward. Use the given triggers to move the car to its destination.

row.name: ENA: Dream BBQ
row.detailed_description: Supporter Edition The Supporter Edition of ENA: Dream BBQ includes bonus behind-the-scenes content on how the game was made! As well as additional goodies such as: Hidden Hourglass Dog Collectables Animatics and Concept Art Pre-Production Animations In-Development Screenshots Developer Commentary Downloadable Gifs and Wallpapers About the Game 'ENA! We've got work to do, so quit daydreaming and pay attention! And don't you DARE get involved in any predicaments along the way... got it?!!' The first interactive adventure of the ENA series by Joel G. Play as ENA as she searches for the Boss that everyone wants to be. Explore strange worlds, take on side gigs, and meet both sweet and sour characters along the journey. There is a lot to encounter on your adventures: Explore new environments filled with hidden secrets and oddities. Meet different characters who only want you to do things for them. Use strange Tools to solve unusual problems. Live the experience of being the least popular person at any party. Experience Chapter 1 'Lonely Door' now! Subsequent chapters are in development and will be available as a paid release. Disclaimers: This game contains sections with flashing lights and images that may induce seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. This game contains visuals and language that some individuals may find disturbing. Viewer discretion is advised.
row.short_description: Experience surreal environments and inexplicable characters as ENA in a new wild world.

row.name: 牌师
row.detailed_description: 牌师是一款在经典玩法上加以创新的rougelike战斗卡牌类游戏。你可以控制三位各怀绝技的牌师，在一座连接着7个异世界的魔塔里探险。你遇到的每个怪兽都可以被抓捕并提炼成拥有各种效果的卡牌。你需要尽可能多地收集、强化卡牌，打造属于自己的无敌卡组，提高在塔内的存活率，最终揭开魔塔的秘密。 我们与众不同的地方： 1、在玩卡牌游戏的时候因为费不够手里的卡打不出去是不是很难受？牌师没有费的设定，创新的游戏机制使得所有卡牌只要在手里，都可以打出！ 2、怕白辛苦一场?辛苦打造的爽快卡组在一场游戏结束后全部消失，内心痛苦无比？牌师不会让你体会到这种痛苦。即使在塔里意外死亡，所有卡牌和强化效果都会被保存下来带入下一次探险，让你尽享满级杀入新手村的爽感。 3、缝合怪？在游玩牌师的时候，你可以体会到rougelike卡牌游戏的乐趣；用怪兽球抓捕怪兽的乐趣；绝（优）境（势）中抽取命运卡瞬（原）间（地）翻（爆）盘（炸）的快（憋）感（屈）；大起大落的炒股乐趣；绞尽脑汁打造无敌套路的乐趣等等。 4、比较浮躁没有耐心？这个还真的没办法TT。牌师没有令人作呕的强制引导教程，所有游戏机制都靠你自己慢慢摸索。
row.short_description: 打牌，抓怪，强化，轻松娱乐爬塔探索

row.name: 战争冒险 序章
row.detailed_description: 添加至愿望单 About the Game 在90年代的东欧国家，由于艾斯佩罗族和伊多诺族之间的矛盾，进而引发了双方的战争。玩家将扮演故事的主人公艾斯佩罗族的少女——弗洛拉，穿越战火过后的断壁残垣，结识抱持着不同想法理念的人们，在残酷的战争中竭尽全力生存下去，并揭开隐藏在战争背后的真相。 战争总是残酷 无情战火打破了东欧小镇的宁静，原本繁华的城镇转瞬间成为惨绝人寰的炼狱，面对敌军持续不断的袭击，幸存者们只能够勉力求生。在巨大的生存压力下，每个人的追求、理念甚至信仰都经受着严峻的考验。而主角的冒险故事正是在这样的背景之下展开。 性格丰富的角色 游戏中玩家将结识许多性格迥异的人物，在这混乱的战争时代，每个人都抱持着不同的立场、信仰及政治观点。与每个人深入交流，这场战争的前因后果，分辨每个人的行为动机，对他人的政治见解表态，影响他人对你的看法，并从中发掘出深藏在战争背后的真相。 穿越炮火艰难求生 探索小镇的每个角落，时刻警惕从天而降的炮弹。保护自己的家人朋友，为有需要的弱者伸出援手，面对强权也毫不畏惧。在时代、信仰、恩仇、人性的艰险抉择之中，你将时常置身两难境地，你将如何做出选择。
row.short_description: 在90年代的东欧国家，由于艾斯佩罗族和伊多诺族之间的矛盾，进而引发了双方的战争。玩家将扮演故事的主人公艾斯佩罗族的少女——弗洛拉，穿越战火过后的断壁残垣，结识抱持着不同想法理念的人们，在残酷的战争中竭尽全力生存下去，并揭开隐藏在战争背后的真相。

row.name: Spirits' Creek
row.detailed_description: January 1988, in a secluded place in the heart of Chic-Choc Mountains, Quebec. An avalanche tears apart the luxurious ski lodge known as Spirits’ Creek. The place is isolated from the world, prisoner of a storm with seemingly no end in sight. Émile Arsenault, the owner-founder, attempts to find his daughter who vanished during the events – but the hotel is riddled with monstrous creatures and inexplicable events. Do you have what it takes to fight through the night and save your daughter? Spirits’ Creek is a third-person survival-horror experience crafted by students in 15 weeks at the Campus ADN, a public videogame school in downtown Montreal. Explore a luxurious hotel filled with mysteries and unveil the Arsenault family’s secrets Fight frightening creatures and a ruthless, blood-thirsty Beast Discover new tools to increase your chances of surviving and explore the haunted dwelling
row.short_description: Spirits’ Creek is a third-person horror adventure where, following an avalanche, you play as a father looking for his daughter. Battle supernatural creatures, tame the elements and solve the mystery surrounding the events in order to survive the night.
row.notes: - Blood and gore-free violence during fights - Psychological horror elements - Decor elements with blood stains - Skeletons used as decor elements - Depiction of cognitive disorder (main character)

row.name: Shape Of The Toilet Rim
row.detailed_description: In this game, using the WASD keys, you can control a cube and make it slide around in all directions. You can press the spacebar to jump. The gameplay in this game features the riveting experience of jumping on top of moving toilet car enemies over and over again until you inevitably get hit by one of the enemies and die. You can then retry and try to beat your high score. A single cube fights for his life. He is stuck in an endless looping purgatory, fighting every second of every day in vain to attempt to vanquish the Shape Of The Toilet Rim. How far can you get him before your will, too, gives out? This game features: - Decently Responsive Controls - Easy to learn mechanics such as jumping on toilet cars to make them explode. - Decent Graphics - Questionable Music and SFX - A relatively easy to understand menu and UI - The game is endless! You can keep retrying to raise your score! - A story (sort of) that is completely disregardable and is not directly mentioned in the game itself - Challenge yourself to get a score above 100! - Don't worry, if you die you can always press enter to block AleeXhey and try again! Not only is this game a work in progress, but it was also mostly made as a joke and isn't meant to be taken too seriously. Thanks for playing though!
row.short_description: A single player arcade-like game where you crush Toilet Cars driven by small suns. See how high of a score you can get!
row.reviews: “This game is a real life changer. Honestly, this has changed my life in ways I could never imagine. people used to hate me. They still hate me, but this game has made me realize what the true meaning of gaming is. It is truly the heart of gaming in society today. Honestly, I would show this game to the president of barack obama. and without my eyes i cannot see this game any farther than i wanted to anyways. but. in other words, this game is among us, but like not among us thanos gauntlet. This game has very good graphics. I can run my rtx 1 on it without any frames being lost. i mean i'll lose like 25 frames every .5 seconds, but other than that the gameplay is really great. poo poo kaka in pee pee kaka land.” 1,000,000,000,000/10, download this game immediately – Mike Hawk “This game truly opens your eyes, and shows you the world its taking you to, it takes you there, it takes you there, and my god does it you there. This game is a masterpiece, and it truly opens your eyes to a new perspective you've never seen before.” 9/10 for being able to block AleeXheY – IceboxOG “life changing story, and absolutely stunning visuals.” 1.61803398875/10 – emerald

row.name: Operation Satoshi [Early Version Alpha]
row.detailed_description: This is a game in development. It has been published just to get feedback from community. We are fully aware there will be defects. You can give feedback to: contact@metaxseed.io Featuring characters from Paragon (Epic Games), a single player free to play demo FPS in a sci-fi and set in an alternate universe. The objective is to rescue the famous Satoshi Nakamoto who had been mysteriously kidnapped many moons ago. You are part of a elite unit that is tasked with a search and rescue mission. Travel across multiple regions to find clues and collect rewards along the way. Use these rewards to update your weapons, ammunitions and characters skill set. Fun and addictive sure to keep you playing for hours. First version of this free game with start with a couple of levels and the developers will keep updating based on community feedback. There are two in game tokens called MXS and SAT that is used to accumulate points to purchase bullets and lives in the marketplace.
row.short_description: This is a game in development. It has been published just to get feedback from community. We are aware there will be defects and will do weekly updates. Feedback can be sent to contact@metaxseed.io. A shooting RPG game to rescue a kidnapped scientist, Nakamoto Satoshi.

row.name: 拾光物语 Border Town Playtest
Connected through fate

We have managed to publish our game in English via machine translation ! Bugs in Seiichi's route have also been fixed. Connected through fate tells the story of our heroine, who is about to move with her mother to a new city. At her new school, she gets acquainted with the three strange Ichigawa brothers. The three brothers could not be more different, and so their first day is already extremely turbulent. But it's not just these strange encounters that will soon turn her entire life upside down!
