row.name: 500 Second Challenge
row.detailed_description: The five hundred second challenge: In this game you will control a character in order not to let him have zero health, or fall to his death. Jumping is possible at the beginning of the easy version, but not the normal version. During the game, you can increase the experience value by stepping on the ladder or eating stars. Leveling up with experience points will give you three random skills, but you can only choose one. Each skill contributes to the development of the game as the ladder gets faster and narrower. You can use the z.x.c keys on the keyboard to quickly select skills, The simple version increases the luck value, the number of consecutive jumps, the maximum life, the life-saving floor seconds, but the score is reduced. feature: - Faster and faster game speed - Fun and light music - Use of random skills - Get high scores for your skills
row.short_description: As the ladder gets faster and narrower, can you increase your living space through the upgrade system? Last for 500 seconds, and your gameplay will be different from everyone else's depending on how your skills level up.

row.name: Soul Searching
row.detailed_description: Your soul has been captured by an evil necromancer determined to take over the lands! Can you escape his perilous dungeon home to warn the kingdom before the undead rise again? Solve various puzzles through each floor of the necromancer's dungeon to ascend through the necromancer's home back to the surface. But you are not alone in the dungeon's chambers, as his undead minions and fellow lost souls also occupy the many floors. Sneak past his servants and rescue your fellow spirit to save the kingdom before it's too late!
row.short_description: In this puzzle stealth game, your soul has been captured by an evil necromancer determined to take over the lands! Can you escape his perilous dungeon home to warn the kingdom before the undead rise and take over the throne?

row.name: Ami's Room
row.detailed_description: A boy named Pierre refuses to leave his room. He sleeps to access dreams where his sister, Ami, escaped to after a traumatic event. Pierre believes that if he locates Ami by a slim chance, he’ll be able to convince her to wake up with him. ♢♢♢♢♢ An exploration game set in a surreal dreamscape full of projections. Piece together past recollections and elusive memories to find the story. Make a choice as the line between the real and the dreamed world begins to blur. The key lies in your hands… but would you choose to wake up? Features Go to sleep to start the game. Transverse between different dreams. Solve puzzles to obtain answers. Talk to those inhabiting the dreamworld. Avoid monsters who try to keep you asleep. When the time comes, remember. ...or forget? Controls Arrow keys — Movement Enter or Space bar — Interact Save — Interact with Save points Shift or F5 — Return to Title screen F4 — Toggle Fullscreen/Window modes F3 — Change display size This game contains depictions and/or descriptions of depression and anxiety. It may not be suitable for all audiences and viewer discretion is advised.
row.short_description: An exploration game set in a surreal dreamscape full of projections. Piece together past recollections and elusive memories. Make a choice as the reality and dreamed world begins to blur...

row.name: Cycle of The Moon
row.detailed_description: In Cycle of The Moon, you fight your way through a map, trying to get to the boss and defeat him. However, you have to be careful, for the thirst of a vampire is constant. Features : Thirst During the game your character has a constant Health Loss effect, refill your health by killing any Npc. Souls Any Npc that can die has a chance of dropping their Soul. These effects can range from Increasing your max HP, Stamina, Decreasing the amount of hp you lose over time from thirst, or even a new Attack! New attacks Unlock new attacks by either the enemy dropping a soul that unlocks a triple attack, which is a triple swing that needs to be timed. Or by finding the other one out in the world! Humans There's a village with humans, which heal you for more than normal enemies would, however killing them also has a chance of spawning soldiers that will hunt you down The boss The goal. Reach the boss at the end, gather enough souls to become powerful enough, and beat the Harbinger of the Moon! This Project was made by 3 students in about 45 days To use a controller you might have to enable the support for your controller in the steam setting under controller tab, and then go under the general controller setting and enable the support for your specific controller. If that doesn't work we recommend DS4Windows
row.short_description: Soule-Like, Roguelike where you fight your way through a map, collecting souls to beat the boss

row.name: Super Ball Arena
row.detailed_description: Multiplayer ‘couch game’ that can be played up to 4 players, gamepads are required to play locally. The primary purpose is to defeat others by hitting a ball so that it collides with the target, inflicting damage in the process. Each player has the ability to attack, dash and block, some actions require energy to be used. The attack can be held to increase its power, but there is also the possibility of using energy tokens to reach the full charge instantly. When played with the joystick, the left stick is used for movement and the right stick is used for aiming. There are also several special interactions to spice things up. For example, blocking a ball only reduces the damage, but doing it with a perfect timing will catch the ball and restore the energy token to the receiver. This project is still early in development and I am currently working on: -Online multiplayer (Photon PUN) -Several power-ups that players can use. -New game modes
row.short_description: Multiplayer ‘couch game’ that can be played up to 4 players. The primary purpose is to defeat others by hitting a ball so that it collides with the target, inflicting damage in the process.

row.name: Jam Above Jam Below
row.detailed_description: Join Witz and Doobz on their adventure to make a video game in just a week! With seven different mini-games, you'll have plenty of fun as you try to win the game jam and save the day! You'll jump, run, bike, puzzle, and even date your way to success, as fully-voiced cartoon cutscenes bring the fast-paced story to life. Primarily an action platformer with some puzzle, rhythm, and dating sim elements, the total expected playtime is about 20 to 30 minutes. This game is made for all ages! Truly a jam within a jam, this game was made in a week by me, Kimberly Blais of Mama Makes Games, for the 2022 Epic MegaJam using Unreal Engine 5. Following the theme of 'As Above, So Below,' this recursive game about making a game playfully explores the joys and challenges of doing a game jam.
row.short_description: Witz and Doobz on their adventure to make a video game through seven different mini-games and funny cartoon cutscenes!

row.name: Touhou - Reimus Awesome Holiday
row.detailed_description: Gameplay: Reimus Awesome Holiday is a turn based RPG Game that will provide the Player with numerous decisions, in which the fate of multiple individuals is at stake in one way or another... or those decisions could lead you to find something strange and otherworldly, who knows? In other words, your choices matter! Of course the standard RPG experience of finding Items in the Overworld, battling Enemies and numerous Sidequests is also included. Features: The Game has an ATB (Action Time Battle) mechanic, where in a meter fills up over time for each participant in a Battle and you are able to control the flow of that Battle with various actions inside the Game, such as increasing the speed in which the meter fills by pressing down the Shift key on your Keyboard. Another Key action is the Guard mechanic. The Guard mechanic allows for reduced damage whenever that Action is selected, even while someone else performs an Action in the meantime. This allows for reactionary damage control and better strategy. Other minor mechanics include: -Hotkeys for the 3 primary Actions in Game (Skills, Guard, Items) which are S (for Skills), D (for Guard) and W (for Items) respectively. -Holding down the A -Key before entering a Cutscene will skip it entirely. (!Does not work during the Cutscene! A -Key must be pressed down before entering!) -Fullscreen can be enabled by simply pressing F5 -Screenratio (1x, 2x, 4x) can be changed with F6. -A Gameshow where you win real (ingame) money! -An Auction where you can spend your real (ingame) money to buy rare Items! -Tired of grinding? With just 5k real (ingame) moneybux, you can just train with Yuugi and get your character to lv30! And more... Also this game has at least 25 endings. I hope you enjoy!
row.short_description: Its Reimus Day off. But her day is ruined by an unknown force in Gensokyo! Play as Reimu to find out what this mysterious group is about and uncover their secret!

row.name: Forbidden Escape
row.detailed_description: This game requires a controller. We are in the middle of the ocean. Forbidden Escape is a 3rd person puzzle-solving and combat game that mixes supernatural clashes and platforming, on a tanker kept secret from the rest of the world, where scientists experiment on child guinea pigs to harness the supernatural effects of an artifact found at the bottom of the sea.  After nearly a decade of research, something goes wrong and the artifact explodes, spreading an encroaching corruption throughout the entire ship and infecting all of its passengers. You play as Riley, a young guinea pig who seems to be the only one to have survived the infection. Escape the tanker and discover the new powers that lie dormant within you. Explore the various levels of Exodus in linear levels and follow Riley's interesting encounter with Inspeca, the Alien Artifact, as she attempts to escape the only home she has ever known. Characteristics Embark on this supernatural adventure - escape from a secret ship, sinking in the middle of the ocean, while fending off any danger that crosses your path. Platforming - test your agility through perilous paths that will put your skills to the test. Puzzle solving - exercise your brain with challenging and interesting puzzles that force you to use all the resources at your disposal. Brutal Combat - unlock new supernatural abilities to aid you in battles against humans now transformed by the corruption of the artifact. Atmosphere and touching narration - the loneliness seems heavy in this sinking ship as the artifact quietly takes possession of what was once your only home. Find your changed friends and try to free them from this unprecedented infection. This original product was entirely developed by nearly thirty students of the 2021-2022 cohort of the Campus ADN, a public videogame school in downtown Montreal, as part of a 15-week end-of-study production project under the supervision of around ten industry professionals.
row.short_description: Escape the Exodus, a ship attacked by an encroaching corruption, and embark on a supernatural adventure to explore the various levels of the vessel. Try to survive against dangers and find the solution to challenging puzzles.
row.notes: This game talks about young children being abused by scientists. The player will be fighting against teenagers and blood will be visible throughout the game.

row.name: Memory's Abyss (Chapter Zero)

row.name: Wayward Rose

Armed with only her wits and determination, she must navigate through treacherous terrain and evade the wolves and phantoms that haunt her every move. row.name: Flax Engine - Tech Demo 2022

New real-time Global Illumination rendering effect using DDGI algorithm simulates how the indirect light bounces through the world. This can be used in games and visualization products such as Arch Vis projects. Use the input Controls list to learn how to control the light direction and toggle custom options such as lights, GI, FPS counter, or dynamically simulated ball physics. Visit Flax Engine Website to learn more.

row.name: FRAIM - Survival Rhythm Aim Trainer
row.detailed_description: What's FRAIM? FRAIM is a super fun and addicting survival rhythm aim trainer focused mostly on micro-adjustment shots, which are the most important type of shots in a highly competitive first person shooters. Why is it designed that way? The game is played in between two frames. Targets spawn in the back frame and disappear once they get inside the front frame, which creates a sense of hurry. This fact is very important for aim training, as although you try your best to aim as fast as possible in other trainers, you generally won't force yourself to take shots which you don't feel confident in and are crucial for your development. In FRAIM you are forced to challenge yourself for your survival by design . Challenge by design Each track comes in five different difficulties to make sure that you can properly challenge yourself. But what if I'm stuck in between difficulties? You can easily override levels in the game. For instance, if you find that it gets easier to pass 'Hard' levels, but too hard to pass 'Expert' levels, you can choose to play the game as hard but override the targets to be smaller, play it as expert and increase the target size, increase/decrease the frame's surface, and much more. Playing in override mode would not affect your scores, they are simply training wheels to help you get to the next difficulty. Make it feel like your preferred game In the settings menu you can change your game profile. By doing so, you make sure that the FOV and the sensitivity feels exactly like they do in the selected game. Make it yours You can easily design your crosshair through the settings menu
row.short_description: Fraim is a fun survival rhythm aim trainer that makes you improve faster by challenging you to your fullest with difficulties and level overrides. Miss too many targets and it's game over! Focused mostly on fast small adjustment shots which are highly relevant to high-skilled FPS.

row.name: Mutants: Genesis
row.detailed_description: Mutants: Genesis: Unleash your mutants in the arena. The GCC where maps come to life Immerse yourself in Mutants: Genesis , an explosive online card game where every card comes to life in a vibrant cyberpunk universe. Fast-paced combat, spectacular visuals and high-level strategy: Mutants: Genesis brings card games to life! 🎴 Animated cards for intense battles Each ardc is animated, offering an immersive visual experience inspired by 90s comic books. The battles are fast-paced and visually impressive, turning each duel into a real show. 🧬 Build your deck with unique Mutants Collect over 200 cards spread across 6 distinct genes. Create synergies between Mutants, Support Cards and Buildings to devise winning strategies. 🤝 Cooperate to defeat legendary Bosses Take part in cooperative battles for up to 3 players against powerful Bosses. Complete weekly Time Rifts challenges for exclusive rewards. 🏆  Compete against other players and climb the rankings Engage in competitive PvP duels and progress from Bronze to Champion in dynamic seasons! Adapt your decks with regular balancing updates to stay on top. 🎁 Progress and unlock new cards Earn cards and resources by playing PvP, PvE and completing daily, weekly and monthly challenges! Use these resources to craft new cards and improve your decks. 🌌 A rich and mysterious universe to explore Play as the latest prodigy at an orphanage training future Psycogs, tacticians capable of controlling Mutants. Discover the secrets that lurk in the shadows of this institution and forge your legend in tournaments around the world!Mutants: Genesis takes you through two story arcs that explore the game's universe!

Join the next generation of Psycogs and climb the ranks to establish yourself as Champion! Collect hundreds of mutants, fashion your own deck, cooperate with or fight other players!

row.name: Crypt
row.detailed_description: If you've found this game by chance through Steam, I advise you not to play it. My name is Valefisk, and I'm a YouTuber. I made this game as a joke - it's not designed to be fun, but to be awful to play. And in this it succeeds. This version that has found its way to Steam is slightly different from the one in the original video. This one is beatable. Personally I think the way this game is best played is with you making someone else play it with no context as to what the game contains. It presents itself (successfully) as a real indie game until you really start to play it, so feel free to torture your friends with this abomination of an experience. Enter the Crypt. Retrieve the Essence and Make your Escape. The objective is - on the surface - simple. Steal the jar from the Crypt and then make your escape. The idea is easy, but finding all the keys wont be. Solve the Puzzles. Can you actually solve the puzzles necessary to access the keys to escape? Sure you can. Does the game include any actual helpful information as to how to solve them? Of course not. Trust your instincts, and not your eyes. Survive Him. You are not alone down within the Crypt. Someone or something is there with you - and it's never too far behind you. Escape! Once you've gotten all the keys, you can finally open the door to Escape...assuming you've done everything right. I mean, I put an achievement in for winning so it's definitely possible - perhaps you've simply missed a nasty prerequisite... Good luck. You're gonna need it.
row.short_description: This is not a video game. This is a psychological torture device. Do not attempt to play this game. You won't have an enjoyable experience. And that's intentional.

Play as 9 characters, 8 of which are based off of REAL PEOPLE on Twitch, and do your best to avoid the Missionaries and Bosses all while picking up illicit items to boost your score AND your speed across 3 completely designed and honed levels! Reach new heights and unlock any of the NEW 25 Achievements and keep track of your records! row.name: Integument
row.detailed_description: It's not a game This is an interactive sci-fi illustration of a microscope interface. In this 'living illustration,' you'll find patterns and shapes that reveal information about the unique lifeforms that live on the surface of your skin, also known as, integument. A new branch in the tree of life Forced quantum hall dating, indicates they belong to an incredibly ancient kingdom that first appeared on Earth 4.4 billion years ago. These, hada could be the bridge between single cell to what eventually became multicellular organisms like us; humans. User ID: mematron Personal log abstract Raw microscope data is collected and pre-processed in the lower level systems (engine) before being sent to the top level display (hood) or stored in a database for further processing and later retrieval.

row.name: Once Human
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord! About the Game Survive in the wilderness You wake up in the middle of nowhere. You'll have to brace yourself for the cruelty of nature (from monsters to lack of food); however, Stardust's influence does not restrict to living things, it also affects the soil and water. Eating polluted food and drinking dirty water will reduce your Sanity. When your Sanity drops, your max HP would drop accordingly. To eat or not to eat, it's a question. Fight against monsters Battle numerous enemies that are once human, and challenge bosses from another dimension to gain powerful items and ease Stardust pollution. You are not only fighting for yourself, but also fighting for the survivors. Customize weapons With about 100 gun blueprints divided into seven categories for you to collect and craft, every loot grants you something new. Did I mention accessories and gun perks? Right, they are the heroes here. If our current weapon cannot satisfy your need, you can add different parts and perks, upgrade your firearm to your heart's content. Build territory Use Territory Core to build a house of your own. You can keep a practical style, jamming everything needed in a small room; or you can design a townhouse with a patio, kitchen, garage… The best part is, you can relocate your territory any time you want! Find out the truth Delve into the truth of Stardust, find out where it came from, and what it wants. In the journey of seeking truth, you may feel alone, but you are never alone. There are several factions in the world, some can be violent and hostile, others might be friendly and helpful. Explore human settlements to learn their stories or exterminate bosses without leaving a name for survivors to praise, the choices are yours.
row.short_description: Once Human is a multiplayer open-world survival game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world.

row.name: Japanese Cultural Property VR Museum
row.detailed_description: In Japanese Cultural Property VR Museum, you can “hold” various cultural assets from across Japan and view them up close at your own leisure. Cultural assets are modelled in ultra-high definition 3D using photogrammetric technology. In real life, these assets cannot be touched and can only viewed in situ, but in this virtual museum you can 'hold' them in your hands and freely view them from all kinds of angles. You can hold them right in front of your eyes and even see them from the inside! You can also make use of a flashlight, a magnifying glass and a cross-section viewer to observe the objects in ways that are impossible in the real world. There are currently five areas available, each exhibiting precious cultural assets that you can “touch”. Iwabitsu Sanada Ninja Museum 'Ninpaku' Area – exhibits ninja tools such as shurikens. Yamanashi Prefectural Museum of Archaeology Area – exhibits Jomon earthenware. Hida Miyagawa Archaeology and Folklore Museum Area – exhibits mainly stone relics. Karako-Kagi Room: Exhibition of earthenware and magatama from the Yayoi period Mongol Fleet Area – exhibits Mongol ships. Folding Screen Area – exhibits folding screen paintings. Tohoku History Museum Area – exhibits earthenware, wooden tablets, roof tiles and other artifacts Some areas also have fun features in them. More areas will be added in the future.
row.short_description: In Japanese Cultural Property VR Museum, you can “hold” various cultural assets from across Japan and view them up close at your own leisure.

row.name: Skelethrone: The Prey
row.detailed_description: You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey. PROLOGUE KEY FEATURES: Metroidvania - Unlock unique upgrades for movement and combat to expand the world. Maintaining the game's progression requires you to use different relics, items and abilities. Challenging bosses - Test your skills against multiple bosses and other creatures from the Dark Ages. The game will constantly test your patience as you face challenging battles that require their own unique approach.. Exploration - The game features a huge world represented by a variety of hand-crafted levels. From fog-shrouded ruins, where undead corpses cling to any living being passing by, and shambling figures emerge. To the Sun-city that hides in the labyrinthine of an ancient tomb where an unspeakable evil lingers, long forgotten by mankind. AVAILABLE IN FULL GAME: Weapons and Equipment – Your character can be armed with bows, scythes, longswords, whips, pistols, rifles, and many more traditional weapons. More exotic weapons will also be available to you, so use any means to achieve success. Multiple Endings – Make key decisions along the way to determine Ericona's fate as you progress through the story. Non-linear exploration – Play through levels and bosses, discover side areas with more secrets and enemies to defeat. Combat galore - You must use an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons and equipment to repel a wide variety of enemies. Put your courage, skills, and resolve on display for them. 'Skelethrone: The Prey' is a free prequel to the main game, setting the stage for the events that will unfold throughout Skelethrone's main campaign. Assume the role of Derek Ericona, a lord who escaped the persecution is now trying to get to the borders of the neighboring kingdom to resist the tyranny of Queen Aurora, but he is being chased and faces an uphill battle. Prepare all your skills to overcome all the obstacles and difficulties prepared for our hero. And now the hunt is on!

Skelethrone: The Prey is a free prequel to the main game, setting the stage for the events that will unfold throughout Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona campaign.

row.name: Cage of Etha
row.detailed_description: Haunted by his mother’s death, young Emile suffers under his father’s gaze. Until, one day, he finds solace in another who resembles her. But is this eerie resemblance a blessing or a mockery of memory? ❖❖❖❖❖ A story-oriented visual novel set in historical France. Navigate the world as Emile, a lonesome boy whose past has caught up with him. Play by his side as he struggles to find a voice in a home that offers none. Stay as his witness as the choices he makes continue on a downward spiral… Features A story driven visual novel with elements of psychological horror. Hand-drawn character art that fits the atmosphere of the game. Nonlinear narrative incorporating dreams and memories. Different endings based on player choices.

row.detailed_description: Welcome to Town of Salem, a gripping online multiplayer game of murder, deceit, and survival set in the quaint yet treacherous town of Salem. Can you uncover the truth before it's too late, or will deception lead you astray? Forge alliances, betray friends, and navigate through lies to maintain your survival. Each game is a new mystery. • Dynamic Social Interaction: Communicate with other players using the in-game chat feature. Persuade, deceive, and discuss strategies to uncover the roles of your fellow townsfolk or to conceal your own identity. • Customization and Variety: Customize your experience with exclusive bundles, themes, and pets. Immersive Experience: Dive into the atmospheric setting of Salem, beautifully crafted with attention to detail. Community and Events: Join a thriving community of players from around the globe. Critical Acclaim: Praised for its innovative gameplay and strategic depth, Town of Salem has captivated millions of players and critics alike. Experience the game that has redefined the social deduction genre. Are You Ready to Uncover the Truth? Download Town of Salem 2 now and test your ability to discern friend from foe. In this town, trust is a scarce commodity, and every decision could be your last. Welcome to Salem, where your survival depends on your ability to deceive or to see through the deception of others. row.name: AQRA Tenses [Learn English]
row.detailed_description: هل تواجه مشكلة مع الأزمنة الإنجليزية؟ تم تصميم هذه اللعبة خصيصًا لتحسين ذاكرتك في وقت قصير. يركز مفهوم اللعبة على تطوير ذاكرة المستخدمين بطرق جديدة تتميز بالمرح والمعرفة. بدون ذكر قواعد قواعد اللغة الإنجليزية ، تم تصميم هذه اللعبة لمساعدة الأشخاص على تعلم القواعد مع ضغط أقل. بالإضافة إلى ذلك ، هناك هدية في اللعبة ، 14 مستوى من لعبتنا التالية للأطفال والمبتدئين (AQRA Steps) لتعلم اللغة الإنجليزية. الهدية متاحة حاليًا بـ 14 لغة فقط (العربية والتركية والألمانية والهولندية والصينية واليابانية والبرتغالية والإسبانية والفنلندية والنرويجية والسويدية والإيطالية والدنماركية والفرنسية). يرجى ملاحظة أنك بحاجة إلى استخدام زر الماوس الأيمن لاستخدام رموز القائمة والمفاتيح.
row.short_description: Are you having trouble with English tenses? This game is specially designed to improve your memory in a short time.

row.name: Fit Puzzle Blocks
row.detailed_description: Get ready to relax and unwind with Fit Block Puzzle , a fun and colorful block-fitting puzzle game. Inspired by classic Tetris, this game challenges you to fit uniquely shaped blocks onto a grid that changes with every level. From rectangles to round grids, each puzzle brings a new, fresh challenge, keeping you engaged without being overly difficult. The game's gradual difficulty progression ensures that you'll be able to complete levels at your own pace without getting stuck for long. It's a perfect game for players who enjoy a calming, stress-free experience while still offering enough complexity to keep things interesting. The mechanics are simple—just move, select, and place the blocks using your keyboard, gamepad, mouse, or even touch controls. Best of all, no need to rotate the blocks! Key Features: Hundreds of levels with unique grids and block shapes Relaxing gameplay that's easy to pick up but keeps you engaged Customizable camera angles , switch between top-down and isometric views Flexible control options —play with keyboard, gamepad, mouse, or touch A colorful, dynamic background that you can change from the pause menu Every completed level unlocks two more , giving you plenty of puzzles to solve Whether you’re looking to pass time or unwind after a long day, Fit Block Puzzle is the perfect game to chill out with. Try it today and see why players are calling it 'simple, fun, and relaxing!'
row.short_description: Solve a lot of puzzles in Fit Block Puzzle. Try to fit all the different shaped blocks on the grid.

row.name: Pushing POPO
row.detailed_description: This game is a simple and highly challenging 2D puzzle game with a system similar to 'Sokoban,' in which the player moves boxes to secure a path to the goal. As you progress, gimmicks are added, such as 'unlocking a passageway with a key,' 'shooting arrows to destroy balloon objects,' 'disappearing blocks that disappear once you get on them,' 'transfer gates connecting two points,' 'elevating blocks that switch with arrows,' and 'interlocking tags that move another box together when you move a box. Gimmicks are added to the game. If you get stuck, you can share the stage codes set for each stage with your friends, allowing each of you to play the same stage regardless of your progress. This game is a fan game for the archer 🏹 Ieiri Popo of the Vtuber unit 'HIYOCRO'. BGM is provided by 'DOVA-SYNDROME', a music material site. Sound effect creation software 'sfxr' is used. [About the distribution of gameplay videos] No report is required when distributing gameplay videos. Please note that we are not responsible for any damage caused by the actual game play and distribution.
row.short_description: This game is a simple and highly challenging 2D puzzle game for those who like to think but are too lazy to remember. By sharing stage codes, players can play the same stage even if they have just downloaded the game. Move the boxes in the stage and reach the goal to clear the stage.

row.name: Magical Girl Survivors: Prologue

You play as a magical maiden, holding up for 15 minutes against endless orcs. Game Features [/] Three beautiful magic girls and a special costume to choose from (there will be more magic girls and costumes for the standard edition) Active and passive skills are no longer limited by slots, and you can even learn all active and passive skills! Fire, Thunder, Water, Blade, Dark 5 categories of more than 20 skills, different skills can buff each other! A variety of genres to choose from, blood rage build, thorn build and so on. Game mode Kill Orcs with magic to gain experience and upgrade dozens of active and passive skills in the 5 series of Fire, Power, Water, Blade and Darkness. There is interaction between different skill groups, and lower skills can also reinforce higher skills. Forbidden spells In the case of an orc siege where ordinary magic is not enough to break through, Magical maidens can use powerful forbidden spells, such as Mooncannon, Meteor Shower, and Blade Storm.
row.short_description: FREE DEMO features ,Play as the Magical Girl, constantly upgrade your magic, build skill sets, and fight the tide of orcs! 15 minutes of fast rougelike game!

row.name: Winged Raider
row.detailed_description: Winged Raider is a 2D Shooter roguelike game where you navigate a castle that is crawling with goofy enemies and evil bosses. When you die you have to start back at the beginning, but the further you progress, the more story you unlock. Do you have what it takes to be the Winged Raider? Character Customization! -28 hats (some have multiple colors) -30 hairstyles in 8 colors -29 facial hairstyles in 8 colors -7 skin colors -12 body colors Guns and Wings! -9 guns (5 primary guns, 4 secondary guns) (You can carry one primary and one secondary gun) -6 wing abilities (different colored wings grant different abilities) Evil Enemies! -16 Different enemies -6 Bosses All enemy, gun, and wing stats are available to read about in the main menu! Check under the more button for item info (guns and wings) and enemy info. Info on bosses is unlocked under enemy info when they are defeated. The Kingdom of Daanco was saved thousands of years ago by a great hero. However, the Winged God stands to destroy everything. Turkzu has begun the attack of the Winged God and seeks to rule the Kingdom of Daanco under the Winged God. Save the Kingdom of Daanco from the curse of Turkzu! Your mission: -Infiltrate the Winged Castle -Defeat any who dare stand in your way -Eliminate Turkzu -Daanco is saved But one question still remains. . . Who is Turkzu?
row.short_description: Save the Kingdom of Daanco from the curse of Turkzu in Winged Raider! Unlock the story by progressing in this goofy roguelike 2D shooter. Fly around the Winged Castle, find new weapons, unlock abilities with colored wings, kill your enemies, and DIE?! Try not to die.

row.name: Magic: The Gathering Arena
row.detailed_description: Magic: The Gathering — FINAL FANTASY Join your favorite FINAL FANTASY heroes, villains, and more for an adventure! These larger-than-life characters and epic, action-packed worlds are now in your deck. Cast spells and draw swords as you shape your Magic story. © SQUARE ENIX   TM & © 2025 Wizards. About the Game Welcome to the digital Multiverse! Magic: The Gathering is the original trading card game- and now you can download and start playing for free with your friends from anywhere! Magic: The Gathering Arena empowers you to discover your strategy, meet the planeswalkers, explore the multiverse, and battle friends around the world. Collect, build and master your unique deck that will become its own legend. Your battle is only the beginning; duel on stunning battlefields, and enjoy Arena’s game changing battle effects and immerse yourself in the game. Start playing for free, challenge your friends, unlock cards, and feel the magic of the original fantasy CCG! NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY Never played Magic before? No problem! row.name: Alquiem
row.detailed_description: Alquiem is not available in any languages ​​other than French . Steam requires you to have an English default page. Thank you for your understanding; I'm sorry, but it's impossible to do better on my end. Maintaining the game already takes up all my time; releasing a game in multiple languages ​​would mean significantly more support. I have a life, I'm already sacrificing a lot for this project, and I have others in the pipeline! 🤍 Ce jeu a été réalisé par une seule personne avec peu de moyens, il peut donc comporter des bugs et ne bénéficiera pas d'un suivi équivalent à celui d'un jeu à gros budget. Merci de votre compréhension et amusez-vous bien. Découvrez plus de 80 talents au travers de classes combinables entre elles pour créer votre propre build unique. Le Mercenaire, le Nécromants, l' Artisan seront votre fer de lance durant votre aventure tandis que le Croisé   devra être débloqué en gemmes radieuses, la monnaie premium du jeu farmable gratuitement. Partez à l'aventure au travers de 6 donjons différent abrîtant plus de 20 monstres uniques  dont des élites plus coriace et même, si vous avez de la chance, des mimics au butin exceptionnel. Profitez d'un système de combat tour par tour modernisé dont les attaques sont automatiques mais les compétences doivent être lancées manuellement. Parfait mélange entre idle et actif. ☠️ Le timing et la stratégie seront de mise pour atteindre les tréfonds du Pandemonium . Un Raid final infini généré aléatoirement regroupant tous les monstres du jeu. Des affixes négatifs viendront corser encore la difficulté de ce mode de survie. De nouvelle rotation d'affixes apparaitront à chaque saison. Récoltez des matériaux pour forger les meilleurs équipements . Synergisez votre arsenal d'armes, d'armures et bijoux avec vos talents de classe afin de créer des façon de jouer encore jamais vu. Les armes légendaires ont des effets uniques et peuvent être perfectionnées encore au delà de leurs limites en endgame. Progressez dans 4 métiers distincs : le Minage, le Bûcheronnage, l'Herboristerie et la Pêche . Les deux premiers vous serviront à récolter des minerais et des bois pour forger vos équipements, les deux autres vous permettront de concevoir des potions aux effets plus fantastiques les uns que les autres. Par exemple des potions de vitesse pour accomplir instantannément des quêtes. Accomplissez des quêtes durant vos combats en donjon ou même en tâche de fond alors que le jeu est cloturé. La dimension idle comme dans les anciens jeux par navigateur d'Alquiem est fondatrice. Alquiem ne s'arrête pas à une partie, une fois au niveau max vous pouvez choisir de recommencer votre aventure de zéro ou presque... 🔨 Le système de Projets urbains vous permet de construire votre propre cité médiéval et ses bâtiments offrent des améliorations permanentes conservées entre vos parties. Les Équipements Héritages sont eux aussi conservés vous permettant de rendre vos débuts de jeu beaucoup plus rapide et inédits ! Alquiem est un jeu à 100% gratuit , pour financer ses ajouts de contenu futurs vous avez à votre disposition multiples microtransactions pour vous faire plaisir allant du simple skin cosmétique à La Croisade : Un battlepass saisonnier extrêmement généreux pour les utilisateurs gratuits qui comporte aussi un skin légendaire unique et de grande quantité de gemmes radieuses une fois débloqué dans sa version payante. De nouvelles classes, de nouveaux systèmes, équipements, monstres, butins et mode de jeu feront leur apparition au cours des prochaines années garantissant au jeu un suivi actif sur la durée. Et ce n'est qu'un bref résumé, découvrez bien plus une fois en jeu. Merci à tous pour votre soutien et amusez vous bien !
row.short_description: Alquiem is a new Medieval RPG in which you will be able to gain strength through numerous classes and talent trees, professions and equipment to face the creatures that inhabit the lands of Odenzur.

row.name: The Riese Project - Prologue
row.detailed_description: 🎮 Welcome to the prologue of The Riese Project A missing grandfather. A hotel with a past. Underground tunnels that refuse to stay buried. „I got you... Wait. I’ve seen this place before.” Anna returns to her family's old guesthouse in the Owl Mountains. Not for rest. For the truth. rapped in a room, with a fogged mirror and a phone call from her mother, she triggers a chain of events that lead straight to “Projekt Riese” — a real, unfinished Nazi complex buried deep beneath Lower Silesia. This is a free prologue of a narrative game where every click speaks. Every item means something. Every decision echoes. 🔍 What to expect? 🎙️ Anna speaks — you listen You’re not a silent shell. You’re the protagonist — sarcastic, stubborn, sharp. „Yesterday I was a quiet student. Today? A seasoned break-in artist.” 🧠 uzzles driven by context, not code Open grandpa’s safe, find a hidden map, match piano tones to underground valves. You think like Anna. You feel like Anna. That’s the key. 🌍 Real location, digital obsession Hotel Szyprówka, photogrammetry, Lumen, Nanite — but the spotlight isn’t on tech. It’s on touchable atmosphere. 🕹️ FPP or VR (OpenXR) Play your way: keyboard, controller, headset — everything works. The choice is yours. 🆓 Free. No strings attached. This is just the first chapter of a larger story. Leave feedback. Help us shape what comes next. 🎯 For players who: Want silence that hurts more than jump scares. PRemember “Gone Home”, “Firewatch”, “Ethan Carter” — and want more. Own RTX, but value truth in pixels over realism for realism’s sake. 🔓 Not a tech demo. A trial by story. The clock is ticking. Someone’s walking up the stairs. And the map doesn’t lie. „Be a bull terrier. Be a storm. Be Jodie Foster in ‘The Silence of the Lambs’.” 📥 DOWNLOAD NOW. Play. Review. Leave a trace. Help forge the full game. Because if not you — then who?
row.short_description: Some stories are better left in the dark. But some will find you. In Riese, echoes don’t always answer the same. A narrative FPP/VR experience about a past that refuses to stay silent.

row.name: The Doll's Window
row.detailed_description: Alva follows a mysterious girl named Elma, who may be an end to their despair. Elma latches onto Alva, who holds the key to her release. Together, they try to escape the labyrinth lying under the pretense of a circus. Together, they try to find a way to be freed. ♢♢♢♢♢ A horror exploration game that takes place in an underground labyrinth. Navigate your way through various traps and mazes. Dodge malicious creations that are perpetually hungry. Depart from the nightmares that constantly haunt you. Features Advance through different levels of the labyrinth. Uncover stories and converse with others to survive. Solve puzzles by finding bits of what's past. Find another puzzle within a puzzle. Try and stop the memories that torment you. Avoid those who are eager to consume your soul. Controls Arrow keys — Movement Enter or Space bar — Interact Save — Interact with Rabbit Dolls X or Escape — Check Inventory W or F12 — Return to Title screen F5 — Toggle Fullscreen/Window modes F1 — View/Change display settings To use Steam Overlay, please change the screenshot key settings to another key other than F12, F5, or F1.
row.short_description: A horror exploration game that takes place in an underground labyrinth. Avoid malicious creations that are hungry for your soul. Depart from the nightmares that constantly haunt you.
row.notes: Depictions and/or descriptions of violence. Few bright flashing images. It may not be suitable for all audiences and viewer discretion is advised.

row.name: MITTIN: Clean Flat Surfaces
row.detailed_description: The Michigan Transition To Independence (MITTIN) is a virtual life skills library of dynamic modules that foster the development of independent living skills in the home and community. Designed to support special education transition-related instruction, these virtual resources are free and available to parents, schools, educators, and students in Michigan. MITTIN is a partnership of the Michigan Association of Administrators of Special Education (MAASE), Michigan Council for Exceptional Children (MCEC), Great Lakes Reality Labs (GLRL), and Public Policy Associates (PPA). The topic covered in this game is'Cleaning Flat Surfaces', where the student can learn how to clean a variety of surfaces in the kitchen and living room of their home.
row.short_description: Learn how to clean a variety of surfaces in the kitchen and living room of your home with MITTIN: Clean Flat Surfaces. MITTIN is a library of dynamic modules that foster the development of independent living skills in the home and community.

row.name: Tower Survivors
row.detailed_description: The Story The evil Necromancer has escaped the tower, and overrun the kingdom with their vile minions! You are the last surviving elf in the kingdom, and they will hunt you down as long as you live. All hope is, however, not lost! Collect gold to summon defenders. Use them to protect the portal, and if you can keep it open for 5 minutes your armies can retake the kingdom and capture the Necromancer again. Join our Discord to make suggestions or report bugs!
row.short_description: Fight an endless horde of evil minions and survive as long as you can. Collect loot and purchase new upgrades and magic abilities. Summon allies to stand along side you and survive the horde!

row.name: Nameless - The Departed Cycle
row.detailed_description: Something lurks in the Umbral Forest, its wicked tendrils snaking out to reshape the very woods themselves. Is this the beast Israh Almasi seeks to hunt and slay for the sake of his dying son? Or something even darker and more sinister than he ever could have imagined? Meanwhile, a mysterious man has made himself at home at Israh’s campsite. He calls himself Nameless… and he only comes at night. Follow the red star to the Umbral Forest and unravel the mysteries within. Nameless: The Departed Cycle is a dark fantasy/horror visual novel featuring a prominent male/male romance. Make choices to determine Israh's fate, and strive to survive -- perhaps even slay -- the monster stalking the Umbral Forest. A magical dark fantasy narrative comprised of over 20,000+ words. Make choices to determine the fates of Israh and Nameless, and unlock five unique endings -- four bad, and one 'true.' Wholly original artwork including six backgrounds, three unlockable in-game illustrations, and five unique character sprites with multiple variations. A rich audio experience, including an original soundtrack which sets the tone with multiple haunting and fantastical scores, plus partial and key line voice acting for the leading characters. Gay men.
row.short_description: Follow the red star to the Umbral Forest and unravel the mysteries within, in this gay, romantic, dark fantasy visual novel.
row.notes: This game incorporates mature themes including physical violence, emotional manipulation, suggestive sexual content, and visual and written depictions of gore.

row.name: Light of Alariya
row.detailed_description: Light of Alariya is an open-world, third-person, exploration puzzle game made by students at SMU Guildhall. In Light of Alariya , you traverse the ancient alien temples and ruins to restore the power of the stars and awaken your sleeping civilization. Alariya was once a quiet and peaceful desert town. Soothsayers foresaw a terrible storm that would last for centuries, so all the townspeople decided to fall asleep until it passed. However, as the world decayed over time, the ancient temples that focused the power of the stars began to crumble leaving the world’s goddess, Ari, with only enough power to wake up one young hero, Rumi. With Ari’s help, Rumi must realign the Constellation Crystals in each of Alariya’s three Star Temples to give Ari enough power to wake everyone up. In her exploration, Rumi discovers a series of notes, memories, and murals that help her uncover the mysteries of Alariya. Features: Single-player, open-world exploration game Playtime (main story): 1-2 hours Playtime (full exploration): 3-4 hours Made in Unreal Engine 5 Original music score
row.short_description: Light of Alariya is an open-world, third-person, exploration puzzle game in which you traverse ancient alien temples and ruins to restore the power of the stars and awaken your sleeping civilization.
row.reviews: “If you're after a short break from first-person shooters, or you would enjoy a calm, relaxing journey through a charming world, then you'll want to at least try Light of Alariya.” Notebookcheck

row.name: Conjury Revell
row.detailed_description: Conjury Revell is a first-person shooter with wave-based arena combat. Play as a rebellious dissident fighting to rid their world of magical oppression and forge a better future for their city in the clouds. Diverse Magical Arsenal Switch between 3 different spells and gravity powers to make the arenas work for you to defeat overwhelming numbers attempting to halt your rebellion. Choose between Ice, Fire, and Lightning spells with calculated precision to destroy your foes. City in the clouds Fight between city streets and above the clouds on airships as you assault your foes. Explore a gothic steampunk world and save the city. Visceral frenetic combat Shooter gameplay that keeps you on your toes. Dash, jump, and blast your way through anyone who stands in your way. Use your environment against your foes to keep them at bay while you charge up a powerful spell to eviscerate them.
row.short_description: Conjury Revell is a first-person action game from the students at SMU Guildhall. Use your magical spells and abilities to eliminate waves of faceless oppressors as they attempt to keep you from rebelling against the system.

row.name: Cave Crawlers
row.detailed_description: In Cave Crawlers you and your friends play as Dwarves searching for glory, power, and loot in the form of armor, weapons, potions, and items hidden underground from the world above. Your player has a fun, complex talent and stat system that you will use to fight powerful bosses and enemies. You'll find all kinds of mysteries along your journey, exploring different biomes, mobs, and items along the way. As a dwarf searching for treasure and glory, you'll find that your journey can be quite tough without some allies at your side. Each player uses their own personalized talents, spells, and items to help defeat treacherous bosses. CO-OP UP TO 10 PLAYERS Crawl through the caves alone or with a group of friends! Cave Crawlers supports up to 10 players in one game. You must rely on the great strength and wit of your teammates to defeat the threats deep in the caves. Be careful though, the power of the caves grows as more dwarfs adventure together. BIOMES As you explore, players will find complete environment changes, new enemies, and new items in each biome. In these biomes, you may stumble upon trapped rooms that contain magnificent rewards. BOSSES Biomes will include their own themed boss. Each boss has its own challenging mechanics that must be overcome to gain access to the next biome. Bosses drop their own unique loot. DEATH At the beginning of your journey, you create a new character and begin that character's journey. Each character has its own set of items and expertise talents. When a character dies, they are permanently dead. LIGHT The caves are extremely dark, players must make use of their limited light. Torches burn out over time, yet players may use their flint and steel in the darkest of situations. TALENTS, SPELLS, PERKS Choose your character's path with over 100+ weapon-specific talents at your disposal. Will you ravage enemies with an axe? Swing extremely fast with a dagger? Heal allies with a torch? Become a tank and block attacks? Try each path and forge your own builds. ITEMS Many unique and powerful items can be found throughout your journey. Each weapon has its own unique talent effect tied to it, helping you defeat increasingly difficult enemies.
row.short_description: Cave Crawlers is a 1-10 player rogue lite set deep underground in a system of randomly generated caves. Players use weapons, spells, and talents to defeat the unique bosses and enemies found in each biome.

row.name: The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann
row.detailed_description: Inspired by German expressionist cinema, The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann is an atmospheric and haunting exploration of radicalisation and the apathy of evil. A first-person point-and-click puzzle/horror game, it will challenge your logic and critical thinking skills just as it horrifies you with its disturbing narrative. Uncover the Mystery of a Doomed Town Use your detective skills to piece together the history of a town and find the secrets behind its ultimate fate. Solve Environmental Puzzles Apply your understanding of the mystery to solve environmental puzzles and escape the same tragic fate that befell the town's inhabitants. Experience a Haunting Atmosphere Taking inspiration from German expressionist cinema and gothic 19th century literature, The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann features a surreal art design and atmosphere that will leave you questioning your own reality. Note: Currently, only Act 1 is available to play. The game will be updated in the future when more content is complete.
row.short_description: The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann is a first-person point-and-click detective game inspired by German expressionist cinema. Solve environmental puzzles to uncover the tragic history and secrets of a doomed town.

row.name: JOJOvsDIO
row.detailed_description: A solo-developed action game themed on JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. Gameplay: Control Kujo Jotaro and hit Dio to the position of the sun above, then use the 'The World' to expose him to the sun for 3 seconds to defeat him. Press the Space to start the game. Collect arrows: Press the corresponding button according to the direction indicated by the arrows on the road. W(up), S(down), A(left), D(right) Use arrows: Click the minus and plus signs next to the HP( Heart ) and spiritual energy( Clock ) to allocate the collected arrows，then click the 'OK' button above the arrow. Control Jotaro to attack Dio. Move ：W、S、A、D Attack ：U、J、K、L The World ：Space(Reduction of Spiritual energy) Win：Burn all the heads of Dio. Hit Dio`s head to the position of the sun above, then use the 'The World' to expose him to the sun for 3 seconds to burn him. Attack the withered tree and drop the item. Using 'the world' allows you to attack the tractor and knives. Lose: lose all HP.
row.short_description: A solo-developed action game themed on JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. Gameplay: Control Kujo Jotaro and hit Dio's head to the position of the sun above, then use the 'The World' to expose him to the sun for 3 seconds to defeat him. Move：W、S、A、D Attack：U、J、K、L The World：Space

row.name: Dark Nights
row.detailed_description: Story You live in a small, peaceful village. Every day is the same as any other; boring. Right when you wish for something exciting to happen, strange things start to occur, stemming from the nearby forest. If that isn't enough, the locals have begun disappearing. At the same time, you meet four mysterious guys. Will you discover the truth before becoming the next target? Features ♦ 4 routes, each with a unique storyline ♦ 16 possible endings, 4 per storyline ♦ At least 10 hours playtime - 60,000 - 70,000 words per storyline. Total 270,608 words ♦ 8+ side characters, vary per route. ♦ 60 CG art/20+ cut scenes ♦ 60 Original background art ♦ 37 Original soundtracks ♦ 29 Achievements ♦ Opening video ♦ Bonus material Notes There isn’t an official order, because each route is a puzzle piece of the whole. Although, some routes are more connected than others. Like Zeikun and Sachiro. If you are going to play all routes anyway, I suggest starting off with Zeikun or Sachiro as an introduction to the story. Kurato and Junoru routes are more plot-heavy so I’d do them as last. If you enjoy keeping hooked on mysteries I suggest this order: Sachiro> Zeikun> Kurato > Junoru. To understand hints given in other routes I suggest this order: Kurato > Zeikun > Sachiro or Junoru. Reach all 16 endings to unlock bonus content.
row.short_description: Nothing is as it seems.

row.name: 流離之歌
row.detailed_description: Clency and Livia is a strategy game. You will control a pair of brother and sister who strayed from their father because of a war. On the dangerous warfield, there is no mercy. They don't have power to fight, so you only can rely on Clency's detection of elements that can make you see the enemys' next motion. Use your Intelligence to help Clency and Livia make through these difficulties. Besides, they have different tallents that you can use: Clency can push the character or obstacle away; Livia can cast a magic bubble to move object. The only thing what they can do is supporting each others. But after the war, is there still any hope in front of them, or it is just a bigger tragedy?
row.short_description: Clency and Livia is a strategy game. You will control a pair of brother and sister who strayed from their father because of a war. They are starving and chased by soldiers. Could you help they through the difficulties?

row.name: Red Haven

In this horror game, the player can investigate the complex and discover what's inside or maybe who. row.name: Spirits of Baciu - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Join us on discord! About the Game SPIRITS OF BACIU - PROLOGUE SOB is an atmospheric puzzle adventure game set in Hoia Baciu forest, one of the most haunted places of the planet. You will follow the adventure of a little spirit waking up into the woods. How did he get here and what haunts this place? Interact with the environment and solve many riddles Talk to the spirits and collect clues and objects Combine them to get new information Listen to the forest and its habitants...only they can help you! Features Mechanics are point-and-click like but you can walk and run with keyboard The hand drawing graphic is full of details : observing the environment is very important to catch clues and collect objects Talking to forest dwellers will help you to solve puzzles and to find your way The involving music with nostalgic vibes will give you a more immersive experience: we suggest to keep the audio ON, or use your headphones, and listen well! row.short_description: SPIRITS OF BACIU - PROLOGUE is the enigmatic adventure of a mysterious cat-like spirit who suddenly awakens in the dark forest of Baciu. Join him on this strange journey and meet many spirits that inhabit the forest. Help him to solve puzzles and to find his way through the forest.

row.name: Half Hour Hexagon
row.detailed_description: Half Hour Hexagon is a minimalist survival game with roguelite elements where you must defeat waves of enemies in an endless map in order to reach the 30 minute mark. Spend cash earned during runs and complete achievements to unlock permanent weapons, abilities, and stat bonuses for future runs and master the art of the Hexagon. Use cash earned during gameplay to buy permanent Upgrades. Some of these Upgrades can have negative effects, but they reveal Upgrades with much more powerful effects later in the tree. There are 5 additional weapon types to unlock by defeating certain enemies across multiple runs. Try to overcome each milestone as you work towards new equipment. There are 13 different items to unlock on top of the 5 that start in your item pool. These are additional milestones for you to work towards and assist you in making it further and further. Finally, you can see a full list of all the enemies you've encountered and view their stats (alongside a brief description)
row.short_description: Obliterate a never-ending horde of enemies while you attempt to reach the 30 minute mark. Race to earn XP and level up to gain new items and opportunities for each run to become stronger than the last.

row.name: Eterspire
row.detailed_description: Early Access Eterspire is in Early Access on PC. We release new updates every two weeks to add content, polish features, and improve performance. Your feedback helps us a ton! We read the Discussions hub and publish detailed patch notes for every update. ------ Eterspire is a fantasy MMORPG built for players who want real progression that's fun and rewarding. Explore a handcrafted fantasy world, join other adventurers in real-time co-op battles, and earn gear through skill and grinding. If you’re looking for a true MMO with real depth, loot, and customization, Eterspire delivers a classic MMORPG experience that you can play on PC and on the go. GRIND FOR GEAR Level up by battling monsters, completing quests, and collecting loot. There are no paid top-tier weapons or shortcuts—your strength comes only from dedication, strategy, and skill. MASTER PVE TRIALS WITH FRIENDS Team up in co-op parties of up to 4 players to face Trials—wave-based PvE challenges with rare loot, EXP, and powerful boss encounters. Build your party, coordinate your attacks, and conquer Aetera’s toughest challenges. CUSTOMIZE YOUR ADVENTURER Choose your class and shape your identity. Use crafting to convert gear into cosmetics, so you can wear your favorite armor and weapons without sacrificing stats. Create a look that’s yours—no matter how you fight. CONTROLLER SUPPORT Eterspire is compatible with a wide variety of wired and Bluetooth controllers! With intuitive button mappings for both combat and UI, it provides one of the best controller experiences among MMORPGs! FIGHT FOR THE TOP RANK IN THE BASTION CHALLENGE Face endless waves of enemies in the Bastion Challenge. Each wave you defeat brings you one step closer to the top rank. Place on group, solo, and class ladders and earn points for fancy cosmetics with every wave you survive! JOIN A TRUE MMORPG COMMUNITY Eterspire is more than just a game—it’s a living, growing fantasy world. Chat, trade, party up, and explore with players around the globe. Join contests, community events, and Discord Q&As with the devs. DISCOVER THE WORLD OF AETERA From lush valleys and deep forests to ancient ruins and sun-scorched deserts, Aetera is packed with places to explore and secrets to find. Meet unforgettable characters as you shape your own legend. NEW CONTENT EVERY 2 WEEKS With biweekly content updates, feature improvements, and regular events, Eterspire evolves alongside its community. Every patch brings something new to discover or conquer.
row.short_description: Eterspire is a true free-to-play, cross-platform MMORPG where your skill and dedication define your progression!  Play on PC and Mobile with crossplay, join a friendly and active community, discover new content updates every two weeks, and explore a massive world full of charming characters.
row.reviews: “I don’t really do reviews on the App Store, especially on MMOs. Most of them don’t come anywhere close to PC or even console counterparts… but Eterspire does. It’s a breath of fresh air with its design and ideas in the mobile marketplace. It’s easy to play, quick, and fun. It gives you a portable MMO experience that you can’t get anywhere else. I highly highly recommend it if you’re a fan of the genre and want something to play on mobile!” 5/5 – Appstore “I rarely write reviews, generally only for particularly awful or exceptional things. This is thankfully the latter. Eterspire has quickly become my MMORPG of choice. Not mobile MMORPG of choice, overall MMORPG of choice. The stylized graphics are eye-grabbing, the monster design is varied and hits just the right good brain chemicals that gives me a feeling of longing and nostalgia. The developer team is incredible, both in their game design choices and community involvement. Give this game a go.” 5/5 – Google Play “Eterspire is easily the best mobile MMORPG of recent years. It's a lovely indie MMORPG where you just pick a class and then dive into a world full of monsters, quests, and loot. And the free-to-play experience is great.” 85% – Minireview

row.detailed_description: The kingdom is about to fall due to an attack by necromancer. The wandering immortals, the secret maneuvers of bandits, the rampant mysterious plague... The people, who have lost their hearts and minds, are being eaten away by heresy. You wake up in a thick fog. You can aim to become a hero in this kingdom, or you can live according to your desires. white as snow as scarlet as blood black as darkness your soul gets cloudy. 'Necrosaga' is a dark fantasy 2D action RPG set in a kingdom where immortals wander. You can always choose between right and wrong, or an option that goes above and beyond your opponent's expectations. You can attack any individual you encounter, or conversely recruit them to join you. Because of his powerlessness at the beginning, he will not be able to exert a great influence on the world. However, you, who can 'steal the abilities of those who have defeated them', gain strength through battles with immortals. Even if you're not good at fighting, you can overwhelm your enemies with absolute power if you take your time. What fate awaits you who eventually gained great power... You can decide how the story ends. ■ Abundant choices ・You can freely select one from a maximum of six options. ・Customization to become stronger is also free. You can specialize in attack, or you can specialize in defense. You are free to use poison or shoot tactics that rely on luck. ■ Incandescent barrage battle ・During the enemy's attack turn, you can avoid the weak point by moving your own heart. ・No matter how high-level your opponent is, if you can't hit them, it won't matter. ・If you feel that the enemy's attack pattern is difficult, there is also a mode where you can practice freely, so you can rest assured. ・If you want a more intense danmaku, you can also challenge the gods that you don't have to fight in the normal route. ■ Attack turns where you freely build a deck and fight ・On your attack turn, you can attack by choosing cards. ・Depending on your sense of deck construction, you may be able to defeat high-level enemies easily. ・Cards can be obtained by defeating enemies or making choices in the story. every choice will make you stronger ・Let's make the strongest deck only for you All music in the game is composed by Maoudamashii. Please enjoy the story of Necrosaga colored with beautiful music.
row.short_description: The story of you and the immortals begins in a kingdom about to be destroyed by a necromancer. You can give someone mercy, or you can take someone's precious things away. This is an action RPG where you decide the ending of the story.

row.name: Builders of Greece: Prologue
row.detailed_description: EA Roadmap About the Game Put your management skills to the demanding test and prove yourself as a fine ruler of the ancient Greek city . Throughout your journey, you will face many challenges, unexpected events, and promising opportunities. Make world-shaping decisions, command your subjects, erect magnificent structures, and make your Polis the most glorious place in the whole ancient world! Builders of Greece: Prologue , being a shortened version of the full game, is a great way to practice your management skills and learn basic game mechanics. Features: Dozens of varied buildings Extensive management and decision-making system Random events and weather conditions Trading, politics, and war systems Old-school City Builder gameplay with a modern twist Plan out your Polis with great precision - work out your own meticulously detailed city layout and establish unabated production chains. Choose from dozens of varied buildings at your disposal and decide which of them will best serve your loyal subjects. Maintain a balance between residential zones, administrative institutions, workshops, service buildings, and military facilities to provide your city with stable, dynamic development. Make fateful decisions and manage all the aspects of your city's life. Set your taxes, establish new trade routes, occupy resource-rich terrains, increase the population of your empire, react to unpredictable events, or become a local military power. The way you rule is entirely up to you! Take good care of your citizens' needs, guarantee their safety and secure their well-being. If you fail, your Polis will soon be hit by riots, plagues, or rapid emigration. Only a good, wise politics will encourage the local population to settle in your city. Prove as an efficient ruler and turn your small provincial town into a huge metropolis known throughout the whole glorious Greece! If you succeed, your city will become famous for its elite, top class society, astonishing wealth, magnificent buildings, and superb military power. Be careful though... your rivals will not remain idle! Be sure to join our Discord server, where we regularly hold engaging events and competitions, and talk about the future of Builders of Greece with our beloved community. Know, that we are always happy to hear your thoughts, feedback and suggestions! Stay up to date, follow our Social Media channels, subscribe the YouTube channel and become part of our ancient society! Add Builders of Greece to your Wishlist!
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in the beautifully recreated golden age of Hellenic city-states. Builders of Greece: Prologue, being a shortened version of the full game, is a great way to try your hand as a ruler of an ancient Greek city-state, practice your management skills, and learn basic game mechanics.

row.name: Pastel Putter

Putt your way through short little mini golf courses with the relaxing soundtrack in the background. Whether you want a casual game to play in long game queues, or simply want a relaxing way to pass the time Pastel Putter's chill vibe is perfect for you.
