Play a single hole or a few dozen, easily jump in and out to of the game created by a one person team with love!!
row.short_description: A relaxing mini-golf game with a simple aesthetic.

row.detailed_description: 1990 is a fun, casual RPG filled with laughs and nostalgia. You are a young boy named Sam. You are on a journey to defeat Dr. X, the evil mastermind scientist stereotype we all know and love. A fun cast of characters: Sam, the ballplayer Billy, the techie Rebecca, the cookie scout Riley, the family dog A variety of enemies: Gambling – Use a slot machine, if that's your thing A simple, happy story Controller friendly. You can play the game entirely with just a mouse too.
row.short_description: 1990 is a fun, casual RPG with turn-based combat.

row.name: Chamber's Reunion
row.detailed_description: Disclaimer: Purchase of this base game includes the first chapter. Further chapters are DLCs. Following a mysterious message from an old friend, you drive to an abandoned estate shrouded in mystery and decay. The air is thick with the scent of damp wood and overgrown vegetation as you approach the looming structure. Before you even reach the entrance, a figure emerges from the shadows, and everything goes black. You awaken in a dimly lit, decrepit room inside the estate, your head throbbing and your senses disoriented. The walls are covered in peeling wallpaper, and the faint sound of whispers seems to echo through the corridors. Disoriented and alone, you realize that your only goal is to escape this nightmarish place as quickly as possible. As you navigate the eerie surroundings, you uncover dark secrets hidden within the estate. Cryptic notes, disturbing artifacts, and fragmented memories hint at a sinister history connected to your friend's message. The shadows seem to move on their own, and you can't shake the feeling that you're being watched. Sinister forces lurk in the darkness, waiting for the right moment to strike. Key Features Atmospheric environment Player voice activity Graphically advanced
row.short_description: Following a message from an old friend, you visit abandoned estate. Suddenly, you're knocked out. As you wake up, your only job is to escape as quickly as possible..

row.name: Card Survival: Tropical Island - The First Days
row.detailed_description: Full Game Available About the Game Card Survival: Tropical Island is a card-based survival experience from the creators of Card Quest. Experience what life would be like if you were stranded on a desert island, all in a card format. Explore, craft tools and manage your needs in order to survive in this hostile environment. The First Days In this free version you'll be able to get a glimpse at the Card Survival experience by playing as the Hunter character for up to 7 in-game days, in a limited area of the island. The full version of the game features more characters, a character creator and a lot more content to explore. Games that you started playing on The First Days can be resumed in the full game. Key Features Simple but deep system: all interactions are done by using cards or combining them together. Tons of Content: Go from a starving castaway in rags to a prosperous island farmer. Realistic Simulation: Tracking everything from body weight to calluses on hands and feet and even your stool consistency. Explore a Desert Island Explore a large island with 8 different environments, including beaches, jungles, grasslands and mangroves. Learn to coexist with the many different animals of the islands, be predator and prey and even learn to domesticate and breed them. Learn of the different culinary and medicinal uses of the diverse flora of the island and discover the secrets of how to grow it. Keep yourself busy with lots of activities Work wood, stone, copper, fiber, leather and clay to craft yourself lots of different tools, weapons, clothes and containers. Build yourself a home and other structures out of wood and mud, including animal enclosures, crop plots and water reservoirs. Roast, smoke and salt different meats, make your own bread, oil, cheese, sugar, wine and cook lots of different recipes. Complex health system Suffer from foot and hand sores, back pain, sunburns and even bug bites. Craft protective clothing and use multiple medicinal plants to treat these ailments. Sprains, fractures, abrasions, bleeding lacerations and animal bites are some of the many ways in which you can get hurt. Wash and treat your wounds to stave off infection and promote healing. Get fever, diarrhoea, nausea, headaches and rashes from the bacteria and parasites you can catch on the island. Feed yourself well and keep your morale high to help strengthen your immune system.
row.short_description: Card Survival is a card-based survival experience. Stranded on a desert island you must use your wits and skills to stay alive. Use cards and combine them together to explore, gather resources and craft useful tools.

row.name: WarKind
row.detailed_description: Welcome to WarKind! Play against other players in teams or alone. Use different races, heroes and their abilities strategically, to defeat your opponents in different game modes. Various game modes . - Play against other players in 1vs1, Free for all or single player mode Dynamic game world - Strategically exploit natural events to destroy your opponents - Randomly appearing natural events in the form of a meteor shower, tornado or volcanic eruption! - Attack your opponents in a forest or from a hill to gain an advantage in battle! Different races - Play with different races and master their advantages - Customize the appearance of your units Different heroes - Use different heroes and their different abilities - Customize the appearance of your heroes! - Gain experience with your heroes to unlock new abilities Countless abilities - Use global abilities and those of your units/heroes strategically - Reach new player levels to unlock global abilities and other benefits! Daily Challenges - Complete daily challenges to receive additional content
row.short_description: Turn-based strategy game with different races and heroes

row.name: Super Galaxy Ball
row.detailed_description: Fast Paced Gravity Defying Action Super Galaxy Ball is a gravity defying 3D platformer set in space with an amazing electronic soundtrack. Navigate your way through each level by double jumping, climbing and sticking to walls to dodge any obstacles in your path to reach the finish. Unlock new skins by completing achievements and race for the fastest time by yourself or online with friends. Powerful Built-in Level Editor The built-in level editor allows you to create levels that are out of this world. Instead of choosing from a set list of pre-sized building blocks, the built-in level editor allows you to dynamically scale all regular blocks to any size, allowing them to fit perfectly wherever you need them. There are also tons of obstacles and behaviors to choose from, each of which contain multiple options that can be tweaked to enhance level design. Play With Friends Race against friends online or through LAN in lobbies of up to 16. The hosting player can choose any campaign or custom level they have on their device. This even includes levels that only the hosting player has downloaded! This allows everyone to easily share their levels with each other online without the need for downloading them first.
row.short_description: A 3D Platformer set in space with 40+ levels and a built-in level editor. Race for the fastest times in campaign or custom levels either by yourself or with your friends online.

row.name: 决战紫禁怀旧服
row.detailed_description: 这是一款具有古代人文特色的2.8D大型多人在线RPG游戏，取材自古代历次群雄中原逐鹿的朝代崩乱时期，酣畅恢弘的战斗将引领玩家进入风云际会的乱世之中，化身英雄，乱世砺剑，为天下苍生尽抒豪情. 三大阵营： 天朝，图兰，大舜。玩家可以自由选择一个阵营加入，为之奋战。 四大门派，八种职业： 战宿门派分为战狂士、统领士两种职业。 药宗门派分为炼药师和祷文师两种职业。 奇门门派分为炼冰手和天罗手两种职业。 流星门派分为火枪手和遁影者两种职业。 以风格迥异的四个基本门派为主，衍生出八种独具特色的职业。玩家可以依照自己的喜好养成防御 、搏杀、远程或者辅助为主的英雄角色，在群雄争霸中扬名立万。 PVE玩法：采集，加工制造，各种副本，世界boss PVP玩法：竞技场、阵营战、帮会战、更有激烈的野外战斗
row.short_description: 《决战紫禁怀旧服》是由泳漫网络发行的一款大型多人武侠类端游。
developers: Hangzhou Yongman Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Hangzhou Yongman Network Technology Co., Ltd.

row.name: Pets Hotel: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Take care of the different types of animals All your little guests have different needs. Pet owners will tell you about them; it is your job to feed them according to their demands. Don’t forget about grooming and play-time! A satisfied customer is the best business strategy of all! Manage your pet hotel One of the biggest challenges that await you in Pets Hotel is designing and running a place where your customers can stay assured that they are leaving their beloved pets in good hands. Your competition never sleeps! Have fun with your guests! Your guests have their requirements! Make sure you get enough daily entertainment and exercise to keep them strong, healthy, and relaxed. Take them for walks, pet them, give them treats, and play with balls. Make all kinds of animals feel at home in your hotel. Start from scratch and build your pet hotel empire! As the game progresses you will expand your business and make it the most premier pets hotel of all time! Imagine a place with a multitude of rooms, each designed and decorated for a different type of animal, with huge playgrounds surrounding your premium hotel! A truly fabulous place that you can create yourself.
row.short_description: Pets Hotel: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Pets Hotel: Prologue gives you a unique opportunity to build, design, and run a place where pets can feel at home. Cats, dogs, turtles, and many other animals are waiting for you to take care of them!

row.name: Bunker Builder Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Bunker Builder Simulator: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Acquire contracts, build, equip and decorate bunkers in this engaging builder. Observe your projects coming alive to provide safety and comfort to your clients! Dig a hole! Most of your contracts will take place in clients gardens. Building a bunker will require providing a stable foundation made with your chosen materials. Durability of your whole project will depend on that choice. The game will provide many tools you will be able to use to accomplish your work efficiently. You will have to cut, weld, plaster, and those are just a few of the tasks awaiting you. In time you will acquire better tools that will allow for faster work, which means taking more contracts and getting rich quicker! You will get access to a wide array of items to fulfill your customers needs. Furniture, armature, kitchen appliances, boardgames and many, many more. Build bunkers that will ensure safety from any danger!
row.short_description: Bunker Builder Simulator: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune.

row.name: Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition
row.detailed_description: (Re)-Discover the dark whimsical tale of Little Nightmares, now enhanced in stunning 4K and 60 FPS. Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition lets you choose between Quality or Performance Mode to favor either the visuals or the framerate depending on your preferences. Enjoy improved visual effects, including RTX reflections, water effects, more particles, and volumetric lighting. Additional helpers have been added for an overall better experience. The Little Nightmares series has been captivating millions of players worldwide since 2017. Now it’s your turn to try to survive the first entry in the most charming horror series ever made. Take on the role of Six, a lone child lost in a massive metal vessel known as the Maw, surrounded by dangerous, distorted versions of adults. You’ll need to do your best to escape in one piece or your fate will be worse than you ever dared dream. OBSERVE YOUR SURROUNDINGS You wake up in a damp, dark room. Your sole possession is a brass lighter. You have no memory of how you got here, but it’s clear that you are in danger. Only your keen eyes and quick wits can get you out in one piece. FIND AN ESCAPE ROUTE This world is not meant for children, but you can use your stature as an advantage with a bit of imagination. Climb drawers and shelves to find child-sized passageways through The Maw too tiny for the adults to reach and you’ll be safe… at least for a while. AVOID THE RESIDENTS The inhabitants of the Maw have only one use for children, and it’s never pretty. Children who don’t want to get caught should stay hidden and move carefully when they’re around. Under certain circumstances, a distraction might avert their attention long enough for you to scuttle away scot-free. Be careful, if you accidentally make too much noise, the Residents are quite determined once you’ve caught their eye. RUN FOR YOUR LIFE Sometimes, there’s no other choice but to run. If you can stay alive long enough to get somewhere the Residents can’t reach you, you might survive. Can you make it through the Maw to freedom? Six is counting on you. Good luck, little one. Game saves cannot be transferred from Little Nightmares (the base version) to Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition (and vice versa).
row.short_description: (Re)-Discover the dark whimsical tale of Little Nightmares, now enhanced in stunning 4K and 60 FPS. Play as Six, a lone child trapped in The Maw, a massive vessel inhabited by monstrous, distorted versions of adults. Sneak, hide, and survive in a world where your childhood fears come to life.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: Unrealistic Violence, Fear, Depiction of Suicide

row.name: Havoc
row.detailed_description: Experience an Arcade team-based action in Havoc, a tactical FPS that takes the genre to new heights with semi-destructible environments. Use strategy and skill to plant and defuse bombs, destroy walls to reach your target, and more. Immerse yourself in team-based action across various game modes, including bomb defusal, team deathmatch, and more. Havoc introduces semi-destructible environments, adding a whole new layer of strategy to the gameplay. Destroy walls and obstacles to create new paths, catch opponents off guard, and create distractions. Every match is filled with unexpected twists and turns, keeping you on your toes and demanding quick thinking and skill. With multiple game modes at your disposal, you can choose the experience that suits your preferences. Engage in high-stakes bomb defusal matches, where teamwork and strategy are essential. Or jump into team deathmatch mode and engage in epic battles against 5 other players. The choice is yours. Havoc allows you to customize your lobby settings, giving you control over gravity, movement, and more. Tailor the game to your liking, whether you prefer fast-paced, gravity-defying combat or a more grounded and realistic approach. Prepare to defend bomb sites, plan your strategies, and customize your loadout to emerge as the winning team. Havoc offers an immersive and customizable experience that will keep you hooked. Gear up, dive into the action, and embrace the chaos of Havoc now!
row.short_description: Havoc is an arcade tactical first-person shooter with semi-destructible environments. It offers a variety of game modes, including Bomb Defusal, Team Deathmatch, Free for All, and Gun Game, along with extensive options to customize lobby settings to your preferences.

row.name: Project:Dream
row.detailed_description: Description: 'Project: Dream' A Side-Scrolling fighting game set within the future. Fight your way through a small, yet growing, roster of hero's and defeat your opponents! Take on strong fighters or defeat your friends in local multiplayer to prove your skill amongst the competition. (This an indie portfolio piece. The game is still being developed overtime and is primarily to showcase my 3D work. New features and updates will come with time!) Key Features: - Local Multiplayer - Varying difficulty of CPU fighters - A growing cast of fighters - Toon shaded art style - Multiple levels to select from
row.short_description: A Side-Scrolling fighter set within the future. Fight your way through a small, yet growing, roster of hero's and defeat your opponents!

row.name: Horror Hotel
row.detailed_description: Horror Hotel is a top-down, 2D shooter which pits you against increasingly difficult gauntlets for foes. The demons of Hell have invaded a remote hotel, and you must defeat them using a combination of spells and your trusty Rune Stone. The Rune Stone is your primary weapon, throw it at demons to destroy them. Don’t worry, it comes back… To be victorious, you must take the fight to your enemies by traveling to Hell and destroying the twelve demon generals leading the invasion. You are the Doctor, and it’s time to cleanse this hotel.
row.short_description: Horror Hotel is a top-down, 2D shooter which pits you against increasingly difficult foes. Defeat your demonic enemies with a combination of spells and your Rune Stone. To be victorious you must take the fight to your enemies by traveling to Hell and destroying twelve demon generals in boss battles.
row.notes: Language, Blood and Gore, Fantasy Violence, Violent References, Alcohol Reference, Tobacco Reference

row.name: QuentBlast
row.detailed_description: QuentBlast is a cool indie RPG, where you bowl to attack! In this thrilling game of chance, the renowned Dr. Quent Blast has taken you on as his apprentice. As he shows you the art and science behind bowling, enjoy snappy, witty dialogue. You can further refine your skills by practicing on a variety of monsters that want to steal your money. Slaying enemies may give you FunBucks, which you can use to buy weapons and ammo and such. Many items would make a good gift for Dr. Blast. Some items can be used to temporarily boost your abilities, but watch out! The protagonist, Kid, gets sick real easy when his Brain Fuel drops too low.
row.short_description: QuentBlast is a cool indie RPG, where you bowl to attack! In this thrilling game of chance, the renowned Dr. Quent Blast has taken you on as his apprentice. As he shows you the art and science behind bowling, enjoy snappy, witty dialogue.

row.name: Running into the Cyberpunk
row.detailed_description: You found yourself in the future where robots have taken over the world. As the woman protagonist, you are trying to escape the robots. In this endless run, you jump from platform to platform. First, the turrets, then the first ship that rains projectiles, then the second shop shoots at you which feels endless, and lastly the drone when all of them fail. In the end, all of them attack you. How long could you survive while trying to escape them?
row.short_description: A wanted criminal trying to outrun the robots. Robots that are trying to put a stop to her escape. How long could you last in this cyberpunk universe? Run into the cyberpunk to find out!

row.name: Fantasia Medieval
row.detailed_description: Medieval Fantasy was a surge of inspiration, which came with the emergence of artwork created by robots. I've been wanting to test my writing on a Visual Novel for a while, so this new technology was the excuse I needed to create this adventure, which simulates a tabletop RPG session with friends. It's a short story, with some ramifications that might spark interest in replaying from the beginning to see all the possible interactions. This game is also a personal experience, to see the acceptance of the Brazilian public with Visual Novels, and to see the shortest possible time that I could create a game from beginning to end. If your experience is worthwhile, consider purchasing the deluxe edition, which comes with extra high-res images and a Thank you letter. Thanks for reading this far, I hope you enjoy the game!
row.short_description: A short Visual-Novel, made with Artificial-Inteligence art, about a party of adventurers on a medieval setting.
row.notes: Language Suggestive Themes

row.name: Street Paint Playground
row.detailed_description: Hear good music and chill out while you show your creativity painting this old walls! You are an artist with motor paint machine in a cool beach enviroment with some old walls to put your art into. This is a game made for chilling and painting! There are some friends hearing music and chilling out while you show your creativity, but the police and their dogs just want to stop the fun! make them happy with some tasty donuts, paint the walls and make colorfull creations, play soccer and try to make a goal, get the pizza and feed the hungry bear, a great space to paint, hear music, chill out around and have fun escaping from funny actors. Share screenshots with your friends in Steam!! Just press 'F12' with steam client on. SOLO singleplayer painter game Multiple COLORS and SHAPES to paint freely! 4 big walls to paint Beach scene with a soccer field and a ball (Make the goal!) Made with Unreal Engine with Stilized Graphics Great original Hip Hop music on background PRESS 'F12' And share your screenshots of your work of art with your friends on STEAM
row.short_description: You are an artist with motor paint machine in a cool beach enviroment with some old walls to put your art into, the police and their dogs just want to stop the fun! make them happy with some tasty donuts, paint the walls and make colorfull creations. This is a game made for chilling and painting!

row.name: Seaberry Keep
row.detailed_description: Find your way out of a large castle mansion! Along the way, help dust the mansion, play games with ghosts, decorate multiple rooms, and grow your own flowers and strawberries, while getting to know the friendly residents of Seaberry Keep! Features Point & click gameplay 2D exploration Story voiced in English Decorating, gardening, hidden object, and other minigames
row.short_description: Play hide-and-seek with ghosts, decorate your room, grow plants, eat cookies, talk to a parrot, and explore!

row.name: Golden Egg
row.detailed_description: A jump and run game: A young knight is looking for a golden egg in a magic world. But countless dangers are lurking. You have to avoid traps and find magic keys to solve the riddle of the golden egg. Open world: You can freely move around the levels and decide in which order you want to gather the magic keys. Try yourself! Can you solve the riddle of the golden dragon egg or will you fail? 4 playable levels, one level hub and a tutorial level The game autosaves whenever you reach the next flag! Some Traps are really tricky to escape Fast reflexes may help you. Can you beat the game in under 10 minutes? Mature Content Description The Game Is Recommended For All Ages.
row.short_description: A young knight is looking for a golden egg in a magic world. But countless dangers are lurking. 3D Jump and Run

row.name: TIMORE REMAKE
row.detailed_description: Official remake of the original Timore, that was released in 2014. Mannequins, darkness, blood, loneliness and horror. Timore Remake features atmospheric environment open for exploration with horrors, items, inventory, environment changes, weird progression puzzles, creepy sound design, nightmare and dream-like scenarios, the game built to make you creeped out. Strange creatures are always stalking you, weird mannequins appearing out of nowhere and constantly looking at you as you try to progress in your path, various mannequins behave differently and the world itself keeps adding more and more horrors along the way. While exploring, the game's inventory system allows you to collect items to find many new areas and uncover more horrors, surrealism and dark atmosphere of this place. Gameplay: you get to explore abandoned locations where you'll find items that let you progress, for that you have your inventory where you keep the collected items and read more about them. Along the way the environment brings more horrors, creatures, atmosphere and even a few extra areas for you to explore where you can find additional creepy sequences including new enemies and scares. The main destination will lead you deeper into the dark hallways and horrors with new items to find and scary locations to explore. The game is split into two environments: the first one lets you explore and navigate around it as things change and more paths open up, while the 2nd part of the game lets you dive deeper into horrors in a more linear path, constantly pushing you to new scares and atmosphere that keeps changing. Completely remade game from the original Timore, new environments, additions and changes, new locations built and a lot more atmosphere as well as reworked scares.
row.short_description: Official remake of the original Timore, that was released in 2014. Mannequins, darkness, blood, loneliness and horror.
row.notes: The game contains horror, violence, blood, gore and loud sounds as well as flashing lights.

row.name: Valora Survival
row.detailed_description: Valora Survival is a free-to-play multiplayer 3D survival game where the possibilities are endless, you can build a farm, a town, even an entire civilization with your friends! There are wild animals, and you are to weak to fight them with your arms so you have to find a way to craft weapons and tools. You also have the possibility of researching and making new discoverings! Your world is expanding quickly so the only thing remaining thing for you is exploring! Invite your friends over to you world and start creating civilizations. The world you once knew got corrupted....[
row.short_description: Valora Survival is a multiplayer 3D survival game where the possibilities are endless, you can build a farm, a town, even an entire civilization with your friends! There are wild animals, and you are to weak to fight them with your arms so you have to find a way to craft weapons and tools.

row.name: Dusk Hollow
row.detailed_description: Dusk Hollow follows a miner braving the dark depths of an underground cave system, all to rescue his friends who have seemingly been taken by the cave itself. Using what tools he finds around him, the protagonist has to fight against rock monsters inhabiting the recesses of the cavern. The game encourages quick thinking, with fighting hinged on using weapons found around the environment and using materials to upgrade the player’s abilities to assist in combating the creatures of the depths. The flashlight is the most important tool in the player’s arsenal, being the main way to view and traverse the level, and importantly, visibly see enemies through the darkness. Dusk Hollow features multiple levels with unique themes and mechanics that challenges the player’s use of both combat and flashlight mechanics. This game was made in 4 months by a team of 5 designers, and 3 artists.
row.short_description: Dusk Hollow is a horror hack-and-slash game that follows a miner braving the depths of an underground cave system, to rescue his friends who have seemingly been taken by the cave itself. Using what tools he finds around him, the protagonist has to fight against monsters inhabiting the cavern.

row.name: Word
row.detailed_description: Type any verse in the Bible and record your best WPM for each verse-set (1 - 2 verses per set). Key Features: Type the entire Bible in any order you like. Word is a non-linear typing game in which you can type any book, chapter or verse in the Bible. Record your highest WPM for each verse-set. Each menu and button show your progress and best WPM. Replay levels to improve your stats! Think of Word as a long term game with tons of replay value; over time, type the entire Bible or just one book or just the famous verses and then go back to improve your score. Record your most efficient performance for each verse-set. Navigating the menus, if you have played the level previously, your best performance will be displayed; efficiency score increases with both higher-WPM and fewer-mistakes. Featuring instrumental hip hop by Fidget !! Includes an ample sampling of super talented audio genius, Fidget! Choose his playlist on the options menu; the default gameplay audio is a satisfying Chopin piano playlist. Word makes use of the World English Bible (WEBP) The World English Bible is a Public Domain Modern English translation of the Holy Bible.
row.short_description: Type the Bible and record your best WPM for each verse!

row.name: NOX TIMORE REMAKE
row.detailed_description: Official remake of the original Nox Timore, that was released in 2014. A nightmare, that you come back to every night. Mannequins. Darkness. Horror. It is a short horror experience of exploring the dark hallways that keep changing. More and more creatures stand in your way as you get deeper into the nightmare, from weird mannequins that always look at you to injured huge monstrosities that want to prevent you from continuing going down your path. Strange letters that speak to you can be found uncovering the secrets of this place and corridor walls that keep reorganizing themselves behind your back. Completely remade game from the original Nox Timore, the game has been recreated from zero with changes and additions, featuring voice acting and new creatures along with intense and creepy atmosphere.
row.short_description: Official remake of the original Nox Timore, that was released in 2014. A nightmare, that you come back to every night. Mannequins. Darkness. Horror.
row.notes: The game contains horror, violence, blood, gore and loud sounds as well as flashing lights.

row.name: The Waterflame Brothers
row.detailed_description: Explore a world where the stories you know aren't what you've been told. A fantastic adventure with 3D platform mechanics, live an exciting adventure created specifically for two people. Play split-screen and take on ever-changing challenges that can only be won with co-op! - History In a magical world full of mysteries, there was a castle, which was the home of the Waterflame family, a family of wizards composed of a mother, her two children and a pet frog. After an accident with some potions, the children are transformed into elemental monsters and need to work together to get back to being a child. - Characters In the game you will be able to choose between the two children, Serena Waterflame and Aidan Waterflame, each one will represent an element and this will directly impact the interactions and mechanics of the characters. - Main Features Local and online cooperation Complement each other's strengths with your skills Adorable characters Explore fun and unique environments - About The Developer Game developed by Iago Souza, student of digital games at FUMEC University, as a final course work; Credits to Professor Lucas (voice of the narrator)
row.short_description: Explore a fantastic adventure with 3D platform mechanics, live an exciting adventure created specifically for two people. Play split-screen and take on ever-changing challenges that can only be won with co-op!

row.name: Singularity Runner
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord About the Game Singularity Runner is a simple casual game that relies on your reflexes. The player-controlled hero runs forward automatically, and the player can control his running path. When a hero changes course, the player scores points, but he cannot touch enemies unless he is in possession of a sword or shield. The shield will protect the player from death, but it will disappear after hitting the enemy and interrupt the combo score. The sword also disappears after hitting an enemy, but additionally it defeats him and does not interrupt the combo score. When a player enters an opponent without a sword or shield, the game ends and the points scored are saved in the ranking. Game Modes You can play campaign or arcade. Campaign has 6 levels to finish. There are three arcade game modes: Endless Game, Time Limit and Time Attack. Each mode has a separate ranking. Run to victory, avoid or defeat your opponents, catch animals - helpers, collect useful items and much more! Game Control Left click to change the player's path. Achivements: Lots of achievements to unlock!
row.short_description: How good a runner are you? Compete against other players in the ranking of the best runners.

row.name: NOeSIS-诉说谎言的记忆之物语 （超高清FHD版）
TBoF (The Book of Fredley)
row.detailed_description: A dark and silly twist to the retro adventure genre. Explore the town of Humberbumpton as Fredley: once a loving child now turned into a living abyss through the loss of his closest friend.As Fredley's heart broke in two, his tome torn open and it's pages scattered, Fredley sunk into the darkness. Now 6 years later, Fredley must gather the lost pages, and mend his book to bring his friend back. Pickup keys and other collectables to unlock doors or buff Fredley to change the dynamics of the game. Fredley is not a fighter and he HATES being molested; a lot of scary things are out there in and outside of Humberbumpton. Sneak past wandering foes and avoid getting spotted, or throw a few firecrackers to scare pursuing enemies. If all else fails, find the nearest hole and hunker down. Talking to the various children around the area is a good way to gain some insight and maybe even an upper hand. But they look so tasty... will you consume the souls of the innocent to satiate your hunger and experience a darker and more dynamic journey? Or show mercy and release them for the greater good and maybe a nice shiny item? TBoF has multiple Unique areas to explore; each more expansive then the last. Numerous enemies with varied attributes and quirks, and different reasons for getting their hands (Or Ghost Jizz) on Fredley.
row.short_description: Gather the Pages, Mend the Book, and harvest the innocent to defy The Reaper. A retro stealth-adventure. Collect Keys to progress and avoid enemies while you explore the town and search for the missing pages that Fredley needs to fix his book and bring his friend back to life.
row.notes: A dark story with mature themes, death, kidnapping

row.name: Battle for borders
row.detailed_description: A game about military weapons. At the moment it is a single player game with bots in tank battles. In the future, it is planned to add other various types of vehicles and weapons, as well as multiplayer. By adding details from containers for game currency earned in battles, the player collects a collection of military vehicles. Mechanics are made in the game: types of tank armor protection (steel, combined and dynamic), types of tank ammunition (armor-piercing, cumulative, high-explosive, ATGM and smoke), the possibility of shooting and controlling a machine gun, the behavior of the tank suspension, partial destruction of the tank. Destruction of surrounding objects and different weather conditions at combat locations. Each MBT has the indicators, sights and shells of the originals.
row.short_description: The purpose of the game is to demonstrate the military weapons of different countries and their use in combat conditions.

row.name: Voice of the Wizard by Brett Farkas
row.detailed_description: The game is now free since the voice recognition capabilities suffer from false positives. Nevertheless, it is an interesting early example of voice recognition gaming, so I am leaving the game up. Touch control versions of the game without any voice control are available for free on mobile IOS and Android. Voice of the Wizard is a 100% voice recognition controlled adventure game. It features bright pixel art graphics in a 42 screen overworld map. Including hidden areas, there are 115 backgrounds total. You are free to traverse an open world. Learn magic spells along the way and cast them using your own voice. Roam an island, encountering witches, knights, warlocks, ogres, and centaurs. It is up to the little blue Wizard to discover the circumstances of his imprisonment. A mysterious castle looms in the center of the island. Mermaids sing idly by the seashore. Fairies flit about with their secrets held close. Explore and discover hidden adventures in the tropical island. As the Wizard learns new spells he comes to new realizations about his circumstances, and unlocks new areas. Discover the secrets. Solve the mysteries. Defeat your enemies. You will be the Voice of the Wizard!
row.short_description: Voice of the Wizard is a 100% voice recognition controlled adventure game. Explore an open world of forests, fields, and shorelines. Learn spells, solve mysteries, and defeat enemies. It's up to you to be the Voice of the Wizard.

row.name: Unscramble Heroes
row.detailed_description: Calling all keyboard warriors that know (some) English! The generic fantasy setting is being overrun by monsters with scrambled words for names. Unscramble the words using your sword (keyboard) and shield (brain) to defeat wave after wave of minion and master. Earn experience based on the level (word length) of each foe and LEVEL UP! to improve your abilities. Collect hearts and items to extend your battle and ACHIEVE (ments) greatness. Etch your name in the HALL OF HEROES (Steam Leaderboards) and compete against your fellow keyboard warriors to claim the title of UNSCRAMBLE HERO!!! Unscramble Words This game contains thousands of common American English words. As enemies appear on screen, a mix of letters will appear below them. Unscramble the letters and type the correct word to defeat the enemy and move on. You even get a little bit of help -- the first and last letters are already in the correct position! Gain Experience Each word you unscramble grants you experience. The longer the word, the more experience! You can adjust the word length in the options, or go for particularly challenging words during the boss encounters. Level Up Think of it like a word based RPG where you gain experience and level up. Yup, you read that correctly. A word based RPG. Upgrade Skills Once you've acquired enough experience to level, you can spend points to enhance your abilities. Gain more health so that you can spend more time unscrambling words. Slow down the monster spawn rate so that you won't be overwhelmed. Start with more items. There are many paths to go down, but only so many points to spend. Don't worry, you can change your mind at any time! Unlock Achievements Can you hit max level? Can you attain a frankly unhealthy amount of points? Did you forget to use your items again? All of these are achievable metrics that you can show off to your friends. Post to Leaderboards This game supports Steam Leaderboards and there are a number of leaderboards to compete on.
row.short_description: How do you like your English words? Scrambled? Then you're going to love this one. Save the generic fantasy setting from scrambled word monsters using the best weapon you have -- a keyboard. Type words, gain experience, level up, upgrade skills, unlock achievements, and post to leaderboards.

row.name: Treekeepers
row.detailed_description: Treekeepers is about a giant tree that needs saving and a hot air balloon at the disposal of you and your 4-person crew. Along the way, encounter oversized obstacles and pests that are out to stop you. One player flies, one player defends the aircraft, and the others kill the bad guys. Don't like who's flying? Then take the flight stick from them! But you'd better learn to work together quickly, because it's your team vs. the world. Join us on the Discord to give suggestions and report bugs! Collect and strategize on which parts of your ship to upgrade Full multiplayer support, online or local, and cross-play with standalone VR users on Quest 2 Take full advantage of PCVR graphical power with lighting and other effects only enabled on the PC version Keep coming back for high scores with a continuous scale difficulty system Features: Ship-based combat where 4 players can navigate challenges together while controlling 4 turrets and giant energy shield. Play remotely online OR in-person with multiple crewmates in one large playspace! 3 upgrades that can be applied to the hot air balloon's turrets or shield. One full playable level with 20 objectives in in a garden setting, with more coming soon! A dynamic difficulty system that allows for players to earn higher and higher scores in each level, and stats to show off to your friends! All VR headsets supported via OpenXR, and you can cross-play with friends on the Oculus Quest 2!
row.short_description: Coordinate, fly, and blast your way through an oversized cartoon world in this 1-4 player co-op adventure!

row.name: Miniland Adventure: Prologue
row.detailed_description: CHECK OUT MORE GAMES FROM OUR FRIENDS [/url about][/imgvid] [url] Miniland: Prologue is a part of the full version of Miniland and is completely free. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of Miniland so you will be fully ready before the final product release! Build your own world and fight against your enemies Miniland is a game where you can do anything you want to ! Of course you will still need to eat something from time to time, but beside that, there are no restrictions ! You start with a small patch of land, that with time you can expand by yourself with biome tiles which you receive every day. In no time, you will find yourself in a big and pretty house with a farm beside, crafting new tools and exploring caves. CREATING THE WORLD Everyday you receive a bunch of biome tiles, that you can place wherever you want ! There are multiple biomes in the game, including: different forests, desert, grassland, snow land, savanna, highland and more! COLLECTING RESOURCES AND CRAFTING You can collect tons of resources from cutting trees, mining metals, looting mobs as well as crafting tons of more items ! MINING AND CRAFTING NEW TOOLS Ascend into the underground to explore dark caves and mine precious materials ! With better materials comes better tools; axes, pickaxes, swords, slingshot, paintbrush and more! BUILDING AND DECORATING With different types of wood to craft floors, walls, fences and various decorations, you can build your dream house and the surrounding. FARMING Have you ever grown a broccoli, asparagus or radishes ? Maybe you were breeding alpacas, ostriches or chasing racoons ? Whether you did or not, you can in Miniland ! FIGHTING WITH MONSTERS The darkness brings monsters . Will you be able to battle them, or you will just fight for your life ? TRADING WITH GOBLINS You'll find defenseless goblins around the world, will you build houses for them to access profitable trades with unique items?
row.short_description: Miniland: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. Your task is to build your world and fight against your enemies. The world doesn't generate itself - you do it, shape the world as you wish! Start with nothing, and build dream houses for goblins and yourself!

row.name: Dream Team Basketball
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR COMMUNITY About the Game Innovative Gameplay A unique take on CCG games that combines 5vs5 team battles and basketball lore. The result is a short strategically and tactically intensive match that leaves you wanting for more. While your average team battle game needs you to do damage, manage mana and health bars, Dream Team Basketball revolves around scoring points, passing, movement and management of players. The game has no critical strike chance, but it has 3point shooting that will make your shots score more, there is no armor or evasion but there is stealing and blocking as defense layers. The game embraces well know tactical game systems and brings them to a sports environment format. Lore Driven Design Play with over 360 basketball and NBA inspired cards, that allow a multitude of gameplay styles and enable crazy combos. With over 450 players, each with an unique combination for their 3 skills, up to 4 passives and other various traits, the game offers infinite possibilities for the deck building side of the game. Competitive Environment Our intention is to develop a competitive scene around the game and have embraced a 'easy to learn, hard to master' design philosophy. The starting 5 players will have an important role for the outcome of the game, while the 7 bench players will give players a multitude of option to interact with various strategies when needed. Dream Team Basketball is still in development. The current design is evolving every day and we’re hoping to take it to the next level with the help of our community. We plan to add a plethora of new game systems while also improving the polish for the game. ​
row.short_description: Dream Team Basketball combines traditional CCG gameplay with innovative mechanics inspired from the game of basketball. Explore over 300 player cards and 400 traits and skills to create your team and engage in a competitive environment.

OBJECTIVE-BASED GAMES Play as a human or dinosaur in objective-based game modes like Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, or Destruction. ENDLESS SURVIVAL Play one of the many survival modes to engage in never-ending waves of enemies ranging from militia soldiers, dinosaurs, helicopters, and more. SCENARIO EDITOR Create your own maps and missions with the included Scenario Editor. The editor is a powerful tool that allows you to make simple changes to existing maps or complex new missions using the integrated trigger system. All scenarios created with the editor are immediately accessible in multiplayer, allowing you to play your creations with friends online. KEY FEATURES Hundreds of weapons, equipment, and items to unlock Play as a human or dinosaur Multiple maps, game modes, and vehicles Scenario Editor to create custom maps and missions Customizable loadouts and appearances Rank progression system Online multiplayer or local play with bots Worldwide leaderboards Achievements

row.name: Just Another Life
row.detailed_description: “Are you lost?” “I don’t think so? I mean, the way back to town is pretty straightforward.” ... Welcome to Hope, where most of the residents ironically don't have high hopes for their future. The player plays as John Doe, just another life in the little town of Hope whose luck has hit rock bottom. However, when John meets a hermit living outside of town, he gradually learns to put his life together. Explore the town. Talk to the residents. Everyone has a story to tell. Work. Or not. Save money. Go broke paying rent. Find love. Or be alone. Buy a house and nice furniture. Or dream about it. Help John reach his full potential. Or give up on John forever. Happiness can be found right around the corner. If John only knows where to look (or have someone point it out to him). This is a game about hope and, ultimately, what it really means to live and be happy.
row.short_description: Just Another Life is a narrative-driven 'life simulation' visual novel mixed with adventure game puzzle elements. Play as John Doe, just another life in the little town of Hope. Help John learn the stories of the various characters of Hope, and help him overcome the hurdles to his own happiness.

row.name: 西部幻想 WestFantasy
row.detailed_description: Regarding this game: In the RPG game 'Western Fantasy', players will experience an alternative and interesting cowboy culture and highly distinctive combat styles. In the early stages of the game, a simple main storyline was set to guide the plot. After completion, players will be able to freely explore the entire western continent in their preferred ways. Is it a thrilling adventure that follows one after another? Or an elegant and leisurely journey? Is it a life of extravagance and extravagance? Or do you aspire to reach the pinnacle of world power? Or perhaps touching some taboo in this world and knowing the truth? The game has multiple gameplay routes and endings, welcome players to explore! Game features: 1. A unique and creative cowboy duel system. Players can obtain bounty orders through the police stations in various towns in the game, find wanted criminals based on clues, and then defeat enemies to obtain rewards through their favorite methods (surprise attacks, frontal confrontation, duels, etc.). In duel mode, sharp reflexes and precise shooting skills will no longer be the only determining factors for victory or defeat. Enemies will use a variety of strange moves to affect your normal level of performance. 2. Smart and individualistic enemies. In this game, the enemies you encounter, whether they are bosses or monsters, each have their own unique skills and cannot be underestimated. Some walk in a coquettish manner, some pull and tug, some design ambushes, and some mock you in their words and actions. No matter how powerful you become, as long as you don't pay attention, you may fall into the ground. 3. Diverse weapon systems, players will explore and obtain new weapons in different ways in the game. Each weapon has its own value and usage scenario, and when a certain weapon's proficiency is sufficient, players can explore and obtain the corresponding weapon's 'master skills' in the game, making your skilled combat style a masterpiece! 4. You can attack all NPCs in the game. If you think this way can help you get what you want faster, or if your ultimate goal is to become a mixed world demon king in the game. Of course, even in games, indiscriminate killing of innocent people will still be punished. Whether you choose friendly or evil behavior, there is a path to the end. 5. Rich side tasks. Listen to or join the emotional stories one by one. Most of the story descriptions in the game are presented in a humorous and witty tone. Interesting mockery always brings relaxation and joy, but do not take it too seriously and immerse it in reality. 6. Original art, including unique artistic styles and personalized music. 7. Dozens of bizarre and interesting small games and puzzle challenges to win rich rewards. Including original mini games: The most grand and famous event in the Western Continent - Racecourse!! The flavor of Eastern martial arts - Falling Leaves Flying Dagger! Full process tension and high energy - bravely venture into the pigsty! Come on, load me with five bullets - death revolver, fate is set!! Exclusive to mobile game Krypton players - Ten consecutive draws to kill!! Kill Ma Te Sentiment - Fingertip Dance King!! Life and death speed hide and seek, infiltrating luxury homes, speculating in real estate, and so on And some well-known classic game adaptations, such as: Carrots Pulling, Archery Master, Huarong Road, Box Pushing, Coin Puzzle, Treadmill, Slot Machine, and more Waiting for players to discover and challenge. 8. Many well-known characters and anime game memes, paying tribute to love, perhaps players can also feel a lot of resonance in the game. 9. Players can challenge and unlock dozens of interesting titles during the game exploration process, some of which can enhance the character's basic attributes and enhance their strength. 10. Honor value system. In the game, by offering rewards and defeating wanted criminals in duels, one can accumulate honor points, while killing innocent people will reduce honor points. Honor values record the player's behavior style and will affect the final direction of the game. There are still many, looking forward to your discovery. Author's message: Western Fantasy is my first game to be released personally. Although I have limited experience in production and a rough art style, it is a fun game with a lot of creative ideas. The game can explore more than 100 hours of content and has a main storyline of over 40 hours, which is relatively slow and hot. I hope players can give more suggestions~ Welcome to join my player QQ communication group: 761236793.
row.short_description: Western Fantasy is an independent game based on cowboys and post-modern science fiction. The story takes place in A.D2573, players will play the protagonist 'River*Clint' and embark on exciting adventures in the overhead world called the western continent.

row.name: Flawless
row.detailed_description: Flawless (完美无瑕) is a third-person adventure game that takes place deep within a young boy’s dreams. Explore the surreal landscape and solve puzzles to discover the origins of the boy’s fears in this psychological narrative experience. Can you escape the nightmare? In addition to controlling the boy's movement through W A S D and using the left mouse button to communicate with the protagonist's parents to advance the plot development, players also need to use W A S D E to decrypt the variant gameplay of Tetris. This game has one teaching level, three puzzle-solving levels, and one plot level, which correspond to encountering, getting along, resisting, and reconciling between the boy and his parents. I hope that players can learn why a lot of children in the process of growing up want to ask their parents the phrase, 'Do I need to be perfect to be worthy of your love' while playing the game. Flawless was made almost entirely by Thomas Wang, who hopes the narrative can help give players a glimpse into the mind of a child growing up under immense parental pressure. Special thanks go to Thomas’s parents for their support of the development and everyone else who contributed to the game. Feedback is always appreciated! Let's see if you could help the boy reach his parents' standards and escape the nightmare... Caution for photosensitive epilepsy!

row.name: 西部幻想 West Fantasy Playtest
Third World: The Bottom Dimension
row.detailed_description: Journey through a fantastical world conceptualised by artist Gabriel Massan, and featuring artists Castiel Vitorino Brasileiro, Novíssimo Edgar and LYZZA that investigates Black-Brazilian experience and the ramifications of colonialism on our ecosystem. As an agent of a mysterious organisation known as the Headquarters you are sent to the territories of Igba Tingbo and Sòfo to fulfil a mission, but events soon begin to unfold otherwise. Embodying different playable characters across two distinct, but interconnected levels, you embark on a journey through six kaleidoscopic landscapes, collecting special abilities and collectibles. As your quest unfolds and you encounter the native stories, characters and delicate balance of this world, you begin to understand another side to the story through the poetry, film and memories that are shared in this unique game. An experiment in non-linear storytelling and collaborative worldbuilding, this game invites you to open your mind. Have You Seen Everything? features ✻ Explore a collectively-imagined world conceptualised by contemporary artists ✻ Playthrough rich virtual environments inspired by the biomes of Latin America including craters, swamps, caves, gorges and deserts ✻ Encounter the work and research of a vital generation of Brazilian contemporary artists including Castiel Vitorino Brasileiro and Novíssimo Edgar through poetry, films, dialogues and narrative design ✻ Immerse yourself in sound design by experimental vocalist and producer LYZZA ✻ Embody two unique playable characters; Funfun and Buburu, each with different abilities and stories ✻ Meet and learn from a variety of characters you meet along the way ✻ Create and share memories by documenting your playthroughs using the in-game camera (Capture Mode) and share them online with the hashtag #thebottomdimension ✻ Open your mind to new ways of seeing the world inspired by queer and decolonial thinking ✻ Listen to the original game soundtrack by LYZZA released 2024 Please note that due to the update, existing users may need to download and re-install the game. commissioned & Produced By Based out of Serpentine, a contemporary art space in London, Serpentine Arts Technologies is an artistic programme with a mission to support artists who are challenging and reshaping the role of technologies in society. powered By
row.short_description: Explore a fantastical world designed by visual artist Gabriel Massan & collaborators that draws on their experience of Brazil’s colonial legacy. This art-game is an experiment in non-linear storytelling and collaborative world-building that invites you to open your mind.

row.name: Pixel Starships 2
row.detailed_description: Pixel Starships 2  is a starship building and battle game in an MMO universe. Featuring full ship customization, online fleets, exploration, programmable AI, detailed planning, micro-management, and complex battle tactics. The strategy mechanics are inspired by games such as FTL, Eve online, and Final Fantasy, and XCom. Battle Engage in epic real-time or asynchronous battles in Pixel Starships 2 , where you command your fully-customized starship in strategic PvP and PvE combat across the galaxy. Layout your crew, program advanced battle AI, and unleash devastating combos as you face off against players from around the world in intense tactical showdowns. New Systems In addition to a new graphics engine, PSS2 introduces a number of new gameplay mechanics. Oxygen and door access is now available. Ensure your mission critical rooms are well connected. New weapons facilities such as the bomb launcher introduce a new layer of depth. Room placement is even more important with bonuses for optimal placement. Programmable The programmable AI system is back with improvements. New filtering conditions allow fine-grain control for AFK setup. At the same time new AI chip unlocking, Presets, Layouts, and Templates allow quick strategic changes. Market Economy The economy in the game is entirely market driven. You can loot, mine, craft, and re-sell items and equipment. Take advantage of resources in specific regions to create rare items. Control lucrative planets and trade routes for maximum economic advantage. Crew Discover new races and crew each with new unique abilities. Crew members now have 6 core stats, plus 4 resistance and skill stats which can be trained and leveled up to take on various specializations. Send your crew on new away missions to take down monsters on different planets. Tournament eSports tournaments are a big part of Pixel Starships. New league and tournament modes are coming soon. The tournament system is now split into amateur and professional leagues to suit differing level of play. We will continue to post development updates on the steam page and forums. Please add the game to your wishlist to receive upcoming updates. Key Features - ● Build Epic Starships of your own design. ● Many races, aliens, factions to command and conquer. ● Battle it out with other real players in a single massive online universe. ● Manage diplomacy, recruitment, research, exploration! ● Control ship's power and limited resources. Discover epic weapons. ● Build and deploy support crafts to augment your Starship. ● Cross-section full ship control and battles. ● Explore planets, discover the secrets of space. ● Form alliances and battle with your friends to achieve victory! ● Program situational AI commands for subsystems and crew. Allowing automatic combats and offline play. (from ship level 4 after building command room)
row.short_description: First Glimpse on Steam Next: Build, Configure, and Manage every aspect of your own Starship. An FTL-esque game in a MMO setting. row.name: nofio wireless adapter for Valve Index
row.detailed_description: Nofio wireless adapter for Valve Index is built for serious gamers. It comes with everything you need to convert your exising Valve Index to a truly wireless VR Headset. With a dedicated wireless transmitter and receiver, the conversion to wireless is easy, non-destructive and removeable. Simply connect the base transmitter to your PC (DisplayPort, USB and Power), attach the receiver to your headset and connect the supplied short Oculink cable and you are good to go. The Nofio adapter integrates directly with SteamVR, apart from a simple USB driver there is no custom software which needs to be run, or added hardware installed to your PC. The processing is performed completely onboard which means your PC resources are 100% dedicated to gameplay with no impact on gaming performance. The wireless connection is completely standalone, without the need for additional wireless routers which means video quality can be maintained without affecting existing network traffic. Nofio is built on the worlds first network aware CODEC technology from IMRnext. The compression ratio can be adaptively adjusted to suit changing network conditions, and subframe streaming allows the frame to be compressed and sent before the next frame is rendered. All of this results in visual quality and latency equivalent to a traditional cabled experience
row.short_description: Introducing nofio, a leading hardware company delivering high-performance, immersive hardware. With unmatched image quality and ultra-low latency, our products unlock true immersive experience.

row.name: Re:|THM - once upon a time
row.detailed_description: 'Re:|THM - Once upon a time' is a rhythm game RPG that travels through reversed time. The rain rises from the bottom to the top, and defeated enemies come back to life. Meetings become separations, and the story heads towards the beginning. Players will unravel the story of the separation of humans and monsters in reverse time. Experience the wonder of a world where time flows in reverse, something that cannot be experienced in reality. The hero Astelro, who defeated the Monster King, kills the human king, Ankh. Using the reverse device called 'Ex' that only the king has, he reverses the flow of time. What Astelro couldn't bear to lose even by going back in time... Various wonders in reversed time The story progresses like a video being played in reverse. The story is unraveled by looking back on the hero Astelro's regrets. Will he sometimes be tormented by his past actions? Real-time reverse rhythm game The biggest feature of this work is a rhythm game that can be reversed in real-time. Even if you make a mistake, you can immediately roll back and restart from that point.

row.name: Hazard Horizon
row.detailed_description: Hazard Horizon is a game in which you have to survive on the space station along with other people. You will be able to play as a human or as their enemy. Gather resources, repair the station, enjoy communication and teamwork with other people. But do not trust everyone, your life is a priority. SANDBOX - mode where you can deal with game mechanics, test everything available in the game, and just hang out with your friends. No goals or limits. CHARACTERS HUMAN - just a person who can walk, run, jump, tackle, and use various items for self-defense. The main task is to repair the station and escape using the shuttle. UNKNOWN CREATURE - the main enemy of people. It has 2 types of attacks and has the ability to crawl on any surface. Very durable but not immortal. The main weakness is fire. The world of toolboxes, duct tape, stinging live wires, and infuriantingly tiny, easy-to-misplace screws awaits! row.name: Howlbreath
