Hunt enemy town players to raise your PVP score. You are not able to enter enemy shops/warehouses, but you are able to invade their town for limited times. Party with your fellow townspeople to hunt stronger monsters or enemy town folk!
row.short_description: Free to play PC fantasy MMORPG featuring medieval combat and a variety of spells, weapons, armor, and items to find and grow your character. Party with fellow townspeople to hunt stronger monsters or the enemy town folk!

row.name: Roost
row.detailed_description: After moving to the big city, You receive a great deal on the perfect apartment. The deal would be suspicious had it not come with a single caveat, you can't move the old photo which hangs on the wall in your bedroom. The owner of the building, Vanessa Smith says the room once belonged to her late grandmother who lived in the apartment. In remembrance she'd like you to keep the painting up. However you get the feeling that's she's leaving something else out as you begin to experience weird phenomenon and your dreams become strange and repetitive. Can you figure out what is actually happening? Or will your fate be sealed? Roost is a Low Poly First Person Exploration Game where you attempt to unravel the mystery of your new apartment. Roost mixes design philosophies of roguelites, adventure games, horror and those weird games you find on the internet to create a unique gameplay experience.
row.short_description: Roost is a First Person Exploration Game where you attempt to unravel the mystery of your new apartment.

row.name: Multiverse Mercenaries
row.detailed_description: Gameplay Navigate, Explore, and Conquer 4 procedurally generated levels Hop between the Multiverses where you will find vastly different environments from a cyberpunk club to a wild savannah. Dominate your foes as Akuma, a world-class assassin yearning for revenge, or TR-7, a state-of-the-art machine who has gone rouge Obliterate enemies to earn money and safely clear a path to a portal transferring you to another universe Purchase 22 different stackable items that turn your mercenary into a force to be reckoned with Die.Reset.Repeat. What to expect currently 4 procedurally levels that will NEVER be the same 2 characters with 3 unique abilities each in attack and movement 4 different enemies that play different roles and attack in different ways 22 items with 3 rarities that not only effect you but also effect the world and enemies 4 unique tracks. 1 for each level A game designed in pixel art What to expect in the future 1-2 more characters 2-3 more levels including a final boss stage 3-4 more enemies 6-8 more items A more prevalent story within the game Bug fixing and gameplay tweaks Mac OS support About the devs Made by me, Matthew Diamond. I am a 17-year-old high school senior making a passion project in conjunction with Curios Cardinals Curios Cardinals is a start-up company that sets up students with college-age students to work on passion projects We hope you enjoy! We really appreciate you playing our game. Please leave feedback! Feel free to reach out to our email or our Twitter! NOTE: MULTIVERSE MERCENARIES DOES NOT WORK ON MAC YET MAC VERSION WILL BE UP IN ABOUT A WEEK
row.short_description: Multiverse Mercenaries is a pixel art roguelike that will allow you to defy death by jumping from obstacle to obstacle in 2D, devastate your deadly foes with a sword or arm cannon as a mercenary, and buy items to supercharge your character all In diverse dimensions in the Multiverse.

row.name: Scare Girl
row.detailed_description: Scare Girl is a free roam survival game With a grassy forest environment . U start In a Forest And Your Trying To Collect 10 White Treasure Chest To Open A Door to Survive. Scare Girl She Out There to attack u. U spawn as a girl with a flashlight In a forest and ur trying To escape By collecting 10 Treasure Chest to open an escape door. Scare Girl Is fast and so are u. I Included a forest map a character that u start with is a girl and a scary character to chase u and trees and grass land and white Treasure Chest collectables and an escape door. And Ill Update U With New Maps. Playing the game is like a breath fresh of air in the forest Running From a scary Killer and ur trying to escape The forest. She can see u and not see u if u are far away. She makes noise if she see u. So u are a girl that's trying to escape basically. Running will help u get away from her. The game is basically running from a scary character and collecting white Treasure Chest to open an escape door In a forest. So search for the white Treasure Chest around the trees to escape.
row.short_description: A Scary game In The Forest And Your Trying To Collect 10 Treasure Chest To Open A Door
row.notes: There Some Violence

row.name: CRAP
row.detailed_description: Do you know rock-paper-scissors? But what if the scissors is a ninja that suddenly summons lightning? That is the principle of this game. 2 players choose a character and equip it with artefacts, attributes and weapons and let them fight each other automatically. Short and sweet A card multiplay auto battler. Choose your hero. Choose a supporter and start looking for an opponent. Choose wisely between artifacts, status cards and weapons to defeat your opponent. Win the best of 3 and get ranking points ;) a bit longer ;) There are characters with different stats and special effects. There are various supporters that you can take with you on your fights, who will support you once with their different abilities if you are 2 points behind. With your 5 points, choose between artefacts, status cards and weapons to equip your hero in the best possible and most specialized way. Many artifacts have an enhanced form that is shuffled into the selection deck after selection. After each round, things are equipped for your hero again until the game is over. It ends with 3 wins or 3 losses. Climb up the leaderboard and become the best. what else is there? - Collect crapies to unlock loot cards - Exchange your found bones for hero card parts - Swap your hero card pieces to unlock heroes or get crapies - Find emblems and customize your profile - Customize your supporters in the locker room
row.short_description: A Card Multiplay Auto Battler. Choose your Hero. Select a Supporter and start searching for an enemy. Choose wisely between Artefacts, Statcards and Weapons to win against your oponent. Win the Best of 3 and get Rankpoints ;)
row.notes: The fighting between the Players containing Pixelblood.

row.name: Larcenauts Spectator Mode
row.detailed_description: View all of the action in Larcenauts, the top VR hero shooter, in full screen and full resolution on your PC monitor. Perfect for viewing Larcenauts competitions or getting the highest quality video for streaming. Easy to use interface get's you right in the action so that you can see everything going on in a Larcenauts match. Features Include: ✦ Full screen, full resolution, spectator view ✦ Easily find friends in Larcenauts and spectate their games ✦ Use the Spectator code to watch private competition games. ✦ Spectate from multiple camera locations in the map or use the follow camera to follow specific players Want to get in on the action? Add Larcenauts to your game library and join the competition.
row.short_description: View Larcenauts games full screen and in full resolution for the best flat screen viewing and streaming experience. Use the friends list and spectator codes to easily join and spectate games. Never miss the action with multiple camera views and a follow cam to follow players.

row.name: The Tower
row.detailed_description: You have been trapped in a mysterious tower by an ancient chicken deity. This tower is home to many pools of lava, floating death balls, spike traps, and more. Fight hordes of chickens, gather loot and resources to upgrade your gear, and escape the tower, or else be trapped in there forever! The Tower includes: - Combat system - Crafting system - Save/load system - Obstacle courses - Major Boss fight - Status effects - Leveling system
row.short_description: The Tower is a casual-action style game with various levels and a final boss level. In this game, one must find or craft new weapons to defeat your foes, the chicken army. Along with enemy chickens, the Chicken Elder has also set up various traps and obstacles that block your way to him. Good luck!

row.name: Conquer: Napoleonic Wars
row.detailed_description: 1812. Napoleon's empire is at it's largest. Lead a country from the era in this turn-based strategy game. Buy soldiers, build fortifications, alliance yourself with your enemies' enemy, attack, and conquer. This indie game's main objective is to teach those new to 4x strategy games, with a simplistic approach. *Disclaimer, this game is made by a teenager for a school project. Also for Mac Build, go to -conquerer-nw*
row.short_description: A turn-based strategy game based off the Napoleonic Wars! Lead, attack, buy, and communicate. Learn how to play difficult 4x grand strategy games by starting with simple strategy. *Disclaimer, this game is made by a teenager for a school project*

row.name: 残秽的我们第二章 Playtest
Draco
row.detailed_description: Draco is a pixelart-style 2D platform game in which you control Draco, a small dragon born in the kingdom of Mugen. The kingdom is in chaos and fear for its new king, and it's in the hands of to little Draco to pass through the lands of Mugen, reach the king's castle, and bring peace back to the kingdom. Multiple enemies : Discover them all and try to face them successfully. Routes : Discover the different paths in the levels. Upgrades : Collect coins during the game and upgrade your skills. Final boss : Find out who the evil king is and challenge him.
row.short_description: Draco is a pixelart-style 2D platform game in which you control Draco, a small dragon who tries to save the kingdom of Mugen from the suffering caused by the new king.

row.name: For Mother Matron
row.detailed_description: FOR MOTHER MATRON Lizzy is a girl living in The Boarding, a walled city surrounded by fog. All who live here serve the mysterious Mother Matron, its revered leader who hasn’t been seen in person in many years. Periodically, the Mother Matron selects residents to become Surveyors, tasked with exploring the dark unknown tunnels that lie underground to find the key to a better future for the collective. The odds of survival are slim to none. It is an honor and a death sentence. One day, Lizzy finds herself on the draft... Using your wits and quick thinking, you must guide Lizzy through the dangers beneath. Will you survive? Will you find Paradise? Or will you be lost to the dark forever? For Mother Matron is a passion project inspired by Silent Hill, Spirit Hunter: Death Mark, bizarro fiction, and the works of Thomas Ligotti. FEATURES: - A terrifying narrative in a strange world with strange people - A striking dark art style with grimy environments and fleshy monsters - Life-or-death decision making - Partial Voice Acting - Atmospheric original OST by Velvetique & Angel B. - Approximately 2 – 4 hours of content - 2 Endings (and many more dead ends) - Rats - Rats - Rats
row.short_description: A story about a girl named Lizzy living in a miserable world and her journey to its darkest depths. A free atmospheric horror visual novel where you navigate life-or-death situations. SEEK PARADISE OR DIE TRYING
row.notes: This is a visual novel horror adventure about young people surviving life or death situations. As such, it contains content that may not be suitable for all audiences such as Violence, Death, Blood, Gore, Drugs use, Themes of Depression and descriptions of Suicide and Self harm.

row.name: 缄默咖啡厅
row.detailed_description: How to play ：press↑↓←→to move，press Enter to check/talk，press esc return the menu to save/load or use the item Game Length:1-2h catagory:JRPG Silence Coffee Shop（SCS） Aimed at bringing cozy study atmosphere guests， Silence Coffee shop is committed to creating a quality studying environment for our customers. Here, say goodbye to bothersome noise and have the ultimate quiet experience. However，Vanished customer，Flickering light，the steak always out of supply and eerie helping signal，confuse and urge you to explore the truth of SCS with many odd rules contradict to eachother. Player supposed to think the logic between the different rules，interact with surroundings to investigate further. In this adventure，you are not alone.Informed by your new compianion，you accidently know a secretive organization that contains anomalous or supernatural items and entities away from the eyes of the public，SCP. The game contains four endings，but only one explain reason of supernatural properties of SCS.Ofcourse，you also gain a precious thing beside the truth...
row.short_description: Silence Coffee Shop is a JRPG game inspired by SCP and 规则类怪谈（creepy rule）.In this game，you'll act as a regular customer，unveil the truth of Silence Coffee Shop behind it conflicting rules.Of cause，you are not the only one attracted by this abnormal shop...

row.name: Divided Skies
row.detailed_description: Student Project Divided Skies is a university project made by students from Breda University of Applied Sciences and is currently no longer in development . However we still have a community discord where you can join and chat with the devs! Join our Discord Join our community Discord server to connect with the game's developers and fellow players! Share your feedback and suggestions, and be a part of the development process as we work to make improve our game for our full release! About the Game Welcome to the Slums of New Mumbai! Divided Skies is a single player flight adventure game where you play as Kyra, a member of the Nandaka gang, as she completes dangerous missions transporting illegal tech and mechanical enhancements while fighting off rival gangs. Shoot enemies, chase down foes, and explore hidden areas as you uncover the secrets of the metropolis called New Mumbai taking place in the year 2100 Features: Satistying VTOL flight movement : Experience the thrill of fast and easy-to-control VTOL flight movement as you speed through the vibrant slums of New Mumbai on Kyra's Hoverbike. Clear missions and progress the story : As you play the game your main objective will be to clear various objectives to progress through the story uncovering more secrets of New Mumbai and Kyra! Engaging combat encounters : Take down enemies in your way as you progress through the story, with exciting and varied combat encounters that challenge your skills as Kyra. Open to explore environment : Explore the vibrant and sprawling slums of New Mumbai at your leisure, with a beautifully crafted open-world environment Dynamic traffic : Experience dynamic traffic as you fly through the slums, being careful not to harm innocent civilians.
row.short_description: Fly through the slums of futuristic Mumbai and complete various missions as Kyra - a member of the Nandaka gang. Transport illegal tech and mechanical enhancements, fight off rival gangs, chase down foes and explore hidden areas as you uncover the secrets of the metropolis

row.name: Ornament Express
row.detailed_description: Hop aboard Ornament Express, a Virtual Reality puzzle game, where you take the role of a Private Investigator in the 1900's in Switzerland. You've been hired by your client after a crime streak saw her valuable curio stolen. The trail this eccentric thief left behind leads you to a train, filled with stolen artefacts and mysterious items. Can you find the client's stolen goods? In this game you're tasked with sneaking through a moving cabinet of curiosity, the hideout of a fanatic thief obsessed with the strange and weird, looking for what he stole from your client. Stuck behind a series of puzzles and locked in the train, you'll have to rummage through drawers and clutter, solve the puzzles laid out in the carts and codes to continue progressing through this strange hoard of bits and bobbles. Find all the ways in which you can create chaos in the once pristine train cart, messing up the hideout of the thief as much as you can! Pull open drawers, scatter papers around and play with the many souvenirs the thief has collected. The train becomes a captivating playground of disorder, showcasing the aftermath of your relentless pursuit to recover the client's precious curio. Board this short VR experience on any OpenXR compatible headset. Ornament Express is a game made by 3rd year game development students from Breda University of Applied Sciences. After 9 months of development we're excited to share our first VR game with you!
row.short_description: Investigate strange oddities in Ornament Express, where you’re hired to recover your client’s belongings from an eccentric thief and his train of stolen artifacts. Explore a cabinet of curiosities throughout the train, visit carts holding odd puzzles, odder objects, and find hidden away secrets.

row.name: Liber Prologue
row.detailed_description: The liber prologue tells us the backstory of Nick Rhodes' life in the wild west before the connection with a mysterious book that will completely turn his life upside down. You'll be part of a tense western with a gray morality where everyone is willing to trade friends and conscience for a coin and a bottle of whiskey. In this rugged world of the wild west you should learn just one rule. He who does not know fear God is not the judge And the sheriff is not the law. Waiting for you: - Exploring the picturesque locations of the Wild Zakapa - Stories and acquaintances with colorful characters - One-on-one speed duels - Shootouts, chases - Riding a horse
row.short_description: Embark on an exciting journey with a group of bandits who have been having a lot of bad luck lately... Shootouts, duels, diversions and the atmosphere of the wild but beautiful west await you.

row.name: The Archipelago Promise
row.detailed_description: Discord Community About the Game This game is a student project made by students of the Breda University of Applied Sciences. After the 1.0 update, there will be no more updates. Thank you for understanding. As a sailor named Ethan, you set sail on an Alaskan-summer adventure as you are searching for his missing twin. Navigate the treacherous weather, survive dangerous wildlife encounters, and sail between islands within the archipelago to reunite with your brother. In this open-world survival game; The Archipelago Promise! Navigation Unravel what happened to Thomas, by following his trail using the detailed directions he left in their notes. Create your own story and make crucial decisions on where to go next by using your compass, and learn how to survive in this immersive exploration and survival experience. Craft & Survive Monitor your well-being by checking your watch for updates on health, temperature, hunger, and thirst. Utilize your trusty notebook to craft items, and increase your likelihood of survival in the harsh wilderness. Sailing Traverse the rough waters of the Bering Sea with your sailing boat! Maneuver past obstacles and sail from island to island, all in pursuit of finding your brother. Wildlife Whether you're hunting down rabbits for food, or trying to sneak past a sleeping bear, there are all forms of wildlife. Both harmless and life-threatening! Day and Night cycle Explore the islands on a sunny day or a cold stormy night. But beware even though you might see the beautiful northern lights, the cold nights bring low temperatures and hide the danger lurking in the shadows.
row.short_description: Embark on an unplanned expedition as Ethan, a sailor on a quest to find his lost twin Thomas. Navigate the Alaskan archipelago, survive the harsh weather, and unravel the mystery of Iris d'Enfer. The Archipelago Promise is a FREE Survival Game made by Students from Breda University.

row.name: S.P.L.I.C.E.D.
row.detailed_description: S.P.L.I.C.E.D. Take on the role of a strong-willed woman determined to challenge the tyranny of the mob leader Jiaolong and free Chinatown from their oppressor in this 3D side scroller action adventure, Metroidvania. Discover forgotten secrets and powerful weapons that will help you traverse the treacherous streets, as you set off on a dangerous mission to fight the mutants, monsters, and other enemies hiding within. Features: 3D Side-Scroller Action: Embark on a journey with beautifully crafted environments, mixing the depth of 3D landscapes with classic Metroidvania gameplay. Incredible Boss fight: Prepare to test your skills against a colossal and menacing boss. Analyze patterns, exploit weaknesses and have your skills tested in this immersive fight. Exploration: Beautiful scenery, hidden passages and charming backgrounds. Delve deep into this Biopunk Chinatown world as you try to uncover all of its secrets. Are you ready to face the oppressor? Your journey awaits in S.P.L.I.C.E.D., the definitive 3D side scroller Metroidvania adventure.
row.short_description: S.P.L.I.C.E.D. is a FREE Metroidvania made by students from Breda University of Applied Sciences. Traverse a Biopunk Chinatown with high mobility and difficult combat encounters.

row.name: Spinout Drifter
row.detailed_description: Narrative: Welcome to the Rocking Reefs! An island many only can dream to visit! Play as a wild tourist, doing their best to drift away into fame. Gameplay: Check out the competition! As the Rocking Reefs are home to some of the most competitive drifters on the planet. With many records to beat, as well as plenty of tracks to race across. A tropical paradise for some, and a police state for others… As you're attempting to set your records, be careful of the reckless police that will stop at nothing to end your drifting career. Do your best to set these records, but be wary of the Reef Police! Customization: Customize the look of your car, and upgrade your vehicle in ways that suit your playstyle!
row.short_description: Narrative: Drift through the city, dodging cars and other things alike! Drifting: Control your car in various ways to maneuver through traffic! Customize your car: Choose from a variety of car body's, colors, and tires!

row.name: Molytropia: Cloud in Shape of Hurt
row.detailed_description: Molytropia: Cloud in Shape of Hurt is the first of seven chapters, which will tell an amazing story about the adventures of a girl and her friends. They will find a strange red door and try to open it, after that everything will begin. You will plunge into the fabulous atmosphere of summer days. Bright warm sun and beautiful landscapes, what could be better? Of course, difficulties are waiting for children on the way, because without them, it can't be called an adventure. The main thing is to remain calm and think clearly. Gameplay: It's a visual novel, so you'll mostly be reading. Just press a key, then read, press it again, read again... and so on. There will also be a mini-game, a couple of endings and some choices. Features: • Nice soundtrack and beautiful backgrounds. • A kind of psychedelic atmosphere. • An interesting story that will make you think. • The main character is a cute friendly girl. • An exciting contest. • Red door.
row.short_description: The first of seven chapters, which will tell an amazing story about the adventures of a girl and her friends. Colorful landscapes and warm sunny atmosphere. Also, they will find the real door! And take part in the contest! Can you imagine?
row.notes: The game contains scenes of violence or gore.

row.name: SENTINEL
row.detailed_description: Inspired by the literature of Arthur C. Clarke and the 2D Exploration Platformers of the 90's and the 2010's, SENTINEL is a 2D exploration-based platformer that takes place in an alternate future. When a mysterious pyramid structure was discovered during the 1969 moon landing, humanity began focusing less on our planet and more on the stars. After years of research, humanity finally discovered a way to enter the strange monolith, but there was a catch: every person who entered never came back out. With volunteers dwindling, a bounty was raised to entice new explorers: $150 billion to the first person who can successfully enter and exit the pyramid. EXPLORE In SENTINEL, you assume the role of a nameless bounty hunter. Your goal is to explore every inch of the level and try to learn what this strange pyramid really is. The game is played in one large level that features 13 unique rooms for you to explore on your journey. while this task seems tough, you'll be well equipped for your journey in your Nanite Suit. FIGHT With the Nanite Suit, you'll be able to navigate the terrain of this unexplored labyrinth, and you'll be able to fight back against the many strange foes that await you. This game features five unique enemy types found across the map, and two boss encounters to really test your skill. GROW STRONGER As you explore, you'll find new upgrades for your Nanite Suit that change the way the game is played. Whether it's vaulting off of enemies or blasting through the sky, you'll keep adding tools to your arsenal as you progress. Each ability you unlock allows you to explore, fight, and move in new ways. Nobody knows what's in this thing. Nobody alive anyways. Maybe it's time you changed that. Good luck! SENTINEL is a playable concept piece, and thus is fairly short (Like, less than an hour short). While we currently aren't actively developing more levels for the game, we will continue to make bug fix and quality updates to this version of the game. If you'd like to show your support for the game, report a bug, make a suggestion, or just chat with the developers, please join the discord server linked on this Steam page!
row.short_description: Explore, fight, and grow stronger as you progress through this 2D Metroidvania-style platformer. Can you uncover the secrets that hide on our moon?

row.name: AevumCore
row.detailed_description: The Story 'Long ago, the world of Eirensia was born from a crystal that contained powers to almost a God. The relic is known as The Crystal of Vita in which humans used it as a key through their development. As time passed, countries were developed, and the world lived in a tranquil state. However, this was changed forever after a war was ignited…which resulted in the Crystal’s destruction…' The Project AevumCore is an Action RPG that is currently in the process of development and is slowly expanding into a fully developed game. Currently, the project is at the Alpha stage. Our goal is to create an enjoyable and playable demo that users can experience! We hope to construct it into a complete game. Players will be able to explore a large terrain called Primordium (and soon will be able to travel to other available islands in future updates). Inspired by great role-playing games AevumCore is our take on an Action role-playing game. The main goal is to make the gameplay fun and accompany it with an interesting and amazing story. This demo offers up to 5 characters to play. We took inspiration on existing franchises and implemented some ideas we thought would result in a fun and unique experience! Give it a try and tell us what you think! We will continue on adding more improvements and features on future updates for the game! Thank you for taking the time to read about this project, hope to deliver an experience that will be great! Current Build features: 5 playable main characters to choose from A level system to increase stats An action-oriented combat system designed for players to strategize as you fight A large world to explore along Puzzles, platforming and more! Enemies to encounter and fight! Experimental: Controller support (Mostly) Character UI Menu Map UI Future features: Sea and Sky travel A Story quest Side quests Hunting Full Leveling, party and skill system More TBD! The Main Characters Choose from the 5 heroes in this game and experiment on the one you think best fits your playstyle. Marcus , a hunter and merchant trying to earn a living to help out his foster mother. Class: Attack   (Constant Damage and All Rounder) Clementine , the princess of a fallen country on a mission to restore her parents and kingdom.  Class: Heal (Health support) Lucette , an engineer and thief looking to become wealthy! Class: Flank   (Heavy Damage and Status Effects) Azura , an Ex-Prasidian guard striving to protect the ones she cares for! Class: Support   (Skill Point and Status Support) Deante , a Blacksmith longing an opportunity to be a hero! Class: Tank   (Defense Support) Exploration In this game, players will be encouraged to explore the vast and beautiful areas. Explore from large field plains, caves, high mountains, and much more. Each place will offer a different aesthetic and who knows you may run into a secret or two hiding within each area. Future updates will only expand these possibilities to the sea and skies offering countless of breathless views and adventures! (More features will be added as the game continues to get updated) Combat Style In this game you will be able to choose to play as one of the 5 main characters, each having their unique sets of attacks and special abilities . Execute from a range up to 7 arts per character at your disposal and chain these arts to form powerful combos . However, be cautious on your attack positioning, guarding and the attack's effects . These are vital and may impact on the outcome of the battle ! DISCLAIMER: AevumCore is still in the process of development. The requirements may subject to change. Additionally, the demo is subject to change and does not reflect on the final product. We apologize if you experience any issues during gameplay but ask for your understanding as we put our best effort to fix and address the issues. We want to build a game that everyone can enjoy! Be sure to report any issues/bugs/glitches if you can! This will help speed up the development process.
row.short_description: AevumCore is an action role-playing game that embarks a grand journey with Marcus and his companions. Join them as they fight through a series of challenges and uncover the truth of the world of Eirensia and its existence! They are set in a mission to restore and save the world from its demise.

row.name: Color Zone
row.detailed_description: You can watch the development stages of the game live on Twitch. Color Zone is developed by an independent developer. The main purpose is for people to enjoy playing games. The game is in beta and will be shaped according to the wishes of the players; new game modes, new characters, new maps etc. Don't forget to join the Discord page to be with us while this game is being developed. Have fun! Gameplay: You can conquer the Color Zones in the game by going over them. You have to protect your own zones by fighting with other players. The player with the highest scores at the end of the game will win the game! Skills: Visibility: See all players through walls. Stun: The stun skill freezes all the players. It does not affect if the player has a shield. Shield: Protects you from all kinds of attacks. Speed: Speeds up your character. Rocket: Launches a powerful rocket to the nearest player. Bomb: Drops a bomb in front of you. Shoot: Shoot with the weapon (Murdock Character) Aim: Aim for better Shoot (Murdock Character)
row.short_description: Protect your Color Zone against other people!

row.name: Sorcerer Standoff
row.detailed_description: A magical, split screen fighter perfect for pro gamers and button mashers alike. Play as four unique and powerful Sorcerers as you battle across two exciting map packs. Settle the score in couch co-op with friends (or foes). Learn each Sorcerer's deep moveset in Sorcerer Training or jump right into the fray with tug of war style matches. Explore several unique environments to uncover their hidden utility. Master Four Unique Sorcerers Play how you want and choose from four Sorcerers, each with a unique playstyle and difficulty curve. Command the volatile power of lightning, the reality warping prowess of the void, the deadly manipulation of toxins, and the swift judgement of phoenixes. Turn the tides of battle as you master each Sorcerer's three spells and four enchantments. Innovative Spellcasting Experience projectile combat like you never have before with an innovative spellcasting system. Use 'combat lanes' to cast spells in one of three directions, altering their trajectory to curve around obstacles or mix up your attacks. Spells can be blocked or parried by matching your lane with the lane of an incoming spell but be careful, enchantments cannot be blocked or parried! Tug of War Matches Each map pack contains four unique levels, three of which have unique traits that can be triggered by interacting with the environment to gain advantages over the opponent. Split-screen couch co-op 4 unique characters 2 map packs with 4 levels in each Tutorials for gameplay and individual characters as well as full move lists This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Choose from one of four Sorcerers and engage in third-person magical duels as you tame volatile lightning, contort space and time, meld spells with alchemy, or employ a flock of spectral phoenixes across eight unique locations in this local, split-screen fighter.

row.name: Oathbreakers
row.detailed_description: The Steam version of Oathbreakers is currently offline and will be back online closer to the official release date. The Meta Quest version is still online. Sorry for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding! [Get the Meta Quest Version from the Meta Quest Store] Oathbreakers is a multiplayer fantasy VR RPG that incorporates a unique blend of strategic precision-based realtime action combat, with unrestricted player vs player competitiveness, in a relaxing survival RPG themed environment. Favouring a player-performance based approach to gameplay, Oathbreakers challenges you to discover, gather, earn, learn, craft, customise and master an arsenal of spells, stats, weapons and equipment to define your own play style and achieve your goals.
row.short_description: Oathbreakers is a multiplayer fantasy VR RPG that incorporates a unique blend of strategic precision-based realtime action combat, with unrestricted player vs player competitiveness, in a relaxing survival RPG themed environment.

row.name: Skader
row.detailed_description: Our Multiverse is collapsing, triggered by a catastrophic spacetime event. Many universes are already gone and just a handful left. Those who survived live in a constant universe incursion state and are about to collapse as well. There is an ancient artifact that can protect a single universe from collapsing and the multiverse sentinels, a pure energy intelligence without a body, decide to conduct an ultimate tournament. The winner will take the artifact home to save their universe. The sentinels pick the best warrior from each universe and invite them to the contest. You represent one of these warriors, provided with a high-end skating device, a helmet, and a trail generator to compete. Each universe gives you a unique skill which distinguish you from the rest and gives advantage. The battle arena contains highly sophisticated features, power-ups, and the artifact. The player who holds it longer wins and takes the artifact home to decide their universe destiny. Game features Unique ice-skating VR locomotion, easy to start but hard to master Singleplayer mode to play versus bots Multiplayer mode to play versus real players all over the world Voice chat during the game - use an open microphone to chat with other players in real-time to share your excitement Short sessions - long VR games can be tough, which is why you get the full experience even during short game sessions Trails, power-ups, weapons for dynamic gameplay Complete tutorial - learn controls and capabilities to get the most from your cyborg Every game gives you experience, virtual currency, and level-ups, and changes your position in the leaderboard, which is visible to all players
row.short_description: A sci-fi MOBA with unique ice-skating locomotion and a trail generator device to catch your enemies. Use power-ups to gain an advantage, coordinate with the team, and fight for your universe in the ultimate multiverse battle for the ancient artifact to save your universe from incursion

row.name: Emberfate: Tempest of Elements
row.detailed_description: ABOUT Set in regular modern-day life, you are the leader of a raiding guild in the world's hottest MMORPG, Emberfate, which has just released the new expansion, Tempest of Elements. Balance the intricacies of being a guild leader, ranging from preparing for boss battles or distributing loot, to managing the complex relationships you have with your fellow players. Engage in conversations with your guildmates, listen to their troubles — and maybe pursue one of the three possible love interests to build a romantic relationship of your own! Take charge of your own fate, and shape the future of those around you. In Emberfate, everyone is dealing with something, and your choices and support could make all the difference. FEATURES An Immersive MMORPG-simulation Experience Be who you want to be in the world of Emberfate! Choose your player character's name, pronouns, background, in-game race / class, guild name, and more!  Venture into the newest raid dungeon, Ruins of Refuge, and prove your worth. Can you lead your raid team to success and defeat all four dragons? Remember to communicate with your party — all lines spoken by the characters over the raid voice chat are fully voiced to ensure the full raider experience of hearing your friends scream in your ear in either excitement or panic. Create lasting bonds with your guildmates and fellow raiders! Chat with them in various text channels — realm, guild, officer, party chat — and occasionally send or receive private messages from them!  Explore and manage life as an Emberfate player with the fully functional guild, mail and inventory system! A Sweet Romance to Remember Tired of only watching and helping your friends' love lives flourish? No problem! There are three love interests you can pursue, who are waiting for that special someone (you) to come into their lives! Grow closer to them over text chats, voice calls — and even video calls!  Again, all the voice and video calls are fully voiced, so be prepared to hear your future partner (maybe) whispering sweet nothings in your ear! Love Interests
row.short_description: An immersive MMORPG-simulation chatroom based romance / otome visual novel. You are the leader of a raiding guild in the world's hottest MMORPG, Emberfate. Will you lead your guild to success in the newest raid — and perhaps find love along the way among your guildmates?
row.notes: This game includes content or themes that may be unsuitable for or upsetting to some players, such as: (1) fantasy violence (in the form of killing creatures in a fake MMO) (2) profanity and swearing (3) suggestive context (in the form of flirtatious jokes) (4) depictions of alcohol consumption (5) depictions of cyber-harassment (6) depictions of mental health issues, e.g. depression (7) references to chronic illnesses and depictions of grief (8) references to gambling addiction (9) references to alcoholism issues

row.name: いのちのないうた
row.detailed_description: ▼概要 ゲームアルバム「いのちのないうた」はストーリーを主軸においた7作のゲームを収録した短編集です。 音楽アルバムの構造を借り2017年-2021年にかけて制作された4作品を「先行シングル」、 追加3作品を「アルバム曲」に見立て１つの作品として再構成しました。 一部を除き収録作品はストーリーに強い繋がりを持たず 「死と生」をテーマとするダークな世界観を様々な視点から 描くような構成になっています。 ゲーム中には、歌詞カード風のショートストーリーが読めるB面等、 ミュージックプレイヤーをモチーフに様々な遊び心を詰め込みました。 全編通してのプレイ時間は1時間程度です。 ▼実況・生放送について 基本的に自由にしてもらって構いません。 ※誹謗中傷や作品の世界観を壊すものはお控えください。マナーを守ってお願いします ▼注意事項 ・本作の著作権は、作者であるHata_Ikedaに帰属します ・本作使用により何らかのトラブルが発生しても、作者は一切の責任を負いません ・演出上一部、人により不快に感じる可能性がある表現が御座います。 ・演出上暴力的な表現、自殺、性的な暗喩（文章のみ）の表現を含みます。 ・作中の素材の流用は禁止です、各素材の著作権につきましては作中クレジットをご覧ください ・直接的表現はありませんが、一部の作品に軽い女性同士の同性愛要素があります。ご注意ください
row.short_description: 音楽アルバムを楽しむように7つのゲームを体験しよう。「死と生」をテーマとするダークで神秘的な世界観と、ミュージックプレイヤーをモチーフにした独特なゲームシステムが特徴のオムニバス作品。
row.notes: ・暴力表現 ・自殺の表現 ・違法薬物の表現

row.name: Kart: The Tech Filled Racing Game
row.detailed_description: Hop into a multiplayer racing experience like never before! Features (at time of release, new features coming!!!): Functioning Multiplayer!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Two distinct vehicles, each featuring unique active, passive and ultimate abilities! Passive: Can be utilized at any time without cooldown during the course of a race Active: Tool used to shake up your opponents to gain an edge Ultimate (wip): Powerful tool used to send a message to the race track... No one lap is the same!
row.short_description: Hop into a multiplayer racing experience like never before! Try it out today and hop into a journey that will stand the test of time!

row.name: Quiz.com
row.detailed_description: Play 1000s of free quizzes. Challenge your friends on any device. Use phones or tablets as controllers and compete in multiple question types. Stream friendly!
row.short_description: Play 1000s of free quizzes. Challenge your friends on any device. Use phones or tablets as controllers and compete in multiple question types. Stream friendly!

row.name: Ankora: Lost Days - Prologue
row.detailed_description: 'Ankora: Lost Days - Prologue' is just the beginning of a great adventure. A tale about growing up, making friends and connecting with nature. Discover the beginning of this survival adventure exploring the wild planet of Ankora in the opening act. Mûn is a Junior Ranger from the Interstellar Patrol, stranded on the unexplored planet Ankora after her spaceship crashes there. Mûn will need to craft her own tools to collect the necessary resources for her adventure, overcoming many obstacles: rivers, lakes, waterfalls, mountains... and monsters. Ankora is a huge place. Explore freely around this mysterious planet full of promises and danger. Create different tools, build structures and terraform yourself a new home in the wild. Use the hammer to build structures, the shovel to dig and modify the terrain and the bow to defend yourself! Explore a wide variety of biomes, from deserts to meadows to snowy mountains, each one packed with secrets Level up with each action. Learn new recipes and skills in order to improve your chances of surviving. Visuals inspired by Studio Ghibli films like Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind. A modern setting in a fantasy universe. Meet spacefaring explore Mûn as a rookie, long before the events of Deiland: Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara. Ankora has extreme temperatures, so you’ll have to deal with rain, freezing cold and blazing heat. The days are long and the nights are full of dangers. But don’t despair! Mûn has her ank friends with me, so everything is under control. Ankora: Lost Days can be played with keyboard, but has been originally designed for gamepad. Later, we made an adaptation to keyboard and mouse. However, we will study the possibility of improving it in future versions to better adapt it to the players according to the feedback we receive.
row.short_description: The opening act of Ankora: Lost Days. Discover the beginning of this adventure and explore freely around this mysterious world full of promise and danger. Craft different tools, build structures and terraform yourself a new home in the opening act of this cute-as-heck survival game.

row.name: World Zero
row.detailed_description: It's an RPG Maker game that isn't inspired by Earthbound! (I never played Earthbound) Play as Shouta Kitano, travelling through the lands of a dying world in a parallel universe and save the world by bringing the core to the underground facility made by his dad. Through his journey, he will make friends that join his quest to get to the facility. He won't just meet new friends, he will also meet a strange man who tries to stop him from delivering the core by sending some hired mercenaries.
row.short_description: World Zero is a simple easy to pick up turn based rpg. You play as Shouta Kitano, a boy who fell from an alternate universe thanks to his missing father's watch. Now he is tasked to deliver the core and save the world from the Black Mist to return home.
row.notes: Body horror towards the end of the game Mutilated people as enemies

row.name: Cold Massacre
row.detailed_description: Story: People are fragile, and if they get pushed too much in an order of magnitude for too long then you could say the glass will break. Maybe this person was just unlucky. Going to Norway in a secluded place and everything, or maybe he just sought out such an adventure, but something tells me he did not expect what was coming for him. Perhaps that mask he saw in the darkness is ingrained into his mind. I wouldn't know, he was the one that was a part of the cold massacre after all. You do know who I am, right? Gameplay: This game has 8 endings you have to get, you can do whatever you want within the game, but there is a killer chasing after you. The most important thing to remember is to look for the subtle clues you find in this desolate place... Features: - 8 endings - Many puzzles - Thrilling chase-scenes - Relentless killer - Horrific atmosphere Optimizations: This game can easily be played on a low-end computer, but expect a little stuttering every now and then if your computer is really bad. If your framerate is exceptionally awful try turning off V-Sync and Chromatic Aberration in the options menu. Do keep in mind that V-Sync will typically make the game smoother on a high-end PC. Overall the game should be pretty smooth even for low-end PCs.
row.short_description: Cold Massacre is a survival horror game where you play as a person running away from himself. You have to find your way out of a seemingly endless nightmare that you put yourself into. A relentless killer is chasing after you and it doesn't quite seem human, how will you ever get out?

row.name: Stay Out Of The Farm: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Discord About the Game This is a prologue of full game 'Stay Out Of The Farm' a PS1 styled horror game. Stay Out Of The Farm: Prologue is a free part of full game 'Stay Out Of The Farm' a stealth-driven slasher with old school PS1 style graphics. Here you can try to get through beginning of the bloody path to escape. Use your intelligence to beat killer in a blody game of cat and mouse. During your way to escape you need to stay quite and stay out of sight, owner of the farm is not about to let his newest guest leave so soon. MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION: Corpses, blood, guts, decapitation
row.short_description: Free Prologue to Stay Out Of The Farm, a ps1 styled horror game where you try to escape from a serial killer.

row.name: That Makes Sense
row.detailed_description: That Makes Sense is a puzzle game where you define the rules...yes, like that other game you know. The game takes place on a hex grid, allowing phrases to be formed in interesting patterns, right, left, up, down, compact, diagonal, wandering, branching, meandering. Puzzles can be larger than the screen, use the camera to zoom and pan the puzzle. Puzzles have multiple solutions. Find approaches to create, combine, and change phrases to meet each puzzle's challenges. Test yourself to see if you can solve puzzles in creative ways, beyond the predefined challenges! Gameplay is both familiar and new, making you think in new ways to solve the puzzles. Game takes place on a hex grid, changing how you think about phrases and reusing words Puzzles may be large, use the camera to zoom and pan Multiple challenges in each puzzle, track your progress Find your own unique solutions to the puzzles
row.short_description: That Makes Sense is a puzzle game where you define the rules to solve puzzles. Challenge yourself to think in familiar and new ways to creatively solve the puzzles.

row.name: Rich Teddy Adventure
row.detailed_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure with 'Rich Teddy Adventure,' an action-packed platforming game that combines elements of collecting, puzzle-solving, and intense robot battles. In this exciting world, you take on the role of a charismatic teddy bear on a quest to become the wealthiest and most skilled adventurer in the game. Platforming and Parkouring: Prepare to jump, run, and climb your way through intricate and creatively designed platforming levels. The game features challenging obstacles and dynamic landscapes that will test your reflexes and agility. Utilize parkour moves to traverse the environment swiftly and efficiently. Collecting Coins and Bonuses: As you journey through the various levels, keep an eye out for shiny gold coins scattered throughout the world. Collect as many coins as possible to increase your wealth and unlock special bonuses, power-ups, and upgrades for your teddy bear character. Consumables and Power-ups: Discover a wide array of consumable items and power-ups that grant unique abilities to aid you in your adventure. These consumables might include double jump ability, water breathing, extra health and lifes, your ammo and rare secret boxes. Puzzle Solving: Prepare your wits and problem-solving skills as you encounter intricate puzzles in your quest. These puzzles will require strategic thinking and careful observation to overcome. Successfully solving puzzles will reward you with additional riches and valuable resources. Fighting Robot Enemies: The game world is full of mechanical adversaries that stand in your way. Engage in thrilling battles with robots of various sizes and abilities. Use your wit and reflexes to defeat them and progress further in the game. Compete for the Top Spot: Do you have what it takes to be the richest and most skilled teddy bear adventurer? 'Rich Teddy Adventure' features a competitive leaderboard where players can compare their wealth. Strive to be at the top of the players' list and earn recognition as the ultimate Rich Teddy! Join this adorable yet daring Rich Teddy on an epic journey filled with challenges, excitement, and riches beyond imagination. Master the art of platforming, conquer the puzzles, battle robots, and collect rare boxes to become the most accomplished teddy bear adventurer in 'Rich Teddy Adventure'! Are you up for the challenge?
row.short_description: Get ready for an epic adventure in a magical world filled with wonder and danger. You play as a Teddy Bear who has been summoned to this realm to save it from an impending doom. To do so, you must travel through a series of portals that lead to different parts of this mystical world.

row.name: The Shadow People
row.detailed_description: The Shadow People is a point and click horror adventure game where you wake up exhausted during finals week. Gathering your things, you head to campus to attend class, and then after sitting through a lengthy lecture, you head back home. After refueling at a gas station on the way back, you're driving alone in the dark and doing your best to keep yourself awake. Suddenly, you think you see someone in the road, and you violently swerve out of the way to avoid them. Unfortunately, your car gets smashed pretty badly in the wreck, leaving you stranded on a lonely section of highway. Your cell phone is unable to get any signal, so you decide to hoof it, looking for any sign of civilization or cell phone signal. You reach a nearby town that you swear used to be just empty grassland. You navigate the silent streets, trying your best to figure out a way back home. Controls: Use the left mouse to click through the game. Select text or objects within the game to perform certain actions. Use the right click during the game to access the pause menu. You can select up to 10 different actions, including the 'Move' action. Below the 'Move' action is a mini-map showing you adjacent rooms you can move to. Clicking on the large dots in the mini-map lets you move around in addition to using the 'Move' action to click on areas on-screen to move to. Hints: - You can save the game by right clicking during the game, and selecting the 'Save Game' menu. There are 5 save slots. Save early, save often! If you forget to save, there is also an autosave feature that saves upon entering a new room. - Certain items that are picked up will affect the game's ending. On the item screen in the pause menu, items with a white border can affect the ending. - There are a total of 5 different endings! Two of the endings are not affected by the item pickups, but are secret endings you can find in the game. Some in-game objects that can be interacted with can be clicked more than once for extra information, so try everything!
row.short_description: The Shadow People is a retro point and click horror adventure game with a minimalistic aesthetic. As a student cramming for finals, you drive all the way to school, sit through class, and try to slog your way back home. But fatigue sets in, and dark creatures dance in the edge of your eyesight.

row.name: Thief City
row.detailed_description: WHAT IS THIEF CITY? Thief City is a 4-20 player online casual, action game. Rob civilians, get cash, fight other players, avoid police, and gather weapons and items along your journey to the top of the leaderboards! CROSS PLATFORM Enjoy cross-platform mayhem and play with your friends not only through Steam but also on Android and iOS. GAME MODES Rob 'em - You have two minutes to collect as much money as you can! Collect items and money around the map and rob innocent bystanders. Collect weapons and rob other players to knock them off the leaderboard! More game modes coming soon!! HOW DOES IT WORK? Solana Battle Royale allows your community to duke it out in frantic Battle Royale-style gameplay. To join the fun, this is how it works: ​ 1. First, the player selects their favorite Solana community that they'll be representing. 2. Next, the Player enters their Discord ID, which allows community leaders to identify winners. 3. The player selects their character from the corresponding Solana community roster. 4. After selecting game options, players battle it out as the mayhem begins! The last team standing is declared the winner 5. A final leaderboard is displayed with the top-scoring players. If desired, the Solana communities can choose to reward their top players. Communities can either have their own members battle against each other OR multiple Solana communities can compete for the ultimate victory!
row.short_description: Steal a little and they'll put you in jail, steal a lot and they'll make you #1. Thief City is a low poly, indie, cross-platform multiplayer, casual & action game. Select your community, battle it out, and climb to the top of the leaderboard!

row.name: Robbie
row.detailed_description: Robbie it's a hardcore platformer 2D that will challenge your puzzle-solving skills and patience. Each level has a unique and interesting mechanic that will challenge not only your skills but your ability to think outside of the box. The difficulty's not necessarily harder as you progress throughout the game. The controls are simple and you have only one simple goal, find the exit.
row.short_description: Robbie it's a hardcore platformer 2D that will challenge your puzzle-solving skills and patience

row.name: 呆呆大冒险
row.detailed_description: 《呆呆大冒险》是一个2D回合制RPG游戏，包含剧情模式、Roguelike模式、体验模式三种游玩模式。 在剧情模式下，玩家将从头体验《呆呆大冒险》的所有游戏内容，包含主线任务、支线任务、迷宫、精英怪挑战、解密、小游戏、大秘境战斗等。玩家将扮演出生在夏朝的呆呆，在结交伙伴、收集五灵珠的同时，逐步发掘邪教的真相。 在Roguelike模式中，玩家会获得1个随机的1级主角，只身进入二次元。二次元中有各式各样的关卡，在随机事件关卡中，玩家还需要应对二次元动漫&游戏中的各种事件。如果玩家通过第35关的挑战，就可以在剧情模式或体验模式的存档中领取强大的装备。不用担心Roguelike难度过高——击败二次元中的小BOSS可以获得二次元积分，而二次元积分可以购买各种各样的永久强化效果，使你在二次元的冒险更加得心应手。 在主线剧情通关后，玩家可以前往地下城，体验独特的大秘境玩法。大秘境玩法类似于魔兽世界，玩家需要在限定时间内积累足够的小怪进度并击败地下城的所有BOSS，来解锁更高等级的大秘境挑战。大秘境的层数越高，BOSS掉落的奖励也越好。 在主线剧情通关后，玩家还可以前往有顶塔，亲身体验一场规则怪谈。玩家需要在遍布规则的怪塔中谨慎前行，最终打破规则的枷锁，重获自由之身。 本作共有4个主角、22张大地图、208个物品、162件武器、201件防具和174个敌人。游戏由作者使用RPG Maker MV开发，主线剧情游玩时长约为10小时，开发时长（包含测试）约1400小时。游戏永久免费，希望玩家能够喜欢。
row.short_description: 《呆呆大冒险》是一个2D回合制RPG游戏，玩家将扮演出生在夏朝的呆呆，在结交伙伴、收集五灵珠的同时，逐步发掘邪教的真相。本作还包含Roguelike模式和大秘境玩法，让玩家拥有丰富的游戏体验。

row.name: Physics Lab
row.detailed_description: Welcome To Physics Lab, We Appreciate Your Interest In Testing With Us Today! What Is Physics Lab Physics Lab Is A Small Sandbox Game Where Players Have Multiple Labs To Play Around In, Each Lab Is Different With Different Physics Based Objects And Features, You Will Find Almost Anything Can Be Picked Up! Alpha Point Lab Alpha Point Lab Is A Physics Lab Which Focuses On Slides And Objects, In This Lab You'll Be Able To Throw Objects You Pick Up At The Wall Or Other Objects And Travel Down A Slide With Or Without Objects! Beta Point Lab Beta Point Lab Is A Physics Lab That Focuses On Balance Platforms, Jump Pads, In This Lab You'll Be Able To Run Across The Lab, Jump At New Heights Or Send Objects To New Heights And Balance On Physics Based Platforms! Charlie Point Lab Charlie Point Lab Is A Physics Lab That Focuses On Dropping Objects On Giant Ramps, In This Lab You'll Be Able To Choose What Type Of Ramp You Want To Use And Slide Down It With Or Without Objects!
row.short_description: Test Physics Through Multiple Labs And Push The Limits Of What Physics Can Do In A Sandbox Environment!

row.name: Summoners War: Chronicles
row.detailed_description: CHRONICLE'S SWEETEST HALLOWEEN EVENT About the Game Summoners War: Chronicles is a summoning RPG that explores the conflicts and choices that shaped the world found in the original Summoners War: Sky Arena. Choose one of six Summoners—Orbia, Kina, Cleaf, Soleta, Heath, or Jin—to explore vast continents, summon Monsters, and battle against the darkness seeping through the Rift of Worlds. KEY GAME FEATURES Choose Your Character Each Summoner has a unique role and skill set. Choose the one that suits your playstyle and embark on your journey! Fight Alongside Your Monsters Summon a team from over 520 Monsters and join them on the battlefield for the first time! Action RPG Combat Evade enemy attacks, command your Monsters, and cast spells in real-time combat encounters. Endless Adventure Explore a vast world comprised of multiple continents. Game Modes Delve into loot-filled Dungeons, climb the many-floored Ascensions, and take on Raids with friends! Then head to the Arena to compete against other players! Summoners War Reimagined Experience the expanded universe of Summoners War, and immerse yourself in the untold story of the Rahil Kingdom.
row.short_description: The King of Rahil is looking for a Summoner to protect the kingdom against Tefo's enormous conspiracy. Explore a vast world with your Monsters by your side in this new Action RPG set in the Summoners War Universe.

row.name: Shong
row.detailed_description: Shong is a 'chess-lite', a simple take on the abstract strategy genre of games. Here you take control of four lone pieces and attempt to 'Shong' your opponent. How do you 'Shong' your opponent? You trap their king or move your king to the other side of the board. Sound simple? There's a twist. Each time you move a piece, the piece will flip between two movement patterns creating an extra layer of complexity when thinking multiple moves ahead. Play tournament mode and be greeted with seven different AI personalities, each one complete with a unique strategy. Challenge your friends to multiplayer online or locally. Can you become the ultimate Shong champion?
row.short_description: With less pieces and a smaller board size, Shong is the smallest brain board game you'll never play.

row.name: Oylinder
row.detailed_description: A 3D platformer like you've never seen before, you must climb a mountain, by controlling a ball with six legs, a key for each leg, jump, roll and fall until you have mastered it. And if you have played 'Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy' before, then you know what you are getting yourself into. WARNING! Some keyboards or laptops will make a beeping sound when several keys are pressed at the same time, you have to find out on your own how to turn it off.
row.short_description: A 3D platformer like you've never seen before, you must climb a mountain, by controlling a ball with six legs, a key for each leg, jump, roll and fall until you have mastered it. If you seek a challenge, this is it.

row.name: Buy a Croquette!
row.detailed_description: Localization Notes The English and Japanese translations have not yet been implemented. We are currently working on the English and Japanese localizations of Buy a Croquette! , and will release an update announcement as soon as the translations are completed. Stay tuned! About Us Join our Discord: ysbxSfYaQs Join our players’ QQ group chat: 1061372406 Publisher's Homepage: Click on the publisher “Eternal Dream” to visit our homepage. Follow us to get more updates on the game! Original Art Collection & Bonus Pack The Original Art Collection & Bonus Pack DLC is now available for purchase. Additional story DLC is also in development! About the Game Despite eating two boxes of bento for lunch, Chio Aozora's stomach is rumbling again! 'It's been such a long time since I last had a croquette. I really miss that crispy, golden goodness…” The familiar aroma of croquettes is so tempting, but Chio has forgotten to bring money! 'I think I tucked some money into my textbook, but I left the textbook at school...' Collect 380 yen in the shopping streets of Nagano to buy the croquette Chio has been dreaming of! 'But... where should I start?' Help out at the store, run errands, collect urban legends, play word games, and even rummage through trash cans – all to get the yen coins you need! 'I never thought I'd have to resort to rummaging through the trash...' The game features simple puzzles, mild depictions of horror (no chase scenes though!), multiple endings, and all sorts of quirky elements. Of course, there are also croquettes! Tips on How to Buy a 380-Yen Croquette: Yen coins are hidden all over Nagano! Investigate trash bins, bathroom sinks, park slides, vending machines, and other places throughout Nagano’s streets and alleys to find lost coins! Be a good citizen by helping others! The kind-hearted Chio Aozora will assist the residents of Nagano with various requests, from finding lost items to counting the convenience store inventory, from solving mysterious cases to tailing suspicious individuals... There's nothing a high school girl can't do! Uncover the buried secrets of Nagano! A notebook sealed with passwords and secrets… could it lead to a hidden treasure? Misplaced crates, Penrose stairs, abandoned houses, word games... Solving these puzzles might lead to unexpected rewards... Receive the croquette from kind-hearted people! There might be ways to get a croquette without collecting coins. Maybe someone can lend Chio some yen, or maybe even hand over their croquette – Chio might even be able to get a free meal from the croquette vendor... All of these choices will lead to different endings! Deal with unexpected crises (if you make a wrong choice)! While Chio is collecting coins, some choices might lead her into dangerous situations – she might encounter some terrifying urban legends! Game Duration: 4-10 hours Number of Endings: 12 (including 4 hidden endings) A Brief How-to-Play: Use the arrow keys to move the character, and press the ESC/X key to open the menu. Press the space bar to interact with NPCs/objects in front of you. If you get stuck, you can refer to the free DLC – Nagano Survival Guide . A high school girl who loves croquettes. She has to collect 380 yen to buy the croquette that she dreams of because she had forgotten to bring money. Chio Aozora's best friend, who is always there for her (and Chio for her!). She can be a bit of a chatterbox sometimes. The boy Chio Aozora has a crush on. He seems to be a delinquent student who often skips class, but he is gentle to Chio. Producer, Script: Yueqing (越青) Art: Yueqing (越青), Guangnianchi (广廿尺), Yuriko (百合子), ONE, Jichuanli (几串栗) Publisher: Eternal Dream (Details on sourced assets in the game can be found in the end credits.)
row.short_description: March 2012, Nagano. The brave and clever high school girl, Chio Aozora, is facing a major crisis: she doesn’t have enough money to buy a croquette! Navigate through the streets and alleys of Nagano, interact with a variety of characters, solve complex puzzles, collect 380 yen, and buy a croquette!

row.name: Abyss Manager Idle
row.detailed_description: This is a short idle tower defense game that players can complete to 100% in 2 hours. Abyss Manager is an idle tower defense game where players need to assign jobs to various characters, collect resources, recruit and train characters, and excavate more floors to unlock further mechanics.
row.short_description: This is a short idle tower defense game that players can complete to 100% in 2 hours.Abyss Manager is an idle tower defense game where players need to assign jobs to various characters, collect resources, recruit and train characters, and excavate more floors to unlock further mechanics.

row.name: In The Rural Village of Nagoro
row.detailed_description: Nagoro is a small village in the Iya Valley on the island of Shikoku in Tokushima Prefecture, Japan. During her childhood, the valley was prosperous and the village was full of young people. The Nagoro used to have 300 inhabitants that were being supported through the forest industry and dam construction. She moved away to Osaka from Nagoro when she was younger. However, when she becomes older and returns to Nagoro, the village is not the same anymore as what she remembers during her childhood. Estimated play time: 10 minutes Features: - Relaxing music - Educational info about Nagoro - Original song by a Japanese artist - Asami - - Interact button exists
row.short_description: Narrative through Interact Button. In The Rural Village of Nagoro is a short, side-scrolling game with minimalist gameplay 'Interact button’ to tell a fate that falls on Nagoro village. Explore and press ‘F' button’ to greet all cheerful neighborhoods.
row.reviews: “short 15-minute narrative journey featuring lovely hand-drawn visuals and an emotional ending.” PocketGamer “It is quite intriguing to see a developer outside of Japan lament the modern-day problems of the country and to express those concerns through a video game.” Automaton

row.name: Absent in the Rain
row.detailed_description: A visual novel about a mysterious senpai and a suspicious case A mysterious senpai. A serial murder case that has taken the world by storm. And a giant, shadowy fish swimming at my feet... What if all of them are connected and surround me like a circle? What should I do? ◆Outline Genre : Visual Novel Play time : about 60 minutes Ending : 2 endings + 1 extra scene ◆Staff Scenario : Tsubakichi Illustrations : Kato, Milk Music : Aioi Aoha Video : Hayu, Ashinai Apoda Logo/UI/WEB design : B1ack Apric0t Script : Toritsukiyarou, B1ack Apric0t Direction : Pirumu, Joey English Localization : Marta Güell Chinese Localization : 346lab Localization Spanish Localization : Shinzou translations French Localization : wapiaclm Production : D10RAMA
