row.name: L30-P4RD
row.detailed_description: L30-p4rd Is Singleplayer, top-down Shooter You explore planets as a member of the L30-P4RD, a special force that pioneered planets for civilization. Grab your gear and select your ability. Don't die. There's a mission you must have to do. features - 20 Distinctive Weapons, 7 Armor - 3 Classes, 37 passive skills and 15 active skills - Create your own build using skillpoints that can be used regardless of class - Simple missions
row.short_description: L30-P4RD is Sci-Fi Top-down shooter. You explore planets as a member of the L30-P4RD, a special force that pioneered planets for civilization.

row.name: Attic Panic
row.detailed_description: Get ready to enter a world of madness and mayhem in Attic Panic , a thrilling online party shooter with rogue-like elements . In this top-down shooter , every round presents you with a wicked assortment of randomized upgrade cards , ensuring a heart-pounding experience that will keep you hooked. Whether you crave the thrill of shielding yourself from enemy fire, bouncing bullets off walls, or unleashing a storm of otherworldly destruction upon your foes, Attic Panic offers a playstyle for everyone! Play as a possessed toy, controlled by the sinister Lovecraftian beast 'The Entity', and battle for supremacy in the dusty confines of a suburban attic. Armed with a devastating arsenal of weapons and abilities, you'll engage in intense shootouts, gathering upgrade cards and unlocking unique powers as you strive to become the most powerful follower of 'The Entity'. Summon up to three of your fearless friends and plunge headfirst into the abyss of madness today. With it's free-to-play model and addictive gameplay, Attic Panic stands as an indispensable addition to any collection of party games. So, heed the call and prove your worth to 'The Entity' today. Join the battle, for the hour of reckoning is upon us!
row.short_description: Attic Panic is a 2-4 player top-down supernatural rogue-like shooter where you play as possessed toys that battle each other to entertain the Entity, which grants players unique powers and abilities at the end of each round.

row.name: Morendo
row.detailed_description: Morendo The musical term morendo means that passages in a piece of music should be performed 'dying'. Morendo is a point & click adventure game about a concert guitarist whose life takes dramatic turns after his performance. Join him and meet peculiar characters that are waiting for you in the Voyeur. Interact with them and step behind the curtain of betrayal, lust and the facade of show business. This game was developed in a game jam, within 48 hours. Enjoy the real sounds of live recorded guitars and immerse yourself in the macabre, hand-drawn world of Morendo.
row.short_description: Let Morendo pull you into a dark vortex of lies, betrayal, lust and gluttony. Join a concert guitarist on his journey into the abyss.
row.notes: Throughout the game, the player follows the main protagonist on his journey into the abyss. He will engage with a female barmaid and experience sexual encounters. There are fistfights and alcohol consumption in the game. As the game progresses, suicide and blood can be seen.

row.name: TRACHI – ANARCHY
row.detailed_description: ANARCHY combines Tactical RPG combat with real-time Exploration – wrapped in a story about artificial freedom. TRACHIAN Dialogue lends a voice for people who don't exist . – Reality is crazy – Picture a world inside a screen. Fifteen years of fictional history. A scene and another scene. Forward, backward – save, reload, restart. It's the same people doing the same things all over again. There's the screen turning black. Goodbye Trachi 1923, hello Aion 19– Wait, what was that? I swear I heard a crack. Is my mind playing tricks on me? Or did that world just die? – Continuity – What year is it, actually? There's names and people I recognize. This place, though: not how it used to be. Don't get me started on the voice in my head. It's pushing me, as if it knew where I should go. One way or the other, I'll find out what's going on! The world and its people. Present, past and future. Above all else – I want to understand who I'm talking to right now.
row.short_description: Artificial dreams for artificial people. A character-driven, hub-based role-playing game.
row.notes: Fabtasy violence without blood. Profane language.

row.name: CantEscapeTheBackrooms
row.detailed_description: DESCRIPTION CantEscapeTheBackrooms is a Singleplayer horror game, where you will fight on your own to escape the different levels of the backrooms, solving puzzles and find your way out. Explore each room look for elements that might help you to go further. The further you come the more dangerous it will be. Becareful danger lurks around every corner don't be careless Or it'll be over sooner than you think. There are many Entities trying to kill you and your friends, so watch out for them! CantEscapeTheBackrooms is based on the popular creepypasta. LEVELS CantEscapeTheBackrooms offers 4 different and unique levels with different difficulty and different ways to pass these levels. ENTITIES In CantEscapeTheBackrooms you will find many different entities all based on the original creepypasta like Skinstealers, Bacterias, Dullers, Kitty and Smilers. {STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/CantEscapeTheBackrooms.gif
row.short_description: CantEscapeTheBackrooms is a single player horror game. Explore numerous treacherous and dangerous levels, avoid contact with evil entities, and do whatever it takes to find your way out!

row.name: GPRO - Classic racing manager
row.detailed_description: GPRO is a classic long term racing strategy game where your planning, money management and data collection skills are being put to the test. The aim of the game is to reach the top Elite group and win the world championship. But to do so you will need to progress through the levels with many ups and downs. You will be managing a racing driver and a car and you will be in charge of preparing setups and strategy for the race, much like Christian Horner or Toto Wolff do in Formula 1. It will be your job to give your driver the best car, while working with your staff, but you will also have to spend your money wisely. Collect telemetry data from the races you do in order to improve your game and give yourself an advantage over your rivals next time you visit a certain track. You can also join together with your friends to form an alliance and compete in the teams championship, while working together to improve your understanding of the game. Each season in the game spans over roughly 2 months with races being simulated live two times per week (Tuesday and Friday from 20:00 CET). While the game does not require you to be online during the races to participate, watching them unfold live and chatting to fellow managers adds to the fun. In case you miss a live race, you can view a replay of the race at any time. If you are a big fan of F1 and motorsports and like manager and multiplayer games, then join now for free and be part of a fantastic game and a great and friendly motorsport community!
row.short_description: Manage your racing team, driver and a car, prepare setups and strategy for every race, plan your season and budget, analyze race telemetry.

row.name: Fishing With The Homies
row.detailed_description: Set Out On A Quest to Rule the Ponds! Fishing with the Homies is a surreal Fishing Simulation Game where you fish your way across several ponds and lakes to catch all of the fish you can! Armed with what could charitably be called a fishing rod, you will hone your angling skills to best each pond’s established fishermen and gather new equipment. Looting the Waters However, you can’t catch these fish with just your hands! (Well, some people can, but you never managed to do it.) Instead, your fishing rod, line, reel and bobber will help you conquer the ponds and fish up the wonders of the world! These fish won’t simply sit there as you real them in, once you have one hooked you’ll need to tire them out before you can reel them in. Pay attention to what direction the fish is trying to swim in and use your Arrow Keys to fight against them. Remember to keep an eye on your line, as they will put a large amount of tension on it as they fight back, and may even snap the line if you aren’t careful. Fish don’t seem to be the only things in the water though. There are a few shadows in the water that don’t quite look like fish, but it's not clear what they are. Maybe fishing them up as well will help you in some way. The Lurking Legend But be warned, young fisher, for not everything is as it seems. While it seems like everything is sunshine and rainbow trout, there is a great darkness that lies just beneath the surface. Perhaps it is your destiny to finally uncover these very reel threats…or maybe you’re out of your depth.
row.short_description: Begin your fishing journey in this surreal angling experience! Be wary though, the current masters of these ponds might not respond kindly to a rookie fisherman appearing on their turf. Can you uncover the secrets that lurk beneath the surface and rise to the top of this fintastic experience?

row.name: The Archipelago
row.detailed_description: When the world falls apart, what will you make with the ruins? The Archipelago is a visual novel about brewing tea. The teas you choose determine who you encounter in the midst of a vibrant and changing world. The game takes place in a floating archipelago. Once a single island, thirty years ago it broke into pieces, separating lovers and families. Those who remain can communicate only through the Messengers: flying mail deliverers with lofty ambitions of their own. You make tea for whoever needs it, and in exchange ask only to listen in on their conversations. Depending on the flavours in your brew, different people show up to your café, giving you the chance to witness different dialogues - and to watch from different perspectives as the Archipelago's inhabitants contend with trauma, change and hope.
row.short_description: The Archipelago is a visual novel about brewing tea. The teas you choose determine who you encounter in the midst of a vibrant and changing world.

row.name: Pebble Feel
row.detailed_description: Pebble Feel is a personal air conditioner equipped with a highly efficient Peltier element that can heat or cool the neck. A smartphone with this app is connected to the Pebble Feel, a personal air conditioner via Bluetooth, switching between heating/cooling and intensity is available.
row.short_description: Pebble Feel is a personal air conditioner equipped with a highly efficient Peltier element that can heat or cool the neck. A smartphone with this app is connected to the Pebble Feel, a personal air conditioner via Bluetooth, switching between heating/cooling and intensity is available.

row.name: Hexa Rhythm
row.detailed_description: 森の中で暮らす錬金術師の女の子の「無法ちゃん」…。あなたはそんな彼女の助手をしています。 ある日、無法ちゃんは「安価な物から金銀財宝を生み出す」ことに成功します！でも、それが神様の怒りに触れてしまったようで…。 神様が「神獣」をけしかけて錬金を妨害してきてしまいます！ 助手であるあなたは、襲ってくる神獣たちから彼女を守り抜いてください！ でも、どうやって守ればいいんでしょう？あなたは守れる力を持っていませんし…。 大丈夫！なんたって無法ちゃんは錬金術師！アクシデントを解決できる魔法の一つや二つは習得しています！ ただ、錬金中はうまく狙いがつけられない様子…。 なのであなたがすることは、無法ちゃんがうまく神獣を倒せるように、指示を送ることです！ うまく守り切れば、とんでもないモノが生まれるかも…！？ 襲ってくる神獣を撃退しよう！ 神獣は錬金窯を中心に、周囲6方向から襲ってきます！一方で、無法ちゃんは3方向に同時に魔法を撃てます！ あなたはボタン操作で無法ちゃんに指示を送り、狙いを合わせて魔法を発射する指示を送りましょう！ ただし「色」に注意！神獣や魔法には色があり、その色が合っていないと撃退することができません！ 方向と色を意識して、神獣を撃退しましょう！ リズムにノって操作しよう！ こう見えて、無法ちゃんは都会育ちの音楽好き！ なので、リズムにノって指示を送らないと、機嫌を損ねて指示を聞いてくれません…。 バックで流れる音楽のリズムにノリながら操作して、ノリノリで指示を送りましょう！ ただし、他のリズムゲームみたいに'ノーツ'なんて指示はありません！ 自分の中でビートを刻んで、自分なりに音楽にノってみましょう！ 意識することはたくさん！ なので、意識することはたくさんあります！ 神獣が襲ってくる6つのレーン、魔法を放つ3つの方向、 神獣と魔法の色、さらに音楽のリズムまで…。 最初はてんやわんやになってしまうかもしれません。 でもそれら全てが噛み合うようになった時、最高に気持ちいい体験ができること間違いなしです！ うまく守り切れると… 最後まで無法ちゃんを守り切れれば、錬金の成果が最後に現れます！ その成果はどれだけうまく守れたかによって変わるとか…？ 誰よりもとんでもないモノを作り上げて、SNSで皆に自慢してみましょう！
row.short_description: 錬金術師の女の子「無法ちゃん」と、彼女の錬金術を邪魔する「神獣」。襲ってくる神獣を、音楽のリズムにノリながら撃退する、新感覚「リズム防衛シューティングゲーム」！周囲6方向から襲ってくる神獣を、3方向に撃てる魔法を使って撃退しましょう！ただし、操作はリズムに合わせて！音楽のリズムにノリながら、ノリノリで操作してみましょう！どこから神獣が来るかを見張る「防衛」の忙しさと、音楽のリズムにノる「リズム」の気持ちよさ、それらが合わさり、最高の体験を生み出す新感覚リズムゲーム！

row.name: Lam Lam
row.detailed_description: Game Introduction This story is based on real events 'I', as the protagonist, is a freelance illustrator who works hard every day. Because of some previous experiences 'I' are not keen on communicating with others. Therefore, 'I' chose to stay at home all day, avoiding any socialization and annoying situations. One night, 'I' noticed that the neighbor's Room F was making some noise as usual. Just at this moment, I heard the cry of a girl from Room F. 'I' was curious about what was going on, so 'I' used my superpowers to see what was going on next door. What awaits the 'me' will be a heinous and heartbreaking scene. What should the 'me' do...   What to do In Lam Lam, you play as 'I', as the protagonist. You have 3 days to save Lam lam from her terrible parents. You can talk with different characters in other to get information about Lam lam, such as Lam lam, Mr and Mrs Kong the neighbour, Mr Cheung the security and Ms. Poon the teacher. Also you can use the super power to search particular locations. Remember, your choices and actions would affect how the story ended. Game Features - 6 distinctive CGs -Part of the background material comes from the real scene - Simple and clear operation - Multiple endings: he*3, de*2, be*1
row.short_description: One night, 'I' noticed that the neighbor was making some noise as usual. Just at this moment, I heard the cry of a girl from Room F. 'I' used my superpowers to see what was going on next door. What awaits the 'me' will be a heinous and heartbreaking scene.
row.notes: This game includes plot of domestic violence , child abuse and death of child.

row.name: Wolfteam: Reboot
row.detailed_description: FPS, more than that. Wolfteam is a game where you can enjoy a variety of team formations and battlefield situations that change from moment to moment, such as humans and wolves, wolves and wolves, through the keyword werewolves, beyond human-to-human battles. Experience the appearance of powerful and explosive werewolves that you couldn't feel in conventional FPS, and enjoy explosive action while avoiding their teeth and claws. [Worldview] The basic concept is the conflict and combat between terrorists with the WOLF gene, as well as the special forces composed of humans with the WOLF gene, centering on anti-epoxy that maximizes the human's WOLF gene to elicit strong power. Experience the FPS battle to the next level through battles of special abilities beyond humans. [Face your inner Wolf-WOLF transformation] Jump Higher, Run Faster, Climb the Wall, Slay the Human with Stronger Power. You can transform into a wolf while playing, or start playing as a wolf. The combination of humans and wolves allows you to respond more organically to a variety of battlefields, and utilizes the wolf's mobility and flexibility to infiltrate into places where the enemy cannot be prepared. [Adapt to the changing battlefield-WP system] You can select new weapon combinations that have been preset. Dominate the battlefield by setting weapon combinations to suit various situations, and transforming yourself to suit the battle situation. In the world of WOLFTEAM:CLASSIC, only those who adapt can survive. [Various and attractive characters] Special forces trained from all over the world, and terrorists faithful to their desires await you. The characters of the Wolf Team not only have their own stats and characteristics, but also have special abilities when transforming into Wolf, so you need to watch carefully at all times. [Map that reproduces the world's local appearance] The Wolfteam's worldview depicts the battles of special forces and abilities around the world. Accordingly, characteristic streets and landmarks of various regions such as Europe, Turkey, and South America are reproduced intact in the game. [Wofteam's unique mode] In WOLFTEAM, you can play even the basic mode that you enjoyed in the existing FPS with a new feel. Humans and Wolf have completely different attack, defense points, movement paths, and attack ranges and effects, so existing modes such as Death Match and Position Control can be played with new strategies. In addition, you can prove your skills in new modes only available in WOLFTEAM, such as Ice Hold and Wolf Hunt! ▼ Wolfteam Reboot on the Discord:
row.short_description: Wolfteam is a game where you can enjoy a variety of team formations and battlefield situations that change from moment to moment, such as humans and wolves, wolves and wolves, through the keyword werewolves, beyond human-to-human battles.

row.name: Lumien
row.detailed_description: More than 60 students of the Media Informatics and Interactive Entertainment program at Mittweida University of Applied Sciences have developed their own game within 11 months - Lumien. Lumien is a fast-paced third-person platformer in which you explore the ruins of an ancient civilization and breathe life back into it. On your way past the various defenses, you'll be helped by the Orbs, fueled by the mysterious powers of the civilization. Rapid Platforming To match the existing dangers, you'll have to acquire the civilization's technology, through various abilities. These will let you advance faster and faster and overcome previously insurmountable obstacles. Unique Orbs Beyond the diverse movement abilities, you'll be able to use various orbs. These orbs work both as an extension of your movement and as your best means to dodge enemies. You'll be able to send them in specific directions and then activate them manually to unleash their special powers. Interactive Obstacles On your way, traps and enemies await you, which will try to stop you. You'll encounter spike traps, guided by the self-defense system of civilization. But those obstacles can also bring you closer to your goal if you manipulate them cleverly. Additionally, with the orbs you can have an influence on the state of the level, which can disable traps or allow you to bypass them completely. Key Features Simultaneous coordination of up to two orbs with unique abilities An interactive environment that you can manipulate with the help of the orbs Fast-paced third-person platforming with a dash of action An underground civilization characterized by a mysterious knowledge network
row.short_description: Lumien is a fast-paced third-person platformer in which you explore the ruins of an ancient civilization and breathe life back into it. On your way past the various defenses, you'll be helped by the Orbs, fueled by the mysterious powers of the civilization.

row.name: BioFusion
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord Community About the Game BioFusion is a VR co-op multiplayer, PvE, first-person shooter, tower defense game. You play as a Soldier or a Strategist. As a Soldier, you grapple, shoot, throw grenades from the ground, air, or on a hovercraft. As a Strategist, you build walls, towers, traps, wielding a bow and a saber. You collect DNA buffs along the way to specialize your hero. Together you defend the Spores of Evolution from hordes of the evil HW corporation. With multiple heroes, verdant landscapes, and new game mechanics not seen before in a VR action-tower defense game. Locomotion options include smooth, teleport, head-based, controller-based, arm-swing, and more. Comfort features include Vignette, Teleport, Snap turning, Arm swing locomotion. Includes native Meta Quest with Link and Steam VR support. Features: Play with up to 3 friends 2 playable heroes: Soldier and Strategist 7 scenes: Tutorial, Hangar, Orchard, City, River, Underground River, and Forest 3 difficulties: Easy, Normal, and Hard 14 DNA buffs to collect, evolve, and install Gameplay length: 20+ hours 9 enemy types A dozen weapons More than a dozen traps and towers 4 comfort features: Vignette, Teleport, Snap turning, Arm swing locomotion 8 modes of locomotion: Grappling, Climbing, Hang Gliding, Hovercraft, Driving a boat, Arm swing, Teleport, and the standard thumbstick-based movement
row.short_description: BioFusion is a VR co-op multiplayer, PvE, first-person-shooter, tower defense game. Swing on a grappling hook, ride a hovercraft, throw grenades, collect buffs, build towers and traps. Do what you must to keep the mutants from the Spores of Evolution.

row.name: Cult, Chapter One
row.detailed_description: Cult is a short, single player, first person horror game experience with an interactive storyline to keep you up for nights. A story of sacrifice only few could conquer. CULT IS... - An interactive story to keep you locked in to the spine-chilling gameplay. - A game where you must constantly be on the look out for the different types of enemies, you can't fight... so running is your best friend. - A game of stealth. Keep quiet, sneak past enemies and find what you cant leave without. - Deceiving Find batteries and notes to make progress, just be careful who you trust. Cult contains instances of strong language and gore.
row.short_description: Find what you came for and escape, before they get what they want...
row.notes: This game consists of horror scenes, strong language and voilence

row.name: Astonishing Basketball Manager
row.detailed_description: Astonishing Basketball is the basketball manager game of your dreams. Become the coach of your own team and lead your players to the ultimate reward: the Basketball Cup! 🏀 Main Features ★In-depth basketball manager game with a lot of cool stats. You're the coach! ★Many game modes, so you can play just as you want! ★Player story mode with 'The Prodigy', from star of the campus to Hall of Famer ★Manage your basketball arena, scouts and staff ★Narrative gameplay with a deep lore ★Community-created rosters and draft classes Astonishing Basketball Manager is not your usual basketball game. It's not only about stats and ratings. It's not just drafting prospects, trading players, exploring strategies and signing stars, or building a dynasty. In this game, you're writing your own basketball gm and coach life story with one goal in mind: win the Cup. A living world ABK features a deeply simulated world. Fans are posting about your team. Players send you messages about their contract. Or you might have to decide what's for dinner. Not even mentioning the scary coach Regina Dargor! You're the basketball manager! Step into the game, call for a timeout, and replace your tired veterans with some young talented players to dunk on the other team, or ask them to defend the paint more tightly! Adapt your strategy and coaching systems to feed your shooting guard more or prevent the other center from rebounding too much. All your choices have consequences. Build a Dynasty The training system makes it even more important to scout college basketball players from a multitude of universities, and draft future stars to create the ultimate team! Don't forget to build your arena and add shops to attract more fans to the game.. Become a social medias star Follow the scoreboard, the rankings, and the reactions from the fans, reporters and players. Or write on social medias using the team's account! Train your players, from drafted rookies to all-stars, it's your job as basketball manager and coach to find the rookies who have the potential to become legendary basketball stars and build a dynasty with the best strategy.
row.short_description: The ultimate basketball manager game. Become the best coach of the league and build your own basketball dynasty!

row.name: Missing Pieces
row.detailed_description: Missing Pieces is a story-driven adventure in a vibrant alien world, full of hidden secrets, a plethora of languages and a sparkling cast of characters: lovable rogues, heartbroken families, and questionable allies. Find friendship and love, learn about yourself and discover who you really are! A brilliant scientist travels to an alien planet in a galaxy far away. What initially begins as a journey for a better life quickly turns into a nightmare of challenges. Stranded on an unfamiliar planet, lost and misunderstood, you yearn to return home. If only your capsule hadn’t crashed when it arrived … The compelling narrative is interwoven with puzzles rooted in the alien cultures around you: deciphering cryptic alien languages, harnessing the power of alien artifacts, both ancient and new, and learning to play the instrument of beings with no discernible mouths or limbs. If only you had all the missing pieces to fix your capsule, you could finally be on your way home. But will that be your fulfillment?
row.short_description: Missing Pieces is a story-driven adventure in a vibrant alien world, full of hidden secrets, a plethora of languages and a sparkling cast of characters: lovable rogues, heartbroken families, and questionable allies. Find friendship and love, learn about yourself and discover who you really are!

row.name: Boot Camp Endless Runner
row.detailed_description: Glad to present to your attention a new game Endless Runner. The essence of the game is the need to hold out as long as possible on the platform, overcoming obstacles and increasing your rating. The game features 1 level of difficulty: the number of which will continue to increase. Good luck everyone. I'll meet you in the game.
row.short_description: Free to play, Endless Runner. Dodge Obstacles and collect Ammo

row.name: Handshakes
row.detailed_description: Handshakes is a short and sweet puzzler where you must guide two hands towards their goal of a warm, firm handshake. Play by yourself, or share your keyboard/controller with a friend and play through 30 puzzles that are designed to stretch your brain, not strain it.
row.short_description: Take your brain for a walk in Handshakes, a simple yet tricksy sokoban puzzle game. Guide two hands through puzzles designed to stump, not frustate, so that they may achieve their dream of a warm, firm handshake.
row.reviews: “Handshakes is embelic of the hidden gems that make up Steam’s gigantic library. Whilst it isn't overflowing with content, it executes a simple concept flawlessly, boasting an adorably endearing art direction and general game flow to boot.” Through a Console, Darkly “Most importantly, Handshakes is a strand game. Like Death Stranding, it's about making connections between characters. Death Stranding gamified that by tasking Sam Porter Bridges with hauling deliveries across uneven terrain and building infrastructure. In Handshakes, the yellow fellows are the characters and their bodies are the infrastructure facilitating the connection.” The Gamer

row.name: Jotunn - Day of Judgement
row.detailed_description: Start your journey... Jotunn is a small First-Person-Horror experience . Set in a dark and mysterious norse forest, the player is tasked with activating multiple magic runestones to open the Serpent-Gate and to escape the mystical forest. Explore a mysterious dark scandinavian Forest in First-Person both at night and day. Hide and flee the Jotunn, a vicious creature, stalking the forest at night. Stay low and evade getting cought while exploring the forest. Gather your strength at the small forest hut, the only save place from the Jotunn. Sleep here to change the time of day. Search for the ominous Runestones, hidden at different locations across the forest and activate them to gather Odins strength and to find a way to open a gate, leading to safety. But be aware, for the stones can only be activated at night, when the Jotunn haunts the woods. Words from the developer Hi everyone! Thanks for your interest in Jotunn - Day of Judgement. As the developer, I believe that transparency towards the player is the key feature for a good game and a healthy community. Since I am a solo developer, the content of the game is somewhat limited, the performance not optimal (hence the crazy system requirements) and the balancing still not perfect. Still, I did not want to mark this title as Early Access, since I found this misleading since I'm not really planning for too many Updates. Apart from that, I would appreciate every piece of feedback. Share your ideas for improvement, better balancing or anything that comes to mind. As a single person, my capacitites in the fields of balancing and performance testing on multiple devices are somewhat limited. Therefore I am happy about every piece of information I can get. Since Jotunn is very short and not perfect, everyone should have the opportunity to play this game for free (should be obvious) I am looking forward to making more, longer and better games in the future and I am exciting for the upcoming journey!
row.short_description: Alone you find yourself stranded in a dark and mysterious norse forest, tasked by the gods to acitvate the forests magical runestones to open the Serpent-Gate. But you are not alone. A vicious creature lurks in the shadows of the misty forest...

row.name: Light & Shadow
row.detailed_description: When a star falls in a nearby forest, it spurs Po onto a quest to find that light and bring it into their life. Welcome to Light & Shadow, a narrative-driven 2D platformer in shadow puppet form, where you face your anxieties, climb out of depression, and find the moments of joy in a grey world. You'll puppeteer Po through 26 levels spread over 5 Biomes, where you will collect music notes and seek out key special moments in each level, which will help you push back the manifestations of Anxiety and Depression which will obscure your view and slow you down on your quest to find the star. Inspired by “Po's Climb,” a shadow puppet performance by Sequoia Erickson, and in collaboration with Shadowland Theatre, Light & Shadow features an art style heavily relying on the trappings of a shadow puppet show. The cutscenes are recordings of live puppet shows, which tie the world together. In support of the main concepts of dealing with anxiety and depression, Light & Shadow was built in collaboration with mental health professionals and a youth advisory committee, to evaluate the themes and moments in the game in order to ensure they were portrayed accurately and effectively. Leaning heavily into a linear narrative, and inspired by the creative team's film and theater backgrounds, Light & Shadow takes you (and Po) on a journey of hope and heartbreak, excitement and anxiety. Finding your way isn't always easy, keep going! Features: -25 Levels -5 Different Biomes -Unique Layered Musical Health System -List of Mental Health Resources
row.short_description: When a star falls in a nearby forest, it spurs Po onto a quest to find that light and bring it into their life. Light & Shadow is a shadow puppet platformer where you face your anxieties, push past depression, and seek moments of joy in a grey world. Finding your way isn't always easy, keep going!

row.name: DEATHWATCH - PRELUDE
row.detailed_description: DEATHWATCH Sequel 4 Player CO-OP - Wishlist Now DEATHWATCHERS is a 4 Player Co-Op take on the spot the difference style horror genre is now available to wishlist! About the Game DEATHWATCH - PRELUDE is a horror game in which you are tasked to observe haunted locations, log supernatural events and eradicate any potential paranormal threats. DEATHWATCH - PRELUDE is the prelude to DEATHWATCH and gives you access to play the first level as many times as you'd like. You'll need to keep a keen eye on every camera and even your present location for any supernatural occurences. Possible events vary from Audio to Victims and paranormal sightings, plus many more. Using your computer systems you must log each event to gather enough data to eliminate the entity, before it eliminates you! DEATHWATCH - PRELUDE puts you in a vulnerable state where your only chance of survival is to succesfully log enough supernatural events in order to survive the night. You need to constantly be aware of your own surroundings because you may not be the only one observing. Full Twitch integration, view your live chat in game while your viewers observe with you and potentially disrupt or even aid your playthrough. The location contains 100's of events so no two playthroughs are ever the same.
row.short_description: You've been tasked to observe supposedly haunted locations. Observe and log paranormal events and use the tools at your disposal to gather data on any potential paranormal threats and exterminate them if necessary.
row.notes: Human limbs, dead bodies and various blood textures. No actual depictions of gorey violence.

row.name: Unified
row.detailed_description: Unified is a short, 2,596 word kinetic (linear, no choices) visual novel about universal consciousness. Everything is connected via a conscious intelligence that runs the universe. It's about dropping the ego - the idea of being a person itself. There is political, religious, and other unsavory topics too. The writing is not typical. There are functionally no characters in this story. You'll probably laugh at some point but the novel is mostly serious in tone. Features: • 20-30 min maximum reading time • Absolutely no choices to be made • 16 Drawings made using vectors • Gummy Worms
row.short_description: Unified is a short, 2,596 word kinetic (linear, no choices) visual novel about universal consciousness. Everything is connected viaa a conscious intelligence that runs the universe. It's about dropping the ego - the idea of being a person itself.
row.notes: Murder, blood, light descriptions of gore, suggestive logos

row.name: Elong Plug
row.detailed_description: LENGTHY Game Description Explore a sky-high city in this 20-40min adventure game where you play as a plug trying to become as long as LORD ELON. Climbing, dangling, and stretching around buildings may be the only way other pluggers will let you in their pool parties. LENGTHY Features -Collect coins and buy yourself length upgrades -Find hidden items and deliver them to plug city citizens -Chat with fellow pluggers -Climb, dangle, and stretch around buildings using your plug cord -Explore a sky high city -Wear cosmetic hats to brag about your height LENGTHY Credits Aria Mohebi, Ben Greenhalgh, Francisca Chonlong, Julio Cesar, Judy Kim, Chris Steinkampf, Paul Ouzounov, Amir Esmaeeli, Arisa Lutic-Hotta, Saina Tahooni, Steven O'Brien
row.short_description: Play as an elastic plug trying to become as long as LORD ELON. Use your climbing, dangling, and stretching skills to collect coins and buy length upgrades. Will LORD ELON accept you?
row.reviews: “An excellent depiction of the dangers of chasing a longer length.” My Mom

row.name: Tincho Aventuras a la Carta
row.detailed_description: Tincho the capybara has just discovered there's more to eat than grass. In this 2D platformer adventure, Tincho travels across different regions of Argentina to explore its cuisine and help prepare traditional dishes. Explore levels inspired by real-life landscapes, search for the right ingredients, and team up with native animals like Wadu the penguin, the caiman, and the coati. Each one has a role in the kitchen: chopping, mixing, or cooking. If you do everything in the right order, you'll complete the dish and move on! This short game includes two playable characters and sample levels to try out the minigames, humor, and educational style of the game. Perfect for platformer fans looking for a cultural twist.
row.short_description: A 2.5D platformer where you explore Argentine cuisine by collecting ingredients and completing recipes with the help of native animals.

row.name: ANGEL DROID
row.detailed_description: Inspired by hundreds of games ranging from Chrono Trigger, Zelda, Final Fantasy, Morrowind & Oblivion, 90s Star Wars games, Mega Man, Metroid, Phantasy Star 4, and even newer games like Outer Wilds, Hades, Vampire Survivors, and Sea of Stars, Angel Droid is the culmination and incarnation of the love and joy experienced through all those games. Our love and admiration for the developers that pioneered the 90s golden age of video games is the core of this project. Angel Droid exists as a love letter to all the developers that came before us. The inspiration given from those blessed developers and musicians and artists have accumulated to a point of bursting, and Angel Droid is the direct representation of all that positive energy. Though Angel Droid's development is incomplete, the game is still enjoyable to play as an experiment borne of passion and wonder. The game has been priced at 99¢ because that is the lowest price that can be listed on Steam without making the game completely free. I, the developer, never cared about the money. I don't want this game to show up on free game playlists. This game was not meant to be played by the masses. This game was meant to serve as a love letter to all the devs, musicians, and artists I respect (albeit being incomplete and quirky in the game's current state). No popular game was created by one person. This game is no exception, but it comes pretty close to being completed by a one-man-army. With the exception of the Angel Droid's concept art, and the 3D model of the Angel Droid, everything seen, heard, & coded into Angel Droid was created by one person. Angel Droid was developed in 10 months, and the development was halted because I found out my wife was pregnant. Luna, if you're reading this Steam page, I love you, and I cannot express how excited I am now that you're finally here. You probably won't have fun playing Angel Droid when you're a teenager, however I hope Angel Droid shows you how much fun I had developing video games before you became my ultimate pride and joy.
row.short_description: Angel Droid is an unfinished experiment that explores a crafting system inspired by Elder Scrolls, Magicka, Vampire Survivors, and many more. This game is rough around the edges, and now exists as a home to the developer's original soundtrack written 15 years before the game's release.

row.name: Lila's Tale and The Hidden Forest Playtest
Wolfskin's Curse
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Belorov. You stay the night in a walled town with your travelling companion. Terrible affairs of the past leave you two lost, left with no choice. The master of the town has invited you and three others to partake in a banquet on All Hallows' Eve. But as the moon wanes, the scent of fresh blood can be smelled as a scream punctures the night. Your companion has been accused of murder: after all, he's beginning to take on a monstrous form, and the easiest option would be to blame him. The curse brings with it deceit. Can you prove his innocence to these strangers? You have until sundown. Wolfskin's Curse is a fully voice-acted, kinetic (linear with no choices) story. It ranked 13th out of 113 entries in the Spooktober 3rd Annual Visual Novel Game Jam and was developed over the course of September 2021. Format: Kinetic Novel - NO BRANCHING CHOICES. Genre: Gothic Horror, Mystery, Romance, Supernatural Length : ~15k words Language : English Playtime : 1-2 hours
row.short_description: A forsaken nun must prove a monster's innocence. He is offered no voice, but she will lend hers. Wolfskin's Curse is a fully-voice acted, linear visual novel.
row.notes: Content Warnings: depictions of blood, disturbing imagery, alcohol references, violence, mild language, suggestive themes

row.name: Run Blob Run 2
row.detailed_description: You will play as a Cute and Hapless Character named Blob. Help them to navigate MULTIPLE LEVELS and WORLDS to reach the crown and Rule the Land. RBR2 has simple controls, yet challenging obstacles with a Seconds Timer attached to each level so you can constantly strive to improve your best time. Overcome these obstacles, Beat the bosses, collect coins and Be Fast About It!
row.short_description: A Casual, 2D Platformer in which the player must overcome obstacles to beat the level as fast as possible.

row.name: Joy Flight
row.detailed_description: Only Oculus/Quest VR Supported Motion Controls - Turn on the engine, crank the throttle and grab the flight stick using your VR hands. Huge Open World - Explore an expansive island chain with 29 distinct island runways to unlock. Dynamic Weather System - Skirt the waves, dodge lightning and enjoy the rain as you fly through the storm with the dynamic weather system. Free Flight - Fly around the world with no limits, explore into the clouds and beyond. Customise Your Aircraft - Choose your own color scheme and fly 3 different light aircraft. Flight Missions - Pick up passengers and test your skills by delivering them to their destination and earn your place on the leaderboard.
row.short_description: Joy Flight is an open world arcade VR flight game where players will explore, unlock runways with daring landings and complete missions across a large chain of islands! Free to Play

row.name: The Heart Defenders
row.detailed_description: Ahoy adventurer! This is a traditional builder defender game where you have the task to survive as long as you can and don't let that heart stop beating. A demonic force of evil is attacking you. Build harvesters, and churches, and then defend them with towers so the hearth can survive. But be aware... The longer you survive the more evil forces will try to end you. How many waves of evil will you survive? Feel like you are up to the challenge? You will have to place buildings on the map to gather resources. With that resource you will be able to build towers that will defend your heart from demonic eyes. After each wave of enemies, their numbers will increase. So you will need to be smart and efficient with your placement. The resources you can harvest are stones, wood, and, souls. Master the map and its resources and you will have an excellent chance to survive for a long time. Key Features Strategy Build Resource
row.short_description: Building defender 2D strategy game! Place building and gather resources. Use the resources you collect to then build towers that will defend your heart in the middle of the map. Survive as many levels as you can manage! Good luck!

row.name: Couroland
row.detailed_description: 'Couroland' is a Idle RPG game, with daily tasks that can be completed in as little as 15 minutes. The game tries to avoid short periods of time-limited activity, and instead leaves as much time as possible for the player to arrange. The game design is simple and easy to use, very suitable for office workers to play at leisure! 【 Core Gameplay 】 Develop characters, collect illustrations, collaborate socially (The game has a world level,and is very friendly to new players) 【Occupation】 Swordsman, Warrior, Mage, Priest, Ranger Players can choose one as the main character and two as partners to adventure together 【Equipment Collection】 The player can drop random quality items in numerous Dungeon by killing bosses Excess equipment can also be collected as a guide 【 Skills Matching 】 Facing different kinds of enemies, players can switch between different class characters and customize skill combinations 【 Multiplayer Interaction 】 Players can form a family or alliance with their friends, and work together to fight Dungeon and battlefields. 【 Market Transaction 】 Players can sell the surplus materials they collect to the market, while buying the materials sold by other players in the market
row.short_description: 'Couroland' is a Idle RPG game, The game design is simple and easy to use, very suitable for office workers to play at leisure!
row.notes: Some of the characters in the game are slightly naked

row.name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom
row.detailed_description: WHICH EDITION IS RIGHT FOR ME? WHICH EDITION IS RIGHT FOR ME? The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Necrom and The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Necrom includes the base game, Necrom and all previous Chapters ( High Isle, Blackwood, Greymoor, Elsweyr, Summerset and Morrowind ). Those who purchase the Deluxe Collection: Necrom will also receive the Deluxe in-game items. Players purchasing the Collection editions can jump right into the base game, Necrom or any previous Chapter right away. The Elder Scrolls Online Upgrade: Necrom and The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Necrom includes Necrom only, plus Deluxe in-game items for those who purchase the Deluxe Upgrade: Necrom . Digital Deluxe Edition DELUXE Those who purchase The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Necrom or The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Necrom will receive the Deluxe in-game items, including: All past Chapter Collector's Edition / Deluxe items** (only included in The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Necrom ) Hermitage Servitor mount Cipher's Eye Pocket Watcher pet Dark Lady's Headrest memento Knowledge Eater Armor outfit style Leaning / Sitting / Standing Scholar emotes **Does not include past Chapter pre-order / pre-purchase in-game items. About the Game Begin a unique adventure filled with the unparalleled storytelling and deep lore of The Elder Scrolls . Journey to Tamriel - a living, breathing, fantasy universe of magnitude, where your choices shape your experience. Battle, loot, craft, steal or role-play as an archer, mage, merchant, scholar or warrior. Play solo or with friends and combine equipment and abilities to suit your own play style. No game subscription required - buy once, play anytime. NECROM UNLOCK THE NEW CLASS - Become empowered by the secrets of Apocrypha and the forbidden knowledge of Hermaeus Mora. The Arcanist is a powerful new Class capable of destructive, restorative, or defensive magic by channelling the arcane, ancient runes, and lost tomes of power. ALL-NEW ZONES - Explore the Telvanni Peninsula, home of colossal mushrooms, arcane magic, rocky spires and the capital city of Necrom, additionally, behold the forbidden books of the endless library of Apocrypha. A COSMIC STORY - The Prince of Fate holds secrets too dangerous for mortals or Daedra to comprehend. Now hidden yet turbulent powers threaten Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha and if the Daedric Prince's secret is uncovered, it could unravel all of reality. NEW WARDEN AND ARCANIST CLASS COMPANIONS - Two new allies seek grand quests and glory! Unlock the Arcanist-power-wielding Redguard and Argonian Warden Companions to battle by your side and keep you company on your journey across Tamriel. COLLECTION† Purchase The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Necrom or The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Necrom to get instant access to all major Chapter zones, biomes and quest arcs from across Tamriel. The Collection: Necrom[i/] and Deluxe Collection: Necrom includes the base game, Necrom and all previous Chapters, as below (plus Deluxe items for those who get the Deluxe Collection: Necrom ). Necrom (NEW in 2023) Unlocks instantly: High Isle Blackwood Greymoor Elsweyr Summerset Morrowind Base game †Those who purchase The Elder Scrolls Online Upgrade: Necrom or The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Necrom will receive the Necrom Chapter - or Necrom Chapter and Deluxe items, respectively - these versions do not include the previous Chapters or the base game.
row.short_description: Traverse the Telvanni Peninsula in Morrowind and preserve secrets ascribed to the unfathomable realms of Apocrypha. Unlock the runic power of a brand-new class - the Arcanist - and fight to uphold reality itself.
row.notes: Blood and gore Sexual themes Use of alcohol Violence

row.name: JaDa Fishin'
row.detailed_description: JaDa Fishin' is a free cartoony hand-drawn fishing simulator / idle game. Zach, worlds most favorite artist, takes to the local pond to catch some fish. Little did Zach know that fishing would take on a whole new meaning when he finds all different kinds of incredible creatures. How To Play: Once the game starts, you wait for a fish to appear in a quick time event. Once Zach hooks a fish, either press 'A' on the controller, or the Space Bar, enough times to reel in the fish. If you reel in the fish in time, you will catch said fish. Features: 11+ species of fish with to capture! A hard-to-find collectable pin that changes your look! A NEW 'JaDa's Big Book O' Fishin' Book! Saving & Loading, along with a new options menu! It's free! + More free updates incoming! CREDITS: Dallen Larson / ZachJaDa Coding Contributions from: Rubio (@enzomonsalve)
row.short_description: JaDa Fishin' is a free relaxing quick-time fishing game. Collect up to 12 different types of fish on this incredible journey.

row.name: Breadsticks
row.detailed_description: Travel through the dangers in the woods as a fox boy to join afternoon tea with Mr. Bear. Use breadsticks as platforms to cross barriers! Sometimes the obstacles require speed or throwing platforms midair to overcome. Follow the guide of the flowers when lost! A cute fox character! Breastick shaped throwable platforms! Gloomy dark cave environments with pastel plants! Smooth player controls which include wall jumping and sliding! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A speed-based platformer with throwable platforms! Travel through the dangers in the woods as a fox boy to join afternoon tea with Mr. Bear.

row.name: Beer Factory - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Important note about this prologue version This version of Beer Factory is a demo. You will have free access to about 1 hour of the game. To access the rest of the content, please go to the full version available here: About the Game Beer Factory - Prologue is a business simulation and management game. Take the challenge and manage your own beer factory, employees, production lines, as well as the import and export of merchandise. logistics to Manage Manufacture usually requires a production line, some resources, storage options, and transportation. In Beer Factory - Prologue, where your goal will be to produce beer, you will need to import and store the raw materials, refine, brew in tanks, store beer, bottle it and finally send it to the client. recruit and Manage Your Employees When you want to develop your business, nothing will work better than hiring staff to help you with your day-to-day tasks. The employees in your factory can handle most jobs, but it is up to you to tell them what to do. Don't forget to monitor their progress!. a Realistic Economy Every action has a cost and it's up to you to manage your finances. From recruitment to transportation to taxes, the whole finance system in Beer Factory - Prologue has been designed to be as close to reality as possible. Customize and upgrade your factory In order to make beer, you need all kinds of machines. Once you have invested in new machinery, you will be able to exploit it, improve it, and use its maximum potential to produce even more! Then you can expand your factory to grow your business into an empire!
row.short_description: Beer Factory - Prologue is a business simulation and management game. Take the challenge and manage your own beer factory, employees, production lines, as well as the import and export of merchandise.

row.name: Demon's Wrath
row.detailed_description: Demon's Wrath is a 3D open-world role-playing game. The player explores a vast fantasy world called Crementia and can interact with non-player characters (NPCs) and fight enemies. The player, party members, and enemies use skills and spells such as a sword attack or an offensive magic spell. Party members will help you fight or pick up items for you, while enemies navigate around obstacles to attack you. The player can obtain items, such as logs, swords, and slime goo, to craft, build, or increase their combat ability. Some items can be placed in the world or can be used to craft other items. The game focuses on fighting, exploring, completing quests, building, and talking to NPCs. The main goal of the game is to fight demons who are invading your country. This game has boss fights and challenges to give progression.
row.short_description: Demon's Wrath is a 3D open-world role-playing game. The player explores a vast fantasy world called Crementia and can interact with non-player characters (NPCs) and fight enemies. The game focuses on fighting, exploring, completing quests, building, and talking to NPCs.

row.name: Unity Pomodoro
row.detailed_description: Unity Pomodoro is an open source countdown timer app created in Unity designed primarily for desktop use. Unity Pomodoro is a time management tool based on the pomodoro technique, the aim is to improve your productivity by introducing timers for both your work and break sessions. Quickly swap between the two timers to keep you on track and focused.
row.short_description: Unity Pomodoro is an open source countdown timer app created in Unity. A time management tool based on the pomodoro technique, the aim is to improve your productivity by introducing timers for both your work and break sessions. Quickly swap between the two timers to keep you on track and focused.

row.name: PAL
row.detailed_description: Maintain the engine, lights, and oxygen levels while avoiding PAL and navigating towards the mission destination. If your ship takes too much damage from asteroids, runs too low on oxygen, or uses all its fuel, you die. Utilities (engine, lights, oxygen) consume fuel, and can be turned on and off manually. If a utility breaks, it does not consume fuel, but must be fixed before it can turn on. During the mission, PAL will break your utilities and periodically search the ship's corridors. If she finds you anywhere other than the cockpit, or if you fail while repairing a utility, PAL will kill you.
row.short_description: A new mission awaits completion. Will you listen to PAL? Maintain your engine, lights, and oxygen levels while avoiding PAL and navigating towards destination

row.name: Sands of Slumber: The RPG
row.detailed_description: This campaign plays in the genre of old Final Fantasy style taking place in a highly magical and steampunk-esque technological world on the verge of all-out war. This follows the Aasimar: Ashara, Half Elves: Embra and Ish Ma'el, and Marleek (custom race): Victalyassa as they join up in the Unnamed Guild, led by a Dwarf: Drosko, to complete a task for the High King which will put all of their skills and abilities to the test. The heroes meet up outside the city of Valtaska, on the peninsula of Tanaviak , to receive the quest that will start them on a long journey to save the cycle and end the evil machinations of the 'Sand Cult' and their mysterious plans to bring about the end of the world as they know it. The quest to save the world will bring the heroes all over the peninsula and far beyond as the party interacts with Kings, High Society Nobles, Cultists, Brothel Women, Giant Flying Fire Whales, the Embodied Gods, and SO. MUCH. MORE. The Tabletop RPG is played using Dungeons and Dragons 5e, with the rulesets, D20 system, and all. The Video Game adventure is no different, incorporating all it can from the tabletop to make it as authentic to the way it was originally played as possible. You will meet various races and classes of DnD 5e and custom races and classes created by Magenth. Though the campaign in the tabletop RPG kicked off with the quest, in the video game there will be a prelude which will introduce the players to the various mechanics and types of quests which will be found throughout the game including: D20 combat and skill checks, DnD spells and abilities, and a lot of different plugins credited in the game to present the best experience to players and the most accurate to the tabletop while still remaining a video game with all the considerations... considered. We hope you very much enjoy playing with these characters the same way we do! DISCLAIMER: This game was created by a single developer that has no background in coding or art or anything really needed to make a game, while they were in school; developed with RPG Maker MZ and a lot of free/credited resources from people with actual talent and now very talented VOICE ACTORS! I just have a cool story to tell about a DND campaign that I am happy to be a player in, and take way to much notes for. More sessions will be added as time permits, at a snails pace, but I thank you for taking the time to play it. If you enjoy it, share it! Mention you found the game on Steam and get the 'Fan' role! If you enjoyed and want to donate (wow), then you can support the Patreon Here!
row.short_description: Taking place in a highly magical and steampunk-esque world on the verge of all-out war. This follows four heroes as they join up in the 'Unnamed Guild' to complete tasks for the High King which will put all of their skills, loyalties, and abilities to the test.

row.name: Piczle World of Puzzles
row.detailed_description: Do you like logic-puzzles? Of course you do , what a silly question! Piczle World of Puzzles brings together all your favourite Piczle puzzles in one addictive package! From classic nonograms to colour logic-puzzles, from challenging brain-scratchers to relaxing mind-calmers, Piczle World of Puzzles is packed to the hilt , the hilt I say,  with picture-based logic-puzzles! Piczle Cross are classic nonograms. Piczle Color Cross are colour nonograms. Piczle Colors (Currently under construction) are a brain-bending variation on regular nonograms. Piczle Lines offers relaxing pixel-art based puzzling. And…more? At Piczle Academy you won’t just learn how each logic-puzzle works or how to use the many, many gameplay options and tools at your disposal, it will also make you better at puzzling! Learn advanced techniques and challenge yourself with a series of brain-bending logic quizzes to hone your skills! There is no wrong way to play. At Piczle Academy you learn about all the different ways to enjoy the puzzles on your own terms. Whether you are a seasoned logic-puzzler or a curious beginner, Piczle World of Puzzles is for you! Create, test and share your own puzzles with the Piczle community. Or play puzzles created by other Piczle players! Use intuitive editors and get feedback on your creations to put together  Piczle World of Puzzles is free to start and offers copious amounts of free content. Daily puzzles, seasonal puzzle packs, a drip-feed of free puzzles will keep you occupied without spending a penny! For players who wish to support Score Studios, or for those hungry for even more there are DLC packages for each specific puzzle type to get more of the content you want, as well as some extras like profile stickers and puzzle themes!
row.short_description: All your favourite logic-puzzles in one feature-rich package, Piczle World of Puzzles is the ultimate in picture logic-puzzling!

row.name: Fairyside
row.detailed_description: What did Shirley do before she was a teacher at Redwood Academy? Well, she was a student first, and not even a good one! Shirley must learn to navigate her magic school while meeting new companions and slowly uncovering the horrors that lie just beyond the school grounds. Uncover all the dark truths about Luninsula in this standalone prequel to Gun Witch. Gameplay Fairyside is a story-driven procedurally generated shoot-em-up with rogue-like and RPG elements and a healthy dose of bullet hell. It features extensive replayability and engaging visual novel segments alongside cute and appealing characters. Key Features Unique levels every run Hundreds of possible builds 9+ bosses Heavy replayability Endless mode A super cute protagonist Beautiful hand-crafted pixel art Visual novel-style interludes Highly immersive storytelling Engaging characters Monster and lore journal Developer voice acting Fantastic soundtrack Controller support
row.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike shoot-em-up with lots of bullet hell featuring cute pixel art, visual novel interludes, and story-driven gameplay. Join Shirley in her journey to learn magic and survive Redwood Academy!

row.name: Agelast
row.detailed_description: Agelast is a single-player first-person horror game set in a South Korean school. You don't know why you're here, you don't even remember how you got here. Escape from school. However, something is happening at school. This school is obviously temporarily closed, but someone is there. Interact with objects and find items to find your way out. There are no puzzles except for pathfinding. This is because I believe that puzzles during horror games can disrupt the flow of the game and cause irritation. This game is conceived up to Chapter 3. Currently, only Chapter 1 has been produced. Control keys are specified in In-Game Pause (ESC). This game does not support controllers. A mouse and keyboard are required to play. Does not support 2560 x 1080 monitors. Caution) It can contain shocking scenes + This game was made by a Korean high school student. Please note this.
row.short_description: Agelast is a horror game set in Korea, played from the perspective of a student in a difficult situation. Find a way out and interact as you progress through the story. There are no puzzles.

row.name: ARGH!
row.detailed_description: Ahoy sailors! Welcome to ARGH! , a 3D Battle Royale where you will have to come up with the best strategies to survive. Navigate your boat skillfully and be ready to explore every nook and cranny of the map! As you explore, collect and use wisely the various treasures of the seas to get rid of the opposing captains and build a solid reputation across the oceans! However, watch out for the Oblivion! This scourge sweeps memories away and sinks unsuccessful captains into oblivion... So, raise your bounty to the highest level and build an unforgettable legend! - Play as one of 3 unique captains of ARGH! and compete against 6 players in a resource-filled arena. - Explore the various islands and loot their abundant treasures. - Use these treasures to attack other ships! - Adapt to each situation! Is fighting really the best option? - Keep an eye on the Oblivion and its progress to avoid fading from memory. - Achieve great feats to earn the highest bounty in the Seven Seas!
row.short_description: Play as one of the legendary captains in the world of ARGH! Compete against 6 other players in an arena and become the greatest threat to the Seven Seas. Prepare your arsenal by looting nearby islands, sink your opponents, and brave the Oblivion to win and sweep the board!

row.name: Forgotten Souls

Can she escape back to her own life, or will the world of dreams claim her soul? row.short_description: Nadia wakes up in a strange mansion with no memories and only a handsome stranger for help. Can she escape back to her own life, or will the world of dreams claim her soul?

row.name: i love me, i love me not

Check them out :) Mobile Port! 'i love me, i love me not' can now be played on both Android and iOS ! About the Game ilm, ilmn is a casual relaxing game focusing on teaching players healthy mental-health habits. you'll play as a sunflower who's been feeling physically and mentally drained, losing their petals - a part of themself - as a result. you'll wander, explore and meet new friends around this beautiful flower field, each teaching you a healthy habit, helping you grow yourself back together again! each character serves a different purpose for the player : Sol, the Sun - allows the player to speak about their feelings. Naveen, the Frog - teaches the player about journaling. Neptune, the Teardrop - teaches the player a self-love practice. Atlas, the Tortoise - teaches the player about meditating. Aphrodite, the Heart - helps the player overcome heartbreak. Jupiter, the Dog - teaches the player a new skill.
row.short_description: a hand-drawn mental-health-focused game!

row.name: CampNight
row.detailed_description: Try to survive as long as possible by collecting wood to keep the fire alive! Collect wood, kill enemies and loot chests to keep the fire burning so you don't freeze! You have to watch out tho, because when you're too long too far away from your fire you'll start to freeze! And the longer you survive, the more enemies will come to kill you! Can you survive the longest and become the number one on the leaderboard?! features Survival PvE Lootchests Gathering & much more!
row.short_description: Take care of your fire or you freeze to death!

row.name: Dominance
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR COMUNITY ROADMAP About the Game Dominance is a reckless, off-the-wall multiplayer top-down shooter, designed with an emphasis on build variety. Dominance’s main philosophy? Put as few restrictions on the player as possible! In the game, you will defeat your opponents with a large arsenal of upgradable ranged and melee weaponry - from bouncing ricochet sniper rifles to hockey sticks, and more! Mix & match equipment and weaponry to create a perfect loadout - wage war on a huge map and use its varied terrain to your advantage. A new twist on a multiplayer top-down shooter! Deliver death from all angles in this high-octane top-down shooter! Take out enemies with precise hits, predict their movement to come out on top - and utilize active skills, unique to each weapon type and character, to truly Dominate the battlefield. Evolve your character and equipment! Explore the synergies and combinations of abilities, artifacts, guns and armor to find the one that perfectly compliments your style of play. The world of Dominance plays an equally important role during battle - pay attention to your surroundings to stay ahead! Every area has its unique bonuses and hazards. Use the terrain to your advantage - hide in bushes to ambush your opponents, run on concrete to move faster and explore other unique properties of the game map! Choose between a roster of distinct characters - each with a unique set of active and passive abilities, as well as a leveling tree. Defeat other players to become stronger - and win games to unlock lore and customization items for your Hero.
row.short_description: Dominance is a multiplayer top-down shooter, built on a no-limits attitude. Choose between a rich variety of different ability and item combinations, select one of 6 distinct characters. Battle up to 24 foes on the ever-evolving terrain — and prove your Dominance.

row.name: Souls of Tartarus
row.detailed_description: Souls of Tartarus is a 'Rogue-lite', 'Souls-like' inspiered Top-Down Dungeon Crawler. A gamble with the ruler of the underworld 'Tartarus' gives you a last chance to be reborn. Can you defeat his Generals that became lazy and set in there ways? No Checkpoints. No Saves. One Run. One Chance. What is it about? The Barrier of a True Roguelike can sometimes be a bit high. So I tought about a way to combine Rogue-lites with Rogue-likes. You can die during your runs to earn resources but after every 3 runs you will have to face a Boss that needs to be defeated. You lose you start again. You Win you continue to climb up. Ohh and we also sprinkle in a bit of puzzle solving under pressure to keep your braincells fresh and on its toes. Set Losely in the World of Greek Mythology we also borrow from other cultures to create an interesting mix of culture within the Abyss of the Eternal God. Features: A Rogue-Like with the accessablity of a Rogue-Lite, replayability and the adrenaline pumping threat of permadeath. A fun main character that Swears alot. Be a shitty wizard, an awesome swordsman or a grifter in between... it is totally up to you! Top-Down Combat that isnt as fast as other Rogue-Likes, be more methodical, think ahead and strike when the time is right! Lots of spells and weapons, but be warned that you are an average joe.... so all you can do so can the enemy. Continued developement as in 'Early Access' so I will continue to finetune combat, levels, etc as well as add more stuff to round up the experiance acording to player feedback. Apart from randomly generated dungeons there will be new big and complex puzzle sovling dungeons in regular intervals. Plans for Release and After The main Realease will have 5 Randomly generated themes of dungeons that each offer specific dungeon types/Game modes, I call these 'Realms', and another 2 'Semi' randomly generated Dungeons that focus more on puzzle solving and a good old handcrafted touch of madness, I call these 'Dungeons'. After that I plan to regularely update new 'Realms' and especially 'Dungeons' to have a good pool of maps that randomly pop up in your runs. Soo...Will you rage quit sometimes? probably.....BUT.....you’ll git gud… Eventually. See Ya!!!
row.short_description: Souls of Tartarus is a 'Rogue-lite', 'Souls-like' inspiered Top-Down Dungeon Crawler. A gamble with the ruler of the Underworld 'Tartarus' gives you a last chance to be reborn. Can you defeat his Generals that became lazy and set in there ways? No Checkpoints. No Saves. One Run, One Chance.

row.name: Escape First Alchemist: Prologue
row.detailed_description: If you've enjoyed the Prologue, check out the full game: Escape First Alchemist  ⚗️   (This is a single player prologue game for Escape First Alchemist ) ✩ ₊ ☪︎ ⁺₊ ✩ ₊ ☪︎ ⁺₊  ✩ ₊ ☪︎ ⁺₊  ✩ ₊ ☪︎ ⁺₊  ✩ ₊ ☪︎ ⁺₊  ✩ ₊ ☪︎ ⁺₊  ✩ ₊ ☪︎ ⁺₊  ✩ ₊ ☪︎  Escape First Alchemist ⚗️ is a multiplayer (Full version only) first person escape room / adventure game, where you play as the apprentices of the reclusive sorceror-alchemist 'Trismegistus'. row.short_description: First-person escape adventure game. Solve riddles of a reclusive alchemist that trapped you in his workshop. Brew potions and overcome challenges as he laughs at your failures and makes light of your successes...But what if things are not what they seem?

row.name: Now you are the persecuted
row.detailed_description: Run. Don’t fight. You spawn in a weird, half-loaded dungeon. No sword. No loot. No upgrades. Just you, a white door, and a bunch of enemies that don’t stop coming. Every door you open means more monsters chasing you down. Controls Move with WASD or arrows . Dash with Shift or right click . That’s all you get. Procedural chaos Every floor is randomly generated, so you never really know what’s waiting—other than more enemies and more panic . Simple to play, hard to survive Find the white door to escape the dungeon. Each door you enter spawns another enemy. No fighting. No items. Just pure running for your life. Bugs included This is one of my first solo games, so expect glitches. Enemies might do something stupid. Things might break. That’s kind of the fun of it. Why play this? Because it’s free, it’s quick to pick up, and it’ll either make your heart race or make you rage.
row.short_description: No weapons. No loot. No mercy. Just you, a half-loaded dungeon, and endless monsters. Every door makes things worse—so run like hell, or get swallowed by the monsters.

row.name: Axiom
row.detailed_description: Jump into the shoes of Miles as he battles to master his powers in order to uncover the truth about the enigmatic Axiom Corporation. Dive head first into the complexity of the human mind in electrifying fast-paced parkour and gripping story as Miles explores memories, exposes injustices and traverses psychedelic mindscapes. FEATURES Free-Running: Use a variety of leaps, wall-runs, rolls and slides to explore the world in quick, fluid movements Mindscapes: Traverse captivating, mind-bending levels based on Non-Euclidean geometry Narrative: Engaging story exploring family, corruption and the greater good…
row.short_description: In a cyberpunk world where giant corporations take advantage of their power, only those with the ability to enter the human mind can stop corruption at its source. You are a mind assassin called Miles and this mind-bending first-person action-adventure is your story of revenge.

row.name: Dreamland
row.detailed_description: What is Dreamland? Dreamland is a captivating, compact adult visual novel that is actively being developed. Dreamland's Story Description The long-lasting nationwide lockdown has ended, and you finally get to meet up with your best friends from university to go on your first ever college spring break. All of you decide to travel to a town called Dreamland - the capital of the wildest spring break activities. And what seems at the beginning as a fun adventure filled with hot girls, parties and sex, you uncover that Dreamland has a dark and horrifying mystery which haunts you and your friends... Game's Features Every single render in this romance visual novel is manually animated with panning movement and floating particle and flare effects to give the impression that the environment is alive which is something unique to this visual novel in particular. Dreamland also has fully animated erotic scenes with the girls and sexy collectible renders scattered all over the game's backgrounds for you to locate. Not to mention, your choices make a huge difference in the way the story progresses.
row.short_description: Welcome to Dreamland! A town which hosts the wildest college spring break activities filled with hot girls, parties and sex. However, if you look close enough, you'll discover that Dreamland also hides a dark and horrifying mystery which haunts you and your friends...

row.name: Walk While My Grandmother Plays The Piano
row.detailed_description: She's not the best at the piano, it's been a few years... But with more time on her hands she's been playing. Please enjoy this game - as you walk, she'll play. If you take a break, so will she.

row.reviews: “I'm walking and she's playing the piano” 8/10 – my friend

row.name: Daddy
row.detailed_description: Daddy is a First Person Shooter designed to keep the player on the tips of their fingers, as they explore a devilish mansion full of evil cultists and their abominations. With full controller support, the player role-plays as the character Jay(Daddy) and can find/equip various weapons and items to aid them in their horrific adventure. Explore the mansion, sabotage the cult and their schemes, all while trying to rescue your damsel in distress. Story Fed up with the lack of romanticism in their relationship, Samantha, leaves Jay, for her newly found, attention benefactor, Richie and unwittingly joins a cult. Upset over losing his girl to this mystery man, Jay, embarks on a vengeful journey to get Samantha back. Not long after breaking into Richie's mansion, Jay finds the cult to be murderous and full of evil schemes. Now he must save his girl and the city from Richie's wicked intentions.
row.short_description: Sabotage a cult and their schemes in this Mystery, Horror, FPS. Explore a mansion while massacring the creepy followers and their foul abominations. Find various weapons to slay your enemies with and uncover the cruel secrets of the organization.
row.notes: There is violence, death, and gore throughout this game.

row.name: Temple of Kasthet
row.detailed_description: As he was driving home to Wisconsin, bitter 30 year old Brian Teaser wakes up in a mysterious pyramid. Great, now there's blood and corpses everywhere. Thankfully they're fake.. right? He's only apparently got a few minutes to find the pieces and solve the puzzles if he does not wish to end up like all these dead bodies sprawled everywhere. Hilarious. If he finds whoever pulled this prank on him they're not going to laugh anymore! Temple of Kasthet is a first person Puzzle / Escape game with an ambiance straight out of the horror movies from the 1930s, with added humour and sarcasm. You play as the (not) brave (at all) Brian Teaser, in a fantasy interpretation of a haunted egyptian pyramid. Escape from the Temple and solve its mindblowing puzzles before they, well, blow your mind. In Temple of Kasthet, you will : Explore a terrifying environment in a first person view. Find and collect hidden puzzle pieces. Solve puzzles to unlock doors. Discover the story of the Temple with full english or french voice acting (subtitles available). Temple of Kasthet was developped by Random Therapy, a 6 developer team (and a cat) from Switzerland. Lots of chocolate were consumed while working on this project.
row.short_description: Brian Teaser must escape from a mysterious Temple by solving mindblowing puzzles before they, well, blow his mind.

row.name: みらくるすいーぱー Playtest
Cozy Corner
row.detailed_description: Cozy Corner is a calming game that is meant to help you get started with your tasks and bring you into the flow state. It also gives you a cozy place to rest and be productive without any distractions. With no actual gameplay involved, Cozy Corner asks players to work on a task of their own choosing (be it studying, getting some work done, or chores) and sets a timer for said task. As a background, a different range of Lo-Fi music plays while the users work on their tasks. Cozy Corner will have three options for the time management methods: the Pomodoro technique, the 52/17 Rule, and a custom timer of the user's own choice.
row.short_description: Cozy Corner is a task manager desktop app that is meant to help you get started with your tasks and bring you into the flow state. It also gives you a cozy place to rest and be productive without any distractions.

row.short_description: Ruza is an RPG where you lead a group of misfits to stop a monster, a vile reindeer.
